back.description: Other face of a double-faced / modal / flip card; the front face is the card itself.

colors.description: Color indicator (overrides the colors of the mana cost).

display_name.description: The name shown to players when it differs from `name` (a token file named "Elemental X-X Red Trample" shows as "Elemental"; a named token such as "Beau"). Without it a token named like "Beast 4-4 Trample" shows everything before the "4-4".

layout.description: How the two faces relate: transform (default; the back is only reached by transforming), modal (either face can be cast or played from hand) or split (either half can be cast from hand; in the graveyard/hand only the first half is modelled).

oracle_text.description: Reference text only (shown in the UI); never interpreted.

oneOf.description: The effect of an instant or sorcery (or an Aura/Equipment attach, etc.).
"Rather than pay {2} for each previous time you've cast this spell from the command zone, pay 2 life that many times" (Liesa, Shroud of Dusk).

"X" that is not paid in the mana cost but fixed when the spell is cast / an ability of this card is activated: `Amount::X` in its effects reads this value (Monstrous Onslaught: X = greatest power among creatures you control; Undercity Upheaval: creature cards in your graveyard).
Choose one (or more) of several spell modes; each mode has its own targets.

allow_repeat.description: "You may choose the same mode more than once" (Eldrazi Confluence).

escalate.description: Escalate: this cost is paid once for each mode chosen beyond the first.

max_if.description: "If <condition>, you may choose both / all": while the condition holds (evaluated for the caster when the modes are chosen) the maximum becomes this number.

min_if.description: While the condition holds the MINIMUM number of modes becomes this ("if teamwork was paid, choose both" is mandatory).

total_paw.description: "Choose any number of modes that total exactly N": the chosen modes' `paw` values (used as weights) must add up to exactly this (Pick Your Poison).

x_modes.description: "Choose X" (Doomsday Confluence): X is announced first and exactly X modes are then chosen (`choose_min`/`choose_max` are ignored).

from.description: Zone the ability can be activated from (default: battlefield).

loyalty.description: Planeswalker loyalty ability: the cost is a loyalty change (positive adds).

once.description: Exhaust: this ability can be activated only once per object (reset when it leaves the battlefield).

power_up.description: A power-up ability (Marvel "Power-up" ability word); `Trigger::AbilityActivated.power_up` matches only these.

special_action.description: A special action (CR 116.2): activating it never uses the stack, so it resolves at once (paying {U} to end a Gliding Licid's effect).

as_enters.description: "As this enters ...": the trigger resolves before state-based actions are checked, so a 0/0 body isn't killed while it waits (Wood Elemental, Mimeoplasm).

batched.description: "One or more ...": simultaneous events (cards leaving together, several tokens created at once) trigger it only once.

condition.description: Intervening "if" clause, checked on trigger and again on resolution.

from.description: Zone the source must be in for the trigger to be watching (default: battlefield).

limit_per_turn.description: "This ability triggers only twice each turn" (Nadu, Winged Wisdom): at most this many times each turn (0 = no limit); counted per permanent.

no_recheck.description: The condition is checked only when the ability triggers, never again on resolution (an event-dependent condition the card encodes against the entering / cast object: Valakut's "five other Mountains", a per-colour trigger set).

once_ever.description: "This ability triggers only once" (ever, while this object stays in the zone it triggered in: Acrobatic Cheerleader).

once_per_turn.description: "This ability triggers only once each turn."

optional.description: "you may" - the controller decides on resolution.

from.description: Zone the source must be in for this to apply (default: battlefield).

oneOf.description: Suspend N—cost: from hand, pay `cost` to exile this with N time counters; at the start of each of your upkeeps remove one, and when the last is gone cast it without paying its mana cost. (Expanded into an activated and a triggered ability when the card loads.) `x`: Suspend X ({X}{B}{B}{B}, X can't be 0): `cost` holds the X symbol and the card gets X time counters.

Foretell {cost}: on your turn pay {2} to exile this from your hand (a special action); on a later turn cast it from exile for `cost`. Expanded into an activated ability and an alternative cost when the card loads.
"This creature enters prepared" (expanded into an enters trigger with `BecomePrepared`).
Old Companion (The Companion of the Wilds): if this is your companion, you may cast it from your sideboard without first paying {3}.

"If this is your commander, choose a color before the game begins" (Clara Oswald): asked in the pre-game for a commander in the command zone; stored in `Player.pregame_color` and read by `StaticEffect::SetColorsPregame`.
Devour N: as this enters you may sacrifice any number of other creatures; it gets N +1/+1 counters for each (done when it enters).
"Any player may activate this ability": every non-mana activated ability of this permanent can be activated by any player (they pay the cost and are "you" for the ability's effects).

Marks a permanent whose leaves-the-battlefield abilities read `Amount::LkiCount`: when it leaves, the battlefield (plus permanents that left in the same batch) is recorded in its last-known information (Kodama of the Center Tree).

"Only your opponents may activate this ability" (Detention Vortex, Knight of the Holy Nimbus): every non-mana activated ability of this permanent can be activated only by its controller's opponents (they pay the cost and are "you" for the effects).

Marks the NEXT activated ability of this permanent as one only the controller of the permanent it is attached to may activate (they pay the cost and are "you" for it), instead of this permanent's own controller (Volrath's Curse). Other abilities keep their normal activators.
Umbra armor (on an Aura): if the enchanted permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura.

Bestow {cost}: may be cast for `cost` as an Aura that enchants a creature (and becomes a creature again when unattached). The card's other abilities are written normally (an `EnchantedGets` static gives the bonus while it is attached).

Encore {cost}: from the graveyard (sorcery speed), pay `cost` and exile this card: for each opponent create a token copy that has haste and must attack (this engine does not pin it to that opponent), sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step.

Prototype {cost} P/T: may be cast for `cost` as a smaller creature (the color and power/toughness of the prototype) - written as an alternative cost; on the battlefield it has the prototype P/T and the colors of the prototype cost.
Unleash: it may enter with a +1/+1 counter; it can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter.

A room of a dungeon card (a token card in the command zone): `next` names the rooms it leads to. The room's effect is a normal `Triggered` ability with `Trigger::EntersRoom { name }` and `from: Command` on the same card.

"Start your engines!": when this enters, if you have no speed your speed becomes 1 (expanded into an enters trigger). Speed then increases by 1 (max 4) the first time each turn an opponent loses life during your turn. Use `Condition::MaxSpeed` for "Max speed — ..." abilities.
Plot {cost}: at sorcery speed pay `cost` to exile this from your hand; on a later turn cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, at sorcery speed.
Warp {cost}: this may be cast from hand for `cost`; if so, exile it at the next end step, and it may be cast from exile on a later turn for its mana cost.

Ninjutsu {cost}: from hand, pay `cost` and return an unblocked attacker you control to its owner's hand: this enters tapped and attacking (activate during the declare-blockers step or later in combat). Expanded into an activated ability when the card loads.
Compleated: if Phyrexian mana in this planeswalker's cost was paid with life, it enters with two fewer loyalty counters for each such symbol.
"Spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability" (Throne of Eldraine): the generic mana of every activated ability of this card is paid with mana of the color it chose as it entered.
Mana of any type can be spent to activate this permanent's abilities (Sharkey, Tyrant of the Shire): colored and colorless costs are paid with any mana.
"Spend only <color> mana on X" (Crypt Rats, Drain Life, Crimson Hellkite): the {X} of this card's spell cost and of its activated abilities can only be paid with mana of that color.

or_color.description: "Spend only black and/or red mana on X" (Soul Burn): X may be paid with either color.

oneOf.description: "Spend only colored mana on X. No more than one mana of each color may be spent this way" (Emblazoned Golem's kicker {X}): X is paid with that many mana of different colors (the maximum is the number of distinct colors the player can pay; when several color sets work the player picks which).
"X can't be greater than <amount>" (Open the Way: the number of players); checked when X is chosen.
"As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a number between min and max" (Liquid Fire): asked on cast, stored as the card's chosen number (read with `Amount::ChosenNumber`).

"As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may remove any number of `kind` counters from among creatures you control. This spell costs {per} less to cast for each counter removed this way" (Hierophant Bio-Titan): asked on cast; the counters come off the creatures you control (most plentiful first).
"Choose a creature type" announced while casting this spell, before its targets (Aphetto Dredging): stored as the spell's chosen type (`Filter.chosen_type` in its target filters).
"You can't spend mana to cast this spell" (Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis): the whole cost must be paid with convoke / improvise / delve and other non-mana costs.

"...for each <thing> you controlled as you cast this spell": `amount` is evaluated (source = this card, controller = the caster) as the spell is cast and stored as the card's chosen number (read with `Amount::ChosenNumber`; Lethal Exploit).
While this card is in a graveyard, name-based counting treats it as a card with this name (Pardic Firecat: "Flame Burst").

Sneak {cost}: cast it during the declare blockers step by returning an unblocked attacker you control to its owner's hand; the creature enters tapped and attacking. Expanded into an `AlternativeCost` (flash, `Condition::CastWithAlt`) + an enters trigger.
Emerge {cost}: cast it by sacrificing a creature and paying `cost` reduced (generic part) by that creature's mana value. Expanded into an `AlternativeCost`.
"<Subtype> offering": cast it at instant speed by sacrificing a creature of that subtype and paying the difference in mana costs. Expanded into an `AlternativeCost`.
Madness {cost}: when this is discarded, its owner may pay `cost` to cast it (approximated: it stays in the graveyard and is cast from there). Expanded into a triggered ability.
"Enchant player" (Curses): the spell targets a player and the permanent enters attached to that player (`PlayerFilter::Enchanted`, `Sel::EnchantedPlayer`).

"As this permanent transforms into <this face>, attach it to a player" (Curse of Leeches): put on the Aura face next to `EnchantPlayer`. When the permanent transforms into this face its controller chooses the player it is attached to (opponents are offered first) before any player can act; it is not asked when the Aura is cast.
"Enchant opponent" (Psychic Possession, Tenuous Truce): like EnchantPlayer, but only an opponent can be enchanted.
Unearth {cost}: from the graveyard (sorcery speed) return this to the battlefield with haste; exile it at the next end step or if it would leave.
Morph / Megamorph / Disguise {cost}: this may be cast face down as a 2/2 for {3}, and turned face up for `cost`.

face_up_counters.description: "As this creature is turned face up, put N +1/+1 counters on it" (Hooded Hydra).

other_cost.description: Extra turn-face-up costs that are not mana ("Morph—Discard a card", "Morph—Reveal a green card in your hand"). With these and an empty `cost` string, the card is turned face up for only these costs.

oneOf.description: Renown N: when this deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes renowned.

Saga chapters ("I", "II, III" ...): the saga enters with a lore counter, gets another at the beginning of your precombat main phase, each chapter ability triggers as the counters reach its number, and it is sacrificed after the last chapter resolves.
Kicker / multikicker: an optional additional cost. `Condition::Kicked` / `Amount::KickCount` read the result.

buyback.description: This kicker is a buyback cost ("buyback costs cost {2} less": `StaticEffect::BuybackCostChange`).

oneOf.description: Splice onto `onto`: while you cast a matching spell you may reveal this card from your hand and pay `cost`; the spell gets this card's spell effects (and targets) added after its own. The card stays in your hand. Give the card a normal `Spell` ability for its text.
Strive: the spell costs `cost` (a mana string such as "{2}{W}") more for each target beyond the first.

"This spell costs N life more to cast for each target" (Phyrexian Purge): the life is paid with the other costs once the targets are chosen, and the number of targets is capped by the life you can pay.
Entwine {cost}: on a Modal spell, an optional additional cost that makes the spell choose ALL its modes (executed in printed order). Expanded into a one-time `Kicker` that auto-chooses every mode.
"Cast this spell only if / during ...": the spell can only be cast while the condition holds.
An additional cost to cast this spell.
Alternative way to cast (flashback, an alternative cost, ...).

condition.description: The alternative cost can only be used while this holds (Blasphemous Edict: thirteen or more creatures).

effects.description: Overload and similar: cast this way the spell has no targets and does these effects instead of its normal ones.

exile_after.description: Exile the spell instead of putting it anywhere else when it would leave the stack.

flash.description: Cast this way, the spell can be cast at instant speed (sneak: combined with a `condition` on the step; "flash if you pay {2} more").

targets.description: Targets for the alternative effects (an overload-style cost that still needs targets: tiered spells).

oneOf.description: Aura / Equipment attach rule: "Enchant creature" / "Equip {2}".
"This Equipment can be attached only to a creature with toughness 4 or greater": when the host stops matching, the Equipment becomes unattached.

"Enchant creature card in a graveyard" (Animate Dead, Dance of the Dead, Necromancy): the Aura spell targets a card in a graveyard matching `to`; as it resolves that card is put onto the battlefield under the Aura's controller and the Aura enters attached to it (it then behaves as an ordinary Aura).

stay.description: The card is NOT returned: the Aura enters the battlefield attached to the card in the graveyard and stays attached while that card remains in a graveyard and matches `to` (Spellweaver Volute: "Enchant instant card in a graveyard"). `Effect::Attach` can move it to another such card.

tapped.description: The creature card enters tapped (Dance of the Dead).

oneOf.description: Deprecated placeholder (never implemented); use `Replace`. Cards using it fail to compile on purpose.
A static replacement or prevention effect (CR 614/615) that modifies events of the game.

from.description: The replacement works while the card is in this zone instead of on the battlefield (`"Graveyard"`: dredge).

oneOf.description: "This enters under the control of an opponent of your choice" (Captive Audience, Pendant of Prosperity): the first living opponent of whoever would control it.
"This enters tapped" (unless the condition holds when it enters: checklands, fastlands ...).
"As this enters, remove all counters from all permanents" (Thief of Blood): run before `EntersWithCounters`, whose `Amount::CountersRemoved` is the total.
"This spell can't be copied" (Choreographed Sparks): copy effects skip it on the stack.

condition.description: Only when this holds as it enters (escape: "if it escaped").

oneOf.description: "As this enters, choose a creature type / color / basic land type": remembered on the permanent for `Filter.chosen_*` and `ManaProduce::ChosenColor`.

cap.description: With `ChooseKind::PayLife`: the most life that can be paid (also limited by the controller's life total).

except.description: Colors that can't be chosen ("a color other than red").

oneOf.description: Gain-land style: "As this enters, you may reveal a card matching the filter from your hand. If you don't, it enters tapped."

or_control.description: "... or you control a <filter> permanent": no reveal needed then.

oneOf.description: Clone: "You may have this enter as a copy of any permanent matching the filter on the battlefield" (plus exceptions).

condition.description: The copy choice is only offered while this holds (Protean Raider: "Raid — if you attacked this turn, you may have this enter as a copy").

exile_copied.description: The chosen graveyard card is exiled as this enters (Body Double).

exile_two_power_counters.description: With `zone: Graveyard`: choose TWO matching cards (pick them in this order: the one to copy, then the other); both are exiled and this enters with +1/+1 counters equal to the other card's power (The Mimeoplasm). Choosing fewer than two copies nothing.

haste_until_eot.description: If it entered as a copy, it gains haste until end of turn (The Fourteenth Doctor).

tap_and_link_copied.description: "When you do, tap the copied creature": the copied permanent is tapped and linked to this one (`Filter.linked_with_this`; pair with a `DoesntUntap` static): Wall of Stolen Identity.

tapped.description: "You may have this enter tapped as a copy of ...": it enters tapped only if it copied something (Vesuva, Echoing Deeps, Callidus Assassin).

until_end_of_turn.description: The permanent is a copy only until end of turn, then reverts (Cursed Mirror); the copied permanent's enters triggers still happen.

until_turned_face_down.description: It is a copy only until it is turned face down (Vesuvan Shapeshifter): the original card comes back and the "except" abilities end. The choice is offered again whenever it is turned face up.

zone.description: Where the copied card is: the battlefield (default) or a graveyard ("a creature card in a graveyard": Body Double) or exile (The Master, Formed Anew; `filter` then matches cards there).

oneOf.description: "As this Aura is turned face up, you may attach it to a creature" (Gift of Doom): an as-turned-face-up choice among the permanents matching the filter.
Leyline: "If this card is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield" (always taken).
Serum Powder: "Any time you could mulligan and this card is in your hand, you may exile all the cards from your hand, then draw that many cards" (asked before each keep / mulligan decision).

Conspiracy "Before you shuffle your deck to start the game, you may reveal this card from your deck and exile `min` or more cards matching `filter` from your sideboard" (the sideboard stands for the cards you drafted that aren't in your deck). The exiled cards are "exiled with cards named" this one (`Filter.exiled_with_this` matches them).

Gemstone Caverns: "If this card is in your opening hand and you're not the starting player, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield with a luck counter on it. If you do, exile a card from your hand."
Chancellor: "You may reveal this card from your opening hand. If you do, at the beginning of the first upkeep, <effects>" (always revealed). The effects' source is the revealed card.

main_phase.description: The effects happen at the beginning of your first main phase instead of the first upkeep (Chancellor of the Tangle).

oneOf.description: Shock land: "As this enters, you may pay N life. If you don't, it enters tapped."

"If this would enter, <pay cost> instead. If you do, put it onto the battlefield; if you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard" (Mox Diamond: discard a land; Lotus Vale: sacrifice two untapped lands; Heart of Yavimaya, Kjeldoran Outpost). An as-enters choice; unpaid, the permanent goes to the graveyard.
"You may have this enter tapped. If you do, <then>" (Mariposa Military Base): an as-enters choice; `then` runs when it enters tapped.

"As this enters, put a <kind> counter on a permanent you control matching the filter" (Phylactery Lich: an artifact): an as-enters choice, made before any state trigger can see the permanent (automatic with one candidate, nothing happens with none).

"As this enters, exile X cards matching the filter from your graveyard (X = this spell's X). If you can't, put it into its owner's graveyard instead. For each card exiled this way it enters with your choice of one counter of the listed kinds" (Frankenstein's Monster): you choose the cards (automatic when exactly X match), then a counter kind per card (automatic with one kind).

"As this enters, exile any number of <filter> cards from your graveyard" (Sutured Ghoul): the controller picks any number; the total power and toughness of the exiled cards is read with `Amount::EnterExiledPower` / `EnterExiledToughness`.
"As this enters, sacrifice all <filter> you control" (Overlaid Terrain): done before the permanent can be responded to; the filter is relative to the controller.

"As this enters, choose a permanent matching the filter": this permanent is linked to it (`Filter.linked_with_this`, which still finds it after this has left: Dauntless Bodyguard). `optional`: "you may choose" (Scheming Fence): the player may pick nothing and then nothing is linked.
"Hexproof from white": can't be the target of spells or abilities from matching sources that opponents control.
The source's `mark` (see `Effect::SetMark`); 0 when unset.
The result of the most recent die roll.
The result chosen by the last `RollTwoChooseOne`.
The result not chosen by the last `RollTwoChooseOne`.
The X chosen when casting / activating.
The X of the spell that caused this trigger ("whenever you cast a spell with {X} in its mana cost ... X counters": Zaxara).
The number of modes chosen for the spell that fired a cast trigger ("the number of times you chose a mode for that spell": Riku of Many Paths).
A player's counters of one kind (energy / poison / experience).
The SUM of the selected players' counters of a kind (Vishgraz: "for each poison counter your opponents have").
How many of the selected players have at least `at_least` counters of a kind (Glissa's Retriever: opponents with three or more poison counters).
How many times the spell was kicked (multikicker); 1 for a single kicker.
How many times the `index`-th kicker ability (in printed order) was paid (Primitive Justice: "for each additional {1}{G} you paid").
A player's speed (0 to 4).
Party size: how many of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard are represented among the creatures the player controls (0..=4).
How many objects are `Remembered` (the creatures sacrificed to devour, the cards discarded this way ...).
How many cards were drawn since the last `Effect::StartDrawCount` ("a card drawn this way": Explosion of Riches).
How many `Remembered` cards have the same mana value as another `Remembered` card (Vault 21: House Gambit: a Treasure for each such revealed card).

Permanents matching `filter` (its controller test is relative to the leaving permanent's controller) that were on the battlefield when the triggering permanent left it, together with those leaving in the same batch (needs `Ability::LkiSnapshot` on the card; 0 otherwise): soulshift X for Kodama of the Center Tree.

Cards in `of` that left the battlefield this turn under the control of one of these players (Deadly Tempest: `of` a stored slot, `who` the iterated player). `filter`: only cards matching it count ("for each land sacrificed this way": Wave of Vitriol).
How many permanents the selected card's last "sacrifice any number" sacrificed (readable from its other abilities: Devour).
The total power / toughness (as they were when sacrificed) of the permanents the selected card's last "sacrifice any number" sacrificed (Dracoplasm).
Coin flips won since the last `Effect::ResetFlipTally`.
Dungeons the player has completed.
Differently named dungeons the player has completed (Ellywick Tumblestrum's emblem).
Votes the option (0-based index into the last `Vote`'s options) received.
The votes the selected players received in the last `Effect::VoteForPlayers` (summed).
The number the first selected player recorded with `ChooseNumber { record }` (0 if none).
The highest number recorded with `ChooseNumber { record }` (0 if none).
The votes the selected cards received in the last `Effect::VoteForCards` (summed).
Mana spent to cast the selected spell / permanent (0 when it was not cast or cast for free).
Mana of one type (W, U, B, R, G or C) spent to cast the selected spell / permanent ("adamant", "if {B} was spent", "for each {R} spent").
Mana of the listed types spent on the most recent "unless ... pays" payment (cumulative upkeep: "for each {B} or {R} spent this way").
How many snow sources paid for the spell ("if at least {S}{S} was spent", Graven Lore): each snow permanent tapped for mana counts once.
How many of the spell's colors had snow-source mana of that color spent on it (Boreal Outrider).
What a creature adds when tapped to station: its power, or its toughness if it has that option and toughness is greater (Tapestry Warden).
How many mana of the spell's cost came from sources of one kind (Marut: Treasures; Coin of Mastery: artifacts; Bat Colony: Caves); each source tapped counts once.
Number of different colors among the mana spent to cast the selected spell / permanent (converge, sunburst).
Distinct colors of mana spent to activate the source's most recent activated ability (Paragon of Modernity).
How many colors the selected card / spell / permanent is (last known for one that left): Crystal, Ancient Cornucopia, Evolving Door.
Number of creatures tapped to convoke the selected spell / permanent (Ancient Imperiosaur, Knight-Errant of Eos).

Number of permanents (or cards in a zone) matching a filter. Count matching cards. `player`: count only those controlled (permanents) / owned (other zones) by these players instead of using the filter's controller ("lands the defending player controls", "creatures target player controls").

The most matching cards any ONE of the selected players has (controlled for permanents, owned in other zones): "an opponent controls more lands than you" is `Compare` of this with `who: EachOpponent` against your own `Count`. (A plain `Count` with the filter's controller `Opponent` adds all opponents together.)
The base (copiable) power of the first selected card: its printed power, or that of the card it is a copy of; no counters or effects (Curie, Emergent Intelligence).
The total toxic value of the first selected permanent: its toxic keywords added up (Goliath Hatchery's corrupted draw).
Current power minus printed (base) power of the selected creature, may be negative (Sovereign Okinec Ahau).
The power of the card revealed / permanent chosen as this spell's `Behold` cost was paid (the best candidate is taken); 0 if none.
The format's starting life total (20, or 40 in Commander).
The number of cards in the first selected player's deck when the game began (Whtz, the Bibliophile).
Cards in the player's hand when their current turn began (Mindstorm Crown).
The untapped lands the player controlled as their turn began (Power Surge).
The number chosen on the source.
Creatures that entered the battlefield under these players' control this turn / during the previous turn.
`other`: not counting the source itself ("another creature entered last turn": Ephara).
The largest graveyard among the selected players ("an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard": compare to 8).
The largest hand among the selected players (Whispering Madness: the greatest number of cards a player discards from a whole hand).
The smallest hand among the selected players ("an opponent has no cards in hand": compare to 0).
All the selected players' hands added together ("the total number of cards in all players' hands": Realm Seekers).
The highest life total among the selected players ("an opponent has more life than you": compare to your life).
The lowest life total among the selected players ("you have more life than an opponent").
Counters of every kind on the selected players added together (Lumbering Megasloth: "each counter among players and permanents").
The total life the selected players paid with the last `Effect::PayLifeRounds` (use inside `ForEachPlayer` with `EachObject`).
The total the selected players have recorded with `Effect::PayTally` (Liege of the Hollows: the mana each player paid).
Counters of every kind on all the selected permanents added together (Nardole, Luxior, Ferrafor).

The printed bushido value of the selected creatures, summed: each "whenever this blocks" trigger of the card that pumps itself by a fixed amount counts as that many points (bushido N is written as such a pair of triggers; Takeno, Samurai General).
2 raised to the power of the amount (Mathemagics), capped at 2^30.
Coin flips made since the last `ResetFlipTally` (Game of Chaos: the stake is 2 to the power of this minus one).
What the player bid or hid in the last `Effect::BidLife` / `Effect::HideNumbers`, by player (summed over the selected players; Pain's Reward, Goblin Game).
How many cards the selector picks (Mantle of the Ancients: `AttachmentsOf`).
Damage / life / amount of the event that triggered this ability.
`a` divided by `n`, rounded down ("extra turns equal to counters removed divided by five").
`a` modulo `n` (non-negative): `Modulo{a, 2}` is 0 for even, 1 for odd.
Total power of the remembered permanents / their total toughness (sum over `Remembered`).
Total last-known power of the cards in the batch that fired a batched `ChangesZone` trigger from the battlefield (The Skullspore Nexus).
Total power of the attackers in a batched attack trigger: the current power of those still on the battlefield, the power they had when they attacked for those that left (Vulpine Harvester).
The greatest mana value among the selected cards (`Stored` / `EventCards` / `Remembered`).
The greatest mana value among the cards put into exile this turn since the source entered the battlefield, 0 if none (Bell Borca, Spectral Sergeant: "the greatest number noted for it this turn").
The lowest mana value among the selected cards (Stronghold Gambit).
Number of differently named tokens among the permanents matching `filter` (a creature token is named for its creature types, any other token by its name): Neriv, Crackling Vanguard.

CopyExcept.description: A change to a token copy (copiable values, so they are permanent).

oneOf.description: "except its name is X" (the copy keeps this name: legend rule, name filters).
"except it has no mana cost" (its mana value is 0): embalm / eternalize tokens.
"except it's legendary" / "snow in addition to its other types".
"except it has this ability": the ability at that index of the SOURCE's printed card (no need to nest the ability inside itself).
"except its power and toughness are each equal to ...": a characteristic-defining ability the copy has (Colossal Clone Master).
"except it's a Food artifact and it loses all other card types" (Shelob, Child of Ungoliant): the copy's card types and subtypes become exactly these.
"its power is equal to ... and its toughness is equal to ...": amounts worked out when the copy is made (Benthic Anomaly: totals of a `StoreRemembered` set).

"except it has this ability" (the ability is added to the copy).

"except it enters with N counters" (counters are put on the copy right away). "except it has vanishing N if that creature doesn't have vanishing" (Flesh Duplicate): `n` time counters and the upkeep / last-counter abilities, unless the copied card already has vanishing.

"it enters with additional counters on it equal to the same number and kinds of counters the copied permanent has" (Dominion Saboteur); only for `EntersAsCopy`.

Roll a die with `sides` sides as a cost ("{6}, Roll a d8"); the result is the ability's `Amount::X` (Clay Golem).

Sacrifice any number of permanents you control matching `filter` whose total power is at least `power` (Phyrexian Dreadnought's "unless you sacrifice ..."; chosen as the cost is paid).

Pay the printed mana cost of the permanent this one is attached to ("Pay enchanted creature's mana cost": Merseine). Activated abilities only.

Gain control (for good) of a permanent matching `filter` that you don't control, chosen as the cost is paid (Herald of Leshrac's cumulative upkeep: a land).
Remove ALL counters from this permanent (of `kind`, or of every kind when absent); `Amount::X` in the effects is the number removed (Molten Hydra, Jar of Eyeballs).

Draw `n` cards as a cost (Psychic Vortex: cumulative upkeep—Draw a card).
Exile the top `n` cards of your library as a cost (Arc-Slogger, Phyrexian Devourer, Royal Herbalist).

Until the beginning of the effect controller's next upkeep (Xenic Poltergeist).

As long as the effect's controller still controls the source AND the source stays tapped ("for as long as you control this and it remains tapped").
Only with `Effect::GainControl`: for as long as the affected permanents' previous controller is the monarch (Garland, Royal Kidnapper: "for as long as they're the monarch").
As long as the source Aura / Equipment stays attached to something ("for as long as this Equipment remains attached to it": Blade of Shared Souls).

As long as every affected permanent is still on the battlefield and tapped (Braided Net: "for as long as it remains tapped").
As long as the affected permanent is enchanted by an Aura (Rootwater Matriarch: "for as long as that creature is enchanted").
Until the start of the untap step of the affected permanent's controller (Orcish Farmer: "until its controller's next untap step").
As long as the affected permanent has a counter of this kind on it (Immortal Obligation: "for as long as that creature has a duty counter on it").
Until the end of the next turn of the affected permanent's controller ("during its controller's next turn").

Until a player casts a creature spell (Soul Sculptor); it ends as the spell is cast.
Until the end of the next combat phase of the affected permanent's controller ("attacks during its controller's next combat phase if able": Sizzling Soloist).
As long as every affected permanent is controlled by a player other than the effect's controller (Vislor Turlough: goaded "for as long as they control it").
Until the affected permanent is turned face down (Vesuvan Shapeshifter's copy exceptions).

Planechase: until a player planeswalks away from a plane, the controller can't lose the game and their opponents can't win (Celestine Reef).

Archenemy: the next time the controller would set a scheme in motion, they set three in motion instead (Plots That Span Centuries).
Archenemy: the controller sets the top scheme of their scheme deck in motion.
Archenemy: set the selected scheme (still face up in a command zone) in motion again: its "when you set this scheme in motion" abilities trigger again (My Laughter Echoes).
Archenemy: abandon this ongoing scheme (it goes to the bottom of its owner's scheme deck).

If excess damage would be dealt to it this way, instead that damage is dealt to that creature's controller" (Megatron, Tyrant): the creature gets at most lethal damage, its controller the rest. `Amount::LastExcessDamage` afterwards reads the excess (`LastDamageDealt` the part dealt to the creature).

keep_combat.description: Deal it as combat damage when the replaced damage was combat damage (Pariah redirecting combat damage).

less.description: The damage is reduced by this amount first (an optional prevention of X: Battletide Alchemist, `Replace::Damage` with `redirect_optional` and `prevent_amount`).

oneOf.description: Damage divided as the controller chooses among the targets.

among.description: Divide among these objects instead of the ability's targets (untargeted: Master of the Wild Hunt's Wolves).

any_number.description: "among any number of" the objects: a part may be 0 (the division is not forced to give each object at least 1).

at_cast.description: The division is chosen as the spell is cast (each target gets at least 1, in target order, the last target the rest) and kept on the stack item; at resolution an illegal target's share is simply lost (Conflagrate). `amount` is read at cast (X is known by then).

divider.description: The first player this selects divides the damage instead of the controller ("as its controller chooses").

from.description: The damage comes from this object instead of the source (the target creature in Master of the Wild Hunt).

slot.description: Divide among only the targets chosen for this target spec of the ability (Magma Opus: slot 0; its slot-1 targets are tapped instead).

oneOf.description: "Prevent the next N damage that would be dealt this turn to any number of targets, divided as you choose" (Remedy, Pollen Remedy, Angel of Salvation): one shield per chosen target.

at_cast.description: The shields are divided as the spell is cast (Remedy); a target that is illegal on resolution gets none.

oneOf.description: Damage divided evenly among the targets, rounded down (Fireball): each target takes amount / (number of targets).
The players lose all unspent mana (their mana pools empty). `give_to`: the first player this selects adds the mana lost this way (Drain Power).

record.description: The mana lost is noted for the source until end of turn, read with `Amount::ManaDrained` (Pygmy Hippo).

oneOf.description: Each selected player activates a mana ability of each land they control (the first one that needs no mana, its first colour; Drain Power).
Double the amount of each type of unspent mana the players have (Doubling Cube).
Look at the players' hands (information only; nothing changes).
The controller privately looks at the selected cards (a face-down creature: Aven Soulgazer). Nothing moves; the look is only logged, like `LookAtHand`.

Distribute `total` counters among the chosen targets (the controller picks the split, at least one each). `remove_at_cleanup`: for each counter put on a creature this way, remove one from it at the beginning of the next cleanup step (Bounty of the Hunt).

among.description: Divide among these objects instead of the ability's targets (untargeted: "among any number of creatures you control", usually `Remembered` after a `Choose`).

at_cast.description: The division is chosen as the spell is cast (kept on the stack item; a target that is illegal at resolution loses its share): Abzan Charm.

remove_at_end_step.description: "For each counter put on a creature this way, remove a counter from it at the beginning of the next end step" (a delayed trigger per creature; Shambling Swarm).

take_from.description: "Move" semantics: as many counters as were actually put on the objects are removed from the first card this selects (Forgotten Ancient).

up_to.description: "Distribute up to N": the controller first chooses the total (at least one per object, at most `total`).

oneOf.description: Learn: the controller may reveal a Lesson card from their sideboard and take it (asked only when the sideboard holds a Lesson), otherwise may discard a card to draw a card. A `Replace::Learn` of the controller's ("if you would learn, ... instead") is offered first; `plain` skips it.

always_ask.description: The rummage half is always offered as a plain yes/no "may" (even with an empty hand) instead of only when a card can be discarded.

plain.description: Skip "draw ... instead" replacement effects (the draws done BY such a replacement must not trigger it again).

oneOf.description: Draw cards, and the cards drawn become `Remembered` ("draw a card and reveal it; if it isn't a land, discard it").
Start counting the cards drawn from now on (read with `Amount::DrawnSinceStart`).

Each selected card in exile that doesn't have suspend gains suspend ("if it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend"): at its owner's upkeep it loses a time counter, and when the last is removed it is cast without paying its mana cost (a creature gains haste).

"Target spell's controller exiles it with N delay counters on it" (Ertai's Meddling): the spell leaves the stack without being countered. At the beginning of each of that player's upkeeps while the card is still exiled a delay counter comes off; with none left the player puts a copy of the original spell (same targets, modes and X) onto the stack.
"Reverse the game's turn order" (Aeon Engine): `Game.turn_reversed` flips; the next player / previous player (turn order, priority, Left / Right) swap places.

Cipher: the resolving spell card is exiled encoded on a creature you choose (optional; put it last in the spell's effects). Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller casts a copy of the encoded card for free.
Remember that the source card is the same object now (for `Condition::ZccMarked`): "if this card is still in the graveyard" delayed returns (Mangara's Blessing).

Meld: if you own and control this permanent and a permanent named `with`, exile both, then put the melded permanent (the card named `into`, written as an ordinary card) onto the battlefield. When it leaves the battlefield both halves go to that zone. With `attacking` (Mishra, Claimed by Gix): both halves must be attacking, and the melded permanent enters tapped and attacking.
Time travel: for each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter, you may add or remove one time counter (asked per object; all changes happen together at the end).

End the turn: exile every spell on the stack, abilities cease to exist, combat ends, and the game skips to the cleanup step. "End the combat phase": exile all spells on the stack, remove all attackers and blockers from combat, and go to the postcombat main phase (Mandate of Peace).
Count one resolution of the source's ability this turn (read with `Condition::ResolvedTimesThisTurn`).
Two players exchange life totals (`a` and `b` each select a player; each ends with the other's old total).

Destroy every creature that was blocked by the selected creature this turn (they can't be regenerated), then, with `reanimate`, for each one that died this way the controller puts a creature card from the graveyard of the player who controlled it the last time it became blocked by that creature onto the battlefield under its owner's control (Glyph of Reincarnation).

died_only.description: With `remember`: only creatures that actually died (went to the graveyard) are remembered, not ones a replacement effect exiled ("X is the number of creatures that died this way": Hellfire).

existing_at_trigger.description: In a triggered ability: only permanents that were already on the battlefield (with the same timestamp) when the ability triggered are destroyed (Drudge Spell).

remember.description: The cards that were actually destroyed become `Remembered` ("return each creature destroyed this way").

manual_return.description: With `until_source_leaves`: don't return the cards when the source leaves; a later `ReturnLinkedExiles` (in the source's leaves-the-battlefield trigger) does (Day of the Dragons: sacrifice first, then return).

return_at_end.description: Return it at the beginning of the next end step (flicker).

return_at_owners_end.description: Return it at the beginning of the next end step of its owner ("return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of that player's next end step": The Eternal Wanderer).

return_bonus.description: With `return_at_end`: each card returns with an additional +1/+1 counter if it is a creature and an additional loyalty counter if it is a planeswalker (Semester's End).

return_counters.description: With `until_source_leaves` returning to the battlefield: a card that comes back under the source controller's control gets this many +1/+1 counters (Lagrella, the Magpie).

return_to.description: With `until_source_leaves`: the zone the card goes back to (default: the battlefield; Brain Maggot: Hand).

oneOf.description: Tag the selected exiled cards as exiled by the selected player (the first one): `MayPlayFrom.exiler` then lets that player play them (Shared Fate).
Return the cards this (departed) source exiled with a `manual_return` Exile to the battlefield.
Exile the selected permanents until an opponent of the effect's controller becomes the monarch (Palace Jailer); they return under their owners' control even if the source has left.
Move cards between zones.

attacking.description: Enters the battlefield attacking (the same defender as the first attacker; Ninjutsu, Warcry Phoenix).

bottom_ordered.description: Several cards put on the bottom of a library: the controller chooses their order (answer: one Pick of all of them, topmost first); Lim-Dûl's Vault.

choose_host.description: An Aura card put onto the battlefield (not cast): its controller chooses what it enchants (none legal: it stays put). Without this the Aura enters unattached (a later `Attach` effect places it).

discard.description: Moving a card from hand to the graveyard counts as discarding it (raises the discard event).

enters_bare.description: The cards have no abilities as they enter, so their enter-the-battlefield triggers don't fire (Xu-Ifit).

face_down.description: Enters the battlefield face down (a 2/2 with no abilities).

from.description: Only cards currently in this zone move ("shuffle it into its owner's library" does nothing if it already died).

host_chooser.description: With `choose_host`: the player who chooses what the Aura enchants (default: the effect's controller). Takklemaggot: the dead creature's controller (`ControllerOf` the trigger object).

host_creature.description: With `choose_host`: only a creature may be chosen as the host ("Only creatures can be enchanted this way": Retether). An Aura with no creature host stays where it is.

host_only.description: With `choose_host`: the returned Aura can only enchant a permanent in this selection, and an Equipment card returned this way enters attached to it (the SBA unattaches an Equipment whose `AttachOnlyTo` doesn't match). Nothing returns if the selection is empty (Unfinished Business: `Remembered`).  An Aura with several legal hosts in the selection lets its controller choose (Storm Herald).

non_aura_if_no_host.description: With `choose_host`: when the Aura has no legal host it still returns, as a non-Aura enchantment (it ceases to be an Aura and loses its "enchant" ability); `Condition::NonAura` is then true for it (Takklemaggot).

order_chooser.description: With `bottom_ordered` (or `ordered`): the player who chooses the order (default: the effect's controller). Morphic Tide: each owner orders their own cards (`EachObject` inside `ForEachPlayer`).

ordered.description: Several cards put on top of a library: the controller chooses their order ("in any order"; answer: one Pick of all of them, topmost first).

position.description: Into a library at this position from the top (0 = top, 1 = second from the top ...); needs `top_of_library`.

position_x.description: The position is the ability's X ("just beneath the top X cards": Unexpectedly Absent); overrides `position`.

random_order.description: Several cards put on the library move in a random order ("put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order").

remember.description: The moved cards become `Remembered` (for a following GrantPlayFromExile, counters ...).

transformed.description: Enters the battlefield transformed (back face up): "exile it, then return it transformed".

under_control_of.description: The cards enter the battlefield under the control of the first player this selects ("return it under an opponent's control": `EachOpponent`).

oneOf.description: For each selected permanent in turn, find a card with the same name in your library (a name can only be found once per selected permanent), put all the found cards onto the battlefield at the same time (`tapped`), then shuffle ("for each of those permanents, you may search ... for a card with the same name": Clarion Ultimatum).

Return the selected cards from the graveyard to the battlefield with `n` counters of `kind` on them (`n` is worked out before they move, so it can read their last-known counters: "return it ... with one fewer revival counter on it": Nine-Lives Familiar).
Counter every activated and triggered ability on the stack (Summary Dismissal).

"Starting with you, each player may pay any amount of life. Repeat this process until no one pays life" (Plague of Vermin): rounds of every player (the controller first, then turn order) choosing a number of life to pay (0 to their life total) until a whole round passes with nobody paying; each player's total is read back with `Amount::LifePaidRounds`.

"Redistribute any number of players' life totals" (Reverse the Sands): the controller picks any number of players, then gives each of them one of the chosen players' current life totals (each total used once; the last player gets what is left); players then gain or lose the difference.

Join forces: "starting with you, each player may pay any amount of mana" (Minds Aglow). The controller, then the other players in turn order, each choose a number from 0 to the generic mana they can pay (a player who can pay none isn't asked) and pay it (sources picked automatically); each player's payment is read back with `Amount::LifePaidRounds` (the total: all players).

A life auction (Pain's Reward): the controller opens with a bid of 0 to their life total, then in turn order each player whose life exceeds the high bid may top it (a number at most the high bid passes); it ends when the high bid stands. The high bidder is Remembered (a player) and `Amount::BidOf` gives their bid. Nobody loses life by bidding. `opening`: the controller's fixed opening bid instead of choosing one (Illicit Auction: 0). `with`: only the controller and the selected players bid (Mages' Contest: "you and target spell's controller bid life"); everyone alive bids when absent.

"Each player hides at least `min` items, then all reveal" (Goblin Game): each player in turn order (the controller first) secretly chooses a number from `min` to their life total (at least `min`); the numbers are read with `Amount::BidOf` and `Condition::BidIsLowest`.

Record that each selected player paid `amount` (added to their running tally, read with `Amount::PayTally`); `reset` first zeroes every player's tally. Use it in a `MayPay`'s effects inside `ForEachPlayer` so later effects can use what every player paid (Liege of the Hollows).

The selected spells on the stack (the triggering spell of a `SpellCast` trigger) gain rebound: if cast from the hand, they are exiled as they resolve and cast free at your next upkeep (Ojer Pakpatiq).
Counter every activated and triggered ability on the stack controlled by an opponent of the source's controller (Kadena's Silencer).
Counter all spells and all abilities your opponents control; the source card of each object actually countered becomes `Remembered` (Glen Elendra's Answer: then one token per `RememberedCount`).

include_abilities.description: Also the abilities on the stack that match `what`'s controller filter (Whirlwind Denial: "for each spell and ability your opponents control").

remember.description: The countered spells' cards become `Remembered` (Hinder / Memory Lapse: then `Move Remembered` to the library).

remember_targeted.description: Remember the targeted spells' cards even when they were not countered (Arcane Denial: "its controller may draw ..." happens regardless).

oneOf.description: Set base power/toughness.
Set base power only (toughness untouched): Arni Brokenbrow, Belligerent Yearling.
Set base toughness only (power untouched): Wall of Tombstones, Sentinel ("base toughness becomes 1 plus ...", `Forever`).
The selected permanents lose one protection quality ("loses protection from black": Cephalid Snitch); only that exact `from` entry is removed.
Put counters of the same kind as the triggering counter-added event on the selection ("put that many counters of that kind").

The controller of the selected spell reveals their hand, then discards each card with the same name as a card spliced onto that spell (Minamo's Meddling). Put BEFORE the counter effect: the spell's splice record is gone once it leaves the stack.
Put one counter of EACH kind put in the triggering (batched) counter-added event on the selection ("one of each of those kinds": Aragorn, Company Leader).
Double the counters on each selected permanent: only `kind` if given, else every kind it has ("double the number of each kind of counter on it").
"For each kind of counter on it, give it another counter of that kind" (Powerful Broker): +1 of every kind the permanent or player already has.

"Choose a counter on [the first selected permanent]. Put an additional counter of that kind on it" (Ichormoon Gauntlet): the controller picks among the kinds already there (automatic with one; nothing with none).

"Choose a kind of counter on a creature you control. Put a counter of that kind on each other creature you control" (Contractual Safeguard): the controller picks one of the selected permanents that has counters (automatic with one), then a kind among its counters (automatic with one); each OTHER selected permanent gets one counter of that kind.

"Choose a counter on a permanent you control. Put a counter of that kind on target permanent you control if it doesn't have a counter of that kind on it" (Aven Courier): the controller picks a kind among the counters on the `among` permanents (automatic with one); each `to` permanent lacking that kind gets one.

"For each selected permanent, choose a counter on it. You may put an additional counter of that kind on that permanent" (The Caves of Androzani): in turn, the controller picks a kind among the permanent's counters (automatic with one kind), then answers yes/no.
Put `n` +1/+1 counters on the selected permanents as part of a modular trigger: `Replace::AddCounters.modular` replacements apply (Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp).
Link this permanent to the first `Remembered` permanent on the battlefield (Diabolic Servitude: "the creature put onto the battlefield with this"); read with `Filter.linked_with_this`.
Forget every permanent this source linked itself to with `LinkRemembered` (Giant Oyster, when it untaps or leaves).

"For each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it" (Quarry Hauler): the controller answers yes (add) or no (remove) once per kind present, in turn.

"Choose a counter on target permanent or suspended card. Remove that counter from it or put another of those counters on it" (Clockspinning): the controller picks one kind of counter on the first selected permanent / exiled card, then adds one more of that kind or removes one.
The selected creatures must attack the selected player this combat / for the duration if able ("Ruhan attacks that player each combat if able", Taunt).

"Choose an opponent at random that this creature didn't attack during your last combat. This creature attacks that player this combat if able. If you can't choose an opponent this way, tap this creature" (Territorial Hellkite).
All creatures the selected player controls (also ones that arrive later) must attack `player` this turn if able (Taunt, from a delayed trigger at the target's upkeep).

Each creature the selected players control attacks this turn if able ("during target player's next turn, each creature that player controls attacks if able": Rowan Kenrith, run from a `Delayed` at that player's upkeep).

The effect's controller ignores this source's player-filtered effect (`PlayerFilter::MorePermanentsThanEachOther`) until end of turn (Damping Engine: "may sacrifice a permanent to ignore this effect until end of turn").
The selected creatures must attack the selected planeswalker/battle if able for the duration (Gideon, Battle-Forged +2).
Remove every counter (of every kind) from each selected permanent.
The selected permanents or players can't have counters put on them / get counters for as long as the source stays on the battlefield (Suncleanser).
Remove up to `n` counters of any kind(s) in total from each selected permanent; the player chooses the kind of each counter when the permanent has more than one kind.

up_to.description: "Remove up to N": the player may stop early (asked before each counter).

oneOf.description: Move counters from the first selected permanent to the first selected `to`: `n` counters (all when absent) of `kind` (every kind when absent; with an `n` and no kind, the most plentiful kind).

at_least_one.description: With `up_to`: the player must move at least one counter when the source has any ("move one or more counters": Goldberry, River-Daughter); `Amount::CountersRemoved` is then the number moved.

each_missing.description: Instead of a chosen amount: move ONE counter of each kind that is on the source and not on the destination ("a counter of each kind not on Goldberry"); `Amount::CountersRemoved` is the number moved.

up_to.description: "Move any number of counters from among [the selected permanents] onto `to`": `from` selects every source (the destination is skipped); for each, the player repeatedly picks a counter kind to move or stops (up to `n` each, unlimited when absent).

attach_to.description: The token (an Aura such as a Role) enters attached to this permanent.

attack_at.description: With `attacking`: the token attacks the first player this selects (Ellie, Brick Master: "attacking that opponent") instead of the first attacker's defender.

choose_defender.description: With `attacking`: the controller chooses which attacked player / planeswalker / battle the token attacks (Mordor Trebuchet).

set_pt.description: The token's base power / toughness computed when it is created ("X/X token where X is ..."); replaces the token definition's.

token.description: Name of a token card definition.

oneOf.description: You get an emblem: a token card definition (no types) whose abilities work from the command zone (`from: Command`).

bind.description: The first selected object (a permanent or a player) is bound to the emblem: read back inside its abilities with `Sel::BoundCard` (a permanent) or `Sel::ChosenPlayer` (a player). Guardian Angel.

until_end_of_turn.description: The emblem ceases to exist in the cleanup step ("until end of turn, you may pay {1} any time you could cast an instant").

who.description: The player who gets the emblem instead of the controller (Ob Nixilis Reignited: "target opponent gets an emblem").

oneOf.description: Create a token that is a copy of a permanent.

attach_to.description: A token copy of an Aura / Equipment enters attached to the first permanent this selects (`EachObject` inside a `ForEach`: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ); default: the first legal host for an Aura.

attack_at.description: With `attacking`: the copy attacks the first player this selects ("for each opponent, ... attacking that opponent": `EachObject` inside a `ForEachPlayer`; Mardu Siegebreaker).

attacking.description: The token copy enters attacking (under the effect's controller, attacking the same player / permanent as normal late attackers).

by.description: The player who controls the token copies instead of the effect's controller ("target player creates a token that's a copy of ..."; one token per player selected).

except.description: "... except it's an artifact in addition", "except it isn't legendary", "it gains haste".

oneOf.description: Copy a spell on the stack (the copy is controlled by the effect's controller); `new_targets`: they may choose new targets.

by.description: The player who controls (and, with `new_targets`, retargets) the copies instead of the effect's controller ("its controller may copy this spell": `{"type":"ControllerOf","of":{"type":"Target","idx":0}}`; demonstrate: an opponent).

each_other_target.description: One copy for each other permanent or player the spell / ability (which has a single target) could target; each copy targets a different one (Radiant Performer).

even_if_gone.description: The copy is made even when the spell was countered (left the stack) before this resolves ("copy that spell" triggers whose rulings say so: Swarm Intelligence, Thousand-Year Storm).

except.description: "except ..." clauses for a copy of a permanent spell (it becomes a token with these changes: not legendary, a name, added types ...).

for_opponent.description: Make one copy of the (single-target) spell or ability for the first selected opponent: the copy's controller chooses that player or a permanent they control as its target. No copy when that player is the spell's target or controls its target permanent (Zevlor: run it under `ForEachPlayer` over the opponents).

target.description: Each copy's first target is forced to be this object ("the copy targets that token", Zada: one copy per creature under ForEach); no retarget choice is offered.

oneOf.description: The remembered cards still in their owners' hands are discarded at the same time (each fires `Discarded`); they stay remembered (Mog, Moogle Warrior).
Note the type of mana spent to pay this ability's activation cost on the source (the first type paid); read by `ManaProduce::NotedType` (Jeweled Amulet).
Note the type and amount of all the mana spent to pay this ability's activation cost on the source; read by `ManaProduce::NotedMana` (Ice Cauldron).
The selected creatures count as having enlisted a creature this turn (set by the Enlist keyword).
Mark the selected spell (a face-down creature spell cast by Illusionary Mask): the creature it becomes is turned face up instead of dealing / being dealt damage or becoming tapped, once.
Creatures dealt damage this turn by the selected card (now or later this turn) can't be regenerated this turn (Runesword).
Soulbond: pair the two creatures (both must be unpaired creatures controlled by the same player).

The selected permanents phase out (they, and anything attached to them, phase in again during their controller's next untap step). Unlock a locked door of each selected Room (the lowest locked door first).
Lock (`locked: true`) or unlock one specific door (1 or 2) of each selected Room, if it isn't already in that state (Marina Vendrell, Keys to the House: four modes).

lock_until_your_next_turn_ends.description: Teferi, Timeless Voyager: they can't phase in until the end of the controller's next turn.

until_source_leaves.description: Oubliette / Out of Time: they stay phased out (they don't phase in during untap) until this source leaves the battlefield.

oneOf.description: The selected phased-out permanents phase in (Time and Tide, The Pandorica).
This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn (Saddle N = `Activated` with `Cost::Crew {power: N}`, sorcery timing, and this effect).
The selected Mounts become saddled until end of turn ("target Mount you control becomes saddled until end of turn": Guidelight Matrix, Alacrian Armory).
Airbend: exile the selected permanents/cards; their OWNER may cast each from exile for `cost` (a mana string, e.g. "{2}") for as long as it stays there.
`decider`: the player who chooses which cards go to the bottom when it isn't the library's owner (Ransack: the caster decides for the target player's library).

by_owner.description: The player whose library it is makes the choice ("that player searches their library"), not the effect's controller.

graveyard_too.description: "Search your library and/or graveyard": matching cards in the searcher's graveyard can be found too; the library is shuffled only if the card came from the library (Captain Kirk, Boldly Going).

instead.description: A found card that matches `instead.filter` (judged against the source) goes to `instead.to` rather than `to`, when `instead.cond` holds (Celestial Reunion).

under_control_of.description: The found card enters under this player's control (Yavimaya Dryad: "under target player's control").

under_your_control.description: The found card enters under the control of whoever controls this effect (searching an opponent's library: Inevitable Betrayal).

oneOf.description: Look at the top n cards; put some in hand / the rest on bottom / graveyard.

distinct.description: The taken cards must all differ in this respect ("any number of cards with different powers": Rip, Spawn Hunter); a later duplicate pick is dropped.

enters_with.description: The taken cards enter the battlefield with this counter already on them (Arbiter of the Ideal's manifestation counter).

face_down.description: The taken cards are put into `to` (exile) face down (The Dragon-Kami Reborn).

keep_on_top.description: The cards that aren't taken stay on top of the library instead of going to `rest`.

must.description: The choice is mandatory: exactly `take` cards (or all matching if fewer).

random_rest.description: The rest go to `rest` in a random order.

rest_ordered.description: The controller chooses the order the rest go to the bottom of the library in ("in any order").

rest_top_ordered.description: The cards that aren't taken stay on top of the library and the controller puts them back in any order (Dimir Machinations; use with `keep_on_top`).

tapped.description: The taken cards enter the battlefield tapped.

to.description: Where the taken cards go (default: the hand).

top_ordered.description: The chosen cards stay on top of the library and the controller orders them ("put those cards on top in any order", Munda, Ambush Leader).

player_choice.description: "A player of your choice adds ..." in a mana ability (Victory Chimes): when the permanent is tapped for floating mana by hand (`Choice::Mana`) the controller is asked which player gets the mana; when it is tapped to pay a cost, or by the AI, the controller gets it.

until_end_of_combat.description: The mana doesn't empty at the end of steps: it lasts until the end of combat (firebending).

until_end_of_turn.description: The mana doesn't empty as steps and phases end this turn ("you don't lose this mana as steps and phases end").

who.description: The player who gets the mana (default: the effect controller). Vernal Bloom: TriggerPlayer.

as_source.description: The control effect belongs to this object instead of the ability's source (with `Duration::WhileSourceAttachedToAffected`: the Aura whose attachment the control lasts for; Eriette, the Beguiler).

to.description: The player who gains control (default: the effect's controller).

oneOf.description: Every player gains control (permanently) of all permanents matching `filter` controlled by the next player to the left (`right: false`) or right (`right: true`) at once (Aminatou, the Fateshifter). `chosen`: instead of every matching permanent, the effect's controller picks ONE matching permanent of the neighbour for each player (Inniaz, the Gale Force); all changes happen together.

Exchange control of two permanents (each one's controller gains control of the other). `destroy_auras`: when the exchange happens, destroy all Auras attached to the two permanents (Gauntlets of Chaos).

"You control target player during that player's next turn" (Mindslaver, Construct a Cosmic Cube): the first selected player's decisions during their next turn are made by the effect's controller. The game surfaces those decisions with `Decision.player` set to the controller (`Game.turn_ctl`, `Game.remapped_at`). `by`: the controlling player when it is not the effect's controller (Cruel Entertainment). `combat_only`: only the next combat phase (Secret of Bloodbending). "You control target player until this finishes resolving" (Word of Command): while `effects` run, the first selected player's decisions are made by the effect's controller. Change the text of the first selected permanent or spell (CR 612): replace one colour word, basic land type or creature type (`kinds` says which may be chosen) with another. The controller picks the old word among those that appear in the text and the new one (or `to` is fixed; `exclude_new` can't be chosen). Lasts `duration` (`Forever` / `UntilEndOfTurn`).
The two selected permanents exchange text boxes (Deadpool, Trading Card). `while_source`: the exchange ends when the source permanent leaves the battlefield (Exchange of Words).
`lands_only_mana`: while `effects` run the player can use only mana abilities of lands (Word of Command).
The effect's controller also controls the first selected player while the selected spell (on the stack now) resolves (Word of Command's cast spell).
Internal: the end of a `ControlPlayerDuring`.
Simultaneous fights: the i-th selected creature of `a` fights the i-th of `b` (surplus entries on either side are left out); every power is read before any damage is dealt (Ezuri's Predation).
`a` deals damage equal to its power to `b`.

"Becomes a 2/2 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn" (manlands, vehicles, animated artifacts). The selected permanents lose all abilities for the duration (Nightcreep: lands that become Swamps).

add_chosen_subtype.description: Adds the creature type / basic land type this source chose to its subtypes ("is the chosen type in addition to its other types").

add_colors.description: Gains these colors in addition to its others ("a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types").

pt_amount.description: Base power and toughness X/X from an amount worked out as the effect resolves (Cactus Preserve: the greatest mana value among your commanders); overrides `power` / `toughness`.

remove_supertypes.description: Loses these supertypes ("is no longer snow").

remove_types.description: Card types it loses ("becomes a creature ... it's no longer an enchantment": Lurking Evil).

set_chosen_color.description: Replaces its colors with the color this source chose ("becomes the color of your choice", `ChooseColor` earlier in the same effect list).

set_chosen_subtype.description: Replaces all its subtypes with the type this source chose (`ChooseCreatureType` earlier in the same effect list; Mistform cycle).

set_name_chosen_subtype.description: Becomes named after the creature type this source chose (Volrath's Laboratory tokens).

set_subtypes.description: Replaces ALL its subtypes ("becomes an Island", "becomes a Goblin").

oneOf.description: `steal`: whoever resolves it gains control of the creature if the shield is used to regenerate it (Debt of Loyalty).
"It can't be regenerated this turn."
"Damage that would be dealt to that creature this turn can't be prevented or dealt instead to another permanent or player" (Whippoorwill).
The next time each selected permanent would be destroyed this turn, all damage marked on it is removed instead (Pyramids).

`remember`: the permanents that received a counter this way become `Remembered` (Ripples of Potential). "Choose a counter on target permanent or player. Give that permanent or player another counter of that kind": the controller picks one of the kinds the first selected object has (players: poison, energy, experience) and one more of it is added (Animation Module).
Amass N ("Amass Orcs N": `subtype` is added to the Army permanently).

Each player shuffles all permanents they own into their library (tokens cease to exist), then reveals that many cards from the top of their library; the revealed cards (still on top of the libraries) are `Remembered`, to be moved on by following effects (Morphic Tide: `Move` them from the Library in waves).
Each selected creature connives, one at a time: its controller draws a card, then discards a card; if a nonland card was discarded the creature gets a +1/+1 counter.
Myriad: for each opponent other than the defending player, a token copy of the source enters tapped and attacking that player; exiled at end of combat.
Goad: until your next turn the creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.

forever.description: Goaded for the rest of the game (Rendmaw, Creaking Nest).

while_controlled_by_other.description: Goaded only for as long as someone other than the goader controls it (Vislor Turlough); supersedes `forever`.

while_source_on_battlefield.description: Goaded only while the source stays on the battlefield (Hot Pursuit); supersedes `forever`.

oneOf.description: The effect's controller looks at the selected face-down permanents (information only; Smoke Teller).
The selected players can't attack the effect's controller or permanents that player controls during their next turn (Willie Lumpkin, Postman).
The creatures the selected players control can't attack the effect's controller or planeswalkers / battles that player controls until the controller's next turn begins (Orzhov Advokist).
Until your next turn you can't be attacked except by creatures with flying and/or islandwalk (Island Sanctuary); planeswalkers you control can still be attacked.
Until end of turn the controller may tap lands they don't control for mana; that mana can be spent only to cast spells (Piracy; `Player.foreign_lands_turn`).
Until end of turn, any time the controller could activate a mana ability they may pay 1 life to add {C} (Channel; `Player.life_mana`, virtual mana sources in `mana_sources_for_cost`).

"Choose a color": the chooser picks; remembered on the source for `Filter.chosen_color` and `GrantProtectionChosenColor`. `per_player`: the choice is stored per chooser on the source (kept for every player in a `ForEachPlayer`) for `Filter.only_controllers_chosen_color` / `not_only_controllers_chosen_color` (Selective Obliteration); it does not set the source's own chosen colour.
The controller chooses one or more colors; the selected permanents become exactly those colors for `duration` (Prismwake Merrow: "the color or colors of your choice").
"Becomes the color or colors of your choice": `who` picks one to five colors, which replace the colors of the selected permanents (Dream Coat).

"Choose a land type and a basic land type. Each land of the first chosen type becomes the second chosen type until end of turn" (Vision Charm): `who` picks any land subtype (basic or not), then a basic land type; every land with the first type loses its land types and abilities for the duration and gets the second (with its intrinsic mana ability).
"Choose a creature type": remembered on the source for `Filter.chosen_type`.

accumulate.description: Keep every choice made on this source's resolution (one per player, in a `ForEachPlayer`) instead of replacing the last one; `Filter.chosen_type_any` matches any of them (Patriarch's Bidding).

any_land_type.description: Choose any land type (basic or not) instead (Illusionary Presence); `Filter.chosen_type` matches lands of that type.

exclude_noted.description: Types this source already noted (`note`) can't be chosen ("a creature type that hasn't been noted for this Saga": Long List of the Ents).

excluding.description: These creature types may not be chosen ("choose a creature type other than Wall").

nonbasic_land_type.description: Choose a nonbasic land type instead (any subtype of a land card other than the five basic types): March from Velis Vel. `Filter.chosen_type` then matches lands of that type.

note.description: The chosen type is also noted on this source (`Card.noted_types`, kept until the source leaves the battlefield).

only.description: Only these creature types may be chosen (empty = any): "choose Human, Merfolk or Goblin".

planeswalker_type.description: Choose a planeswalker type (any subtype of a planeswalker card) instead: `Filter.chosen_type` then matches planeswalkers of that type (Leori, Sparktouched Hunter).

oneOf.description: "Note one of its creature types that hasn't been noted for this permanent": the source's controller picks one creature type of the first selected card (a spell: every creature type for a changeling) that this source hasn't noted yet and the source records it (read back with `Amount::NotedTypes`). Nothing happens when there is none.
Choose a card type (stored like the creature type: `Filter.chosen_type` / `not_chosen_type` match the card type).

excluding.description: These card types may not be chosen ("choose a card type other than creature").

oneOf.description: "Choose a number between min and max": read back with `Amount::ChosenNumber`. Remember a number worked out now, read back later with `Amount::ChosenNumber` ("draws cards equal to the greatest number discarded this way": store it before the discard).

"Collect evidence X" at resolution, X being the chosen number (`ChooseNumber` first): exiles cards from the controller's graveyard with total mana value X or more (biggest first) and makes them Remembered; nothing is remembered when X is 0 or the graveyard can't cover X (Incinerator of the Guilty).

exclude_chosen.description: Numbers this source already chose with `exclude_chosen` can't be chosen again ("a number between 1 and 5 that hasn't been chosen": The Toymaker's Trap). Nothing happens when none is left.

max_amount.description: A computed maximum instead of `max` ("choose a number up to your life total / the number of cards in hand").

random.description: Nobody is asked: a number from `min` to `max` is picked at random (the seeded RNG, no die roll: "choose 1, 2, or 3 at random", Tibalt's Trickery).

record.description: Also record the number for the chooser (`Game.player_numbers`): read back with `Amount::PlayerNumber` / `Amount::HighestPlayerNumber` / `Sel::HighestNumberPlayers` ("each player secretly chooses a number", Menacing Ogre; the choices are made one after another but the decisions are hidden). Run `ResetPlayerNumbers` first.

oneOf.description: Forget the numbers recorded by `ChooseNumber { record }`.
"You choose how each player votes this turn" (Illusion of Choice): every ballot this turn is cast by the effect's controller.
The first selected player becomes this source's linked player, read back with `Sel::ChosenPlayer` ("target player loses 3 life. When this leaves the battlefield, that player gains 3 life").
"Choose a player" (`opponent` limits it to the chooser's opponents): read back with `Sel::ChosenPlayer`.

among.description: Only players matching this (relative to the chooser) may be chosen: `MostLife` ("choose a player with the most life or tied").

exclude.description: Players selected by this (usually `Stored{slot}` holding earlier choices) can't be chosen: "choose a second player" (Gluntch, the Bestower). When nobody is left, the source's chosen player is cleared.

random.description: The player is chosen at random (equal chances) instead of by `who`'s decision ("choose a player at random").

oneOf.description: The selected permanents gain protection from something for a while.
The selected permanents gain every protection quality that any permanent selected by `among` currently has (Concerted Effort: "gain protection if a creature you control has protection").
