The selected permanents gain a static effect for `duration` ("target creature can't block this turn", "can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less this turn", "must attack", "can block any number of creatures"). The effect's own `affects` filter is ignored; supported: CantBlock, CantAttack, MustAttack, CantBeBlockedBy, CanBlockExtra, GrantKeyword, GrantAbility, Modify. With `dynamic: true` the effect's own `affects` filter is used instead of `what` and also covers permanents that arrive later this turn ("creatures can't block this turn", "creatures your opponents control can't block").
The selected permanents gain protection from the color chosen on this source.

The selected permanents don't untap during their controller's next untap step. With `of_targets`, the skip is that targeted player's next untap step for every selected permanent (Blinding Beam), so another player's "untap during each other player's untap step" effects (Seedborn Muse) don't undo it.
Put the selected cards onto the battlefield under the control of the first selected player ("puts target creature card onto the battlefield under their control"); they become `Remembered`.
Exert the selected creatures: they skip their controller's next untap step, and "whenever you exert a creature" triggers fire.
Until your next turn, creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control (`tax` 0), or can't unless their controller pays `tax` generic for each.

This turn the effect's controller can't attack the selected players (not their planeswalkers): "You can't attack that player this turn" (Call for Aid). `attacker`: these players are barred (from attacking `player`) instead of the controller; `planeswalkers`: they can't attack the planeswalkers `player` controls either ("they can't attack you or planeswalkers you control this turn": Sandswirl Wanderglyph).

only_permanents.description: Instead of barring the players: the barred attackers can't attack only the permanents `player` controls that match this filter ("creatures they control can't attack Jaces you control this turn": Jace, Multiverse Architect).

oneOf.description: "Until your next turn, each player may attack only the nearest opponent in the last chosen direction and planeswalkers controlled by that opponent" (Teyo, Geometric Tactician): the direction is the one this source chose with `ChooseCreatureType { only: ["Left", "Right"] }` just before (Left = next in turn order, Right = previous). A later choice by the same player replaces it.

"Empower Jace N": put `n` loyalty counters on a Jace token you control; if you control none, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token (token "Jace 0 Blue Planeswalker": "[-1]: Surveil 1", "[-3]: Draw a card").
Balance clause: each player sacrifices (or, with `hand`, discards) down to the count of the player who has the fewest matching permanents (or cards in hand) (Magus of the Balance).

Internal (inserted when several modes of one spell are chosen): scope this resolution's targets to the target slots `base..base+n` of the current mode, so `Targets` names only that mode's targets; `n == 255` restores them all.
Suspend: a creature cast from suspend gains haste (as long as it stays on the battlefield).

The selected creature cards gain haste until end of turn if they are cast next and enter the battlefield (Alaundo the Seer: "if you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste until end of turn"; set just before a `CastFree`).

The selected cards (about to be cast) carry a rider: if the spell is a creature that enters, it gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature" (Strago and Relm). Put it before the `CastFree`.
Mark the source (an exiled card) as foretold / plotted / warped this turn.

The source (an exiled card) can be cast for its mana cost reduced by `reduce` (generic part only) on a later turn: the foretell cost granted by Bohn, Beguiling Balladeer. Use after `MarkExiled Foretold`.

Exile each selected card from its owner's hand face down; it becomes foretold with a foretell cost equal to its mana cost reduced by `reduce` (generic part only), castable on a later turn (Ethereal Valkyrie).
The selected exiled cards become plotted: their owner may cast each one for free at sorcery speed on a later turn (Make Your Own Luck).
Prepare: the creatures become prepared (a copy of their prepare spell appears in exile, castable while it stays prepared).
The creatures stop being prepared (their spell copy ceases to exist).
If this would leave the battlefield, exile it instead (unearth).

what.description: The permanents to mark (the ability's source when absent): "if that creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead" for a creature returned by this effect.

oneOf.description: The selected permanents are exiled instead if they would die this turn (Ob Nixilis's Cruelty, Incendiary Flow ...).
Adapt N: if this creature has no +1/+1 counters (or a one-shot `AdaptIgnoreCounters` is pending for it), put N +1/+1 counters on it; the one-shot is used up either way.
The next time each selected creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters (Biomancer's Familiar).
The source permanent's effects are ignored until end of turn (`Condition::IgnoredUntilEndOfTurn` is true for it; Volrath's Curse).
The effect's controller makes the block declarations of the selected players this turn ("you choose how those creatures block": Brutal Hordechief).
The effect's controller makes the attack declaration of the active player this turn ("you choose which creatures attack this turn": Master Warcraft).
Raises the exploit event for this source (used by the Exploit keyword expansion: "when this creature exploits a creature").
This spell or ability makes players guess or group cards / permanents into piles: counted once for `Amount::PileGuessAbilitiesThisTurn` (The Celestial Toymaker).

Through the next `turns` - 1 turns as well as this one (Peace Talks: 2): creatures can't attack (`attacks`) and players and permanents can't be targeted by spells or activated abilities (`targeting`; triggered abilities still can).
This turn the source planeswalker's loyalty abilities may be activated `n` more times (Comet, Stellar Pup: "you may activate Comet's loyalty ability two more times this turn").
This turn you may activate loyalty abilities of your planeswalkers twice rather than once (Kaito, Dancing Shadow).

all.description: All planeswalkers you control (Urza Assembles the Titans) rather than only the source.

oneOf.description: Until end of turn you may activate loyalty abilities of your planeswalkers (with `subtype`, if given: "Jace planeswalkers") on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant (Jace's Machinations).

The keyword ability just performed its action ("whenever this creature trains / evolves / mentors a creature"): `what` is the creature that was mentored. Discover N: exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value N or less; cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand; put the rest on the bottom in a random order. Fires `Trigger::Discovers` with `EventAmount` = N.

"For each kind of counter among permanents `among` (checked as this resolves), put a counter of that kind on one of `onto`" (Exotic Pets: `onto` is `Remembered`, the new tokens). The controller picks the permanent separately for each kind (no question when there is only one).

General Jarkeld: of the first two selected blocked attackers, if every blocker of each could block the other one, each creature blocking exactly one of them (of those two) stops blocking it and blocks the other.

Sorrow's Path: of the first two selected blocking creatures, if each could block every attacker the other blocks, both are removed from combat and then each blocks all the attackers the other was blocking.
Tawnos's Coffin: exile the first selected creature and every Aura attached to it (all exiled with the source) and note the creature's counters. `CoffinReturn` brings them back.

Tawnos's Coffin: return the creature exiled by this source's `CoffinExile` to the battlefield under its owner's control tapped with the noted counters, then the other exiled cards attached to it (an Aura that can't enchant it stays exiled).

Bronzehide Lion: return the selected card from the graveyard to the battlefield as a non-creature Aura enchantment (`Card.as_aura`) enchanting a permanent matching `host` (relative to the effect's controller; the controller picks among several). With no legal host it stays where it is.
Tarrian's Journal: the controller may cast one spell matching `filter` from their graveyard this turn. `finality`: it enters with a finality counter; `subtype`: it is also that creature type.

Restart the game (CR 727; Karn Liberated): every card is put back in its owner's library, new opening hands are drawn and the game begins again with the non-Aura permanent cards exiled with the source left in exile; they enter the battlefield under the controller's control as the new game begins. The controller goes first. Emblems and tokens are gone; life, counters and all other game state are reset.

The source remembers the first selected card as its "last chosen card" (`Sel::ChosenCard`). `on`: the first selected permanent remembers it instead of the source (Timothar's Bat token remembers the exiled Vampire).
This becomes renowned.
This becomes harnessed (a designation; lost when it leaves the battlefield; The Soul Stone).
This Case becomes solved (a designation; lost when it leaves the battlefield). Triggers `Trigger::CaseSolved`.

Set (or with `add`, raise) the source's `mark` to `n`: a value its own abilities keep that is not a counter, so it can't be proliferated, moved or removed by other effects. Lost when the source leaves the battlefield; with `this_turn`, it reads as 0 after this turn.
Start your engines!: if the players have no speed, their speed becomes 1.
The selected players are restricted for a while ("players can't cast spells this turn", "you can't gain life this turn").

Choose a card name (stored on the source; `Filter.chosen_name` matches cards with that name). `who` chooses (default: the controller). The choices offered are the names of the cards in this game that fit `kind`.

from_opponent_hands.description: Only the names of nonland cards in the hands of the chooser's opponents can be chosen ("choose the name of a nonland card revealed this way": Alhammarret, High Arbiter).

second.description: The name is stored as a second chosen name (`Card.chosen_name2`) and `Filter.chosen_name` matches either one (Null Chamber: you and an opponent each choose a name). A choice without `second` clears the second name.

oneOf.description: "Choose a card name from among <names>. Create a copy of the card with the chosen name. You may cast the copy" (Garth One-Eye): the controller picks one of `names` (with `once_each`, not one this source chose before: `Card.names_used`), a card with that name is created outside the game, and the controller may cast it paying its costs.

Each player (the controller first, in turn order) secretly chooses a card name; then each player reveals the top card of their library and puts it into their hand if it has the name they chose, otherwise on the bottom (Conundrum Sphinx).
Search the selected players' zones for cards matching the filter (e.g. `chosen_name`) and exile them (up to `max`); they become `Remembered`. The library is shuffled when searched.

The selected creatures become suspected (menace, can't block) / stop being suspected. The controller sacrifices any number of permanents they control matching the filter (they choose); the sacrificed ones become `Remembered` (`Amount::RememberedCount` counts them). Devour, "sacrifice any number of ...". `by`: that player sacrifices and chooses instead of the controller (Jund's devour for the creature's controller).
The selected creatures are removed from combat. `unblock_sole`: attackers whose only blockers were the removed creatures become unblocked (Balduvian Warlord, False Orders).

The Ring tempts you: the Ring gets its next level (max 4: each level adds its ability through the emblem "The Ring N"), then the controller chooses a creature they control as their Ring-bearer. The Ring-bearer is legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.

Venture into the dungeon: enter the first room of a dungeon (the named one, or the player's choice of Lost Mine of Phandelver / Tomb of Annihilation / Dungeon of the Mad Mage) or, if already in a dungeon, advance to a next room (the dungeon is completed after its last room).

Voting: starting with the controller, each player votes for one of the named options. The tallies are readable afterwards through `Amount::Votes { option }` and `Condition::MostVotes` (council's dilemma: `Repeat { n: Votes }`; will of the council: `MostVotes`). `opponents_only`: only the controller's opponents vote (Prisoner's Dilemma). `secret`: the ballots are hidden from the other players (Secret council).

Voting for objects: each player votes for one of the selected cards. Afterwards `Remembered` is every card with the most votes or tied for most. `secret`: hidden ballots. `optional`: a voter may vote for no creature ("up to one"). `all_voted`: afterwards `Remembered` is every card with at least one vote (not only the leaders). The vote count of each card is `Amount::CardVotes`.
Each player votes for a player (`others`: not for themselves). The votes each player received are `Amount::VotesReceived`; `Sel::VotersFor` has the player id as its `option`.

Clash with an opponent of the controller's choice (recorded as the source's chosen player, `Sel::ChosenPlayer`): each player reveals the top card of their library, may put it on the bottom; the player with the higher mana value wins. `win` runs if the controller won, `lose` otherwise (a tie is a loss for both).
The players' speed increases by 1 (max 4).
The players' speed decreases by 1, not below 1 (Spikeshell Harrier). `only_if_highest`: only a player whose speed is greater than every other player's.
Monstrosity N: if this isn't monstrous, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
Flip a coin: `win` runs when the controller wins the flip, `lose` otherwise.

who.description: The player who flips (default: the controller).

oneOf.description: Bolster N: put N +1/+1 counters on the creature you control with the least toughness (the first of any tie). `remember`: the creature that got the counters becomes `Remembered` ("the chosen creature gains trample", Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader).
Roll a die with `sides` sides: the first outcome whose `min..=max` contains the result runs its effects; `Amount::DieRoll` reads the result.

extra.description: Additional dice rolled at the same time ("plus an additional d6 for each mana from Treasures spent": Mr. House); each fires `DieRolled`.

per_attacked_player.description: Roll one die for each player being attacked (a player, or a player whose planeswalker or battle is attacked) and keep only the highest result; `DieRolled` fires for each die (Iron Mastiff).

oneOf.description: Roll two dice with `sides` sides and choose one result (Grave Endeavor): `Amount::RollChosen` is the chosen result, `Amount::RollOther` the other one. Each die fires `DieRolled`; the controller is asked only when the two results differ.

"For each player, choose friend or foe" (Zndrsplt's Judgment): the controller picks for every living player in turn order starting with themselves; the picks are kept on the source (`Card.player_pick`, true = foe) and read with `Sel::PlayersPicked`.

A reflexive trigger ("When you do, ..."): the controller chooses targets now and the effects go on the stack as a new ability. `untargeted`: the "targets" are plain choices (Season of Weaving's "choose a creature"), so the effects still run when the choice has left.

A modal triggered / activated ability: the controller chooses `choose_min..=choose_max` modes as it resolves, then the chosen modes' effects run in printed order. Modes with targets aren't supported here (use Choose inside the mode).

allow_repeat.description: With `at_stack`: "you may choose the same mode more than once" (I Will Savor Your Agony); each repeat gets its own targets.

at_stack.description: The modes (and the targets of the chosen modes) are chosen as the ability is put on the stack, like a modal spell (CR 700.2): the only effect of its ability, each mode being plain effects or one `Reflexive` whose targets become the mode's targets.

budget.description: "Choose up to N {P} worth of modes; you may choose the same mode more than once": modes are picked one at a time, each costing its `paw`, until the budget is used up or the player stops. `choose_min`/`choose_max` are ignored.

chooser.description: The player who chooses the mode(s) instead of the controller ("target opponent chooses one": pile choice, "an opponent chooses one of them").

max_amount.description: "Choose up to X modes, where X is ...": when set, the maximum is this amount (evaluated as the modes are chosen) instead of `choose_max`.

once_each_turn.description: Each mode can be chosen only once per turn by this permanent ("choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn": Gala Greeters, Lita, Genku).

once_ever.description: Each mode can be chosen only once per permanent for the rest of the game ("choose one that hasn't been chosen": Henrika Domnathi, Gandalf the Grey, Kimoyo Beads).

random.description: "Choose one at random": the engine picks a single mode from the game state (no die roll, so no RollsDie triggers); nobody decides.

villainous.description: This is a villainous choice ("faces a villainous choice"): an opponent of a player controlling `StaticEffect::VillainousChoiceTwice` makes it an additional time.

oneOf.description: "You may play / cast the selected exiled cards": the controller gets permission for the window. `any_mana`: mana of any type can be spent to cast the card (its colored / colorless costs are paid with any mana). `free`: the card may be cast without paying its mana cost. The owner of each selected Adventure card in a graveyard may cast it as an Adventure (its Adventure half only) from there until the end of their next turn (Hildibrand Manderville).
"Until end of turn, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead" (Sins of the Past).

affinity.description: The spell cast this way has affinity for permanents matching this filter ("it has affinity for artifacts": Chiss-Goria).

by.description: The player who gets the permission (default: the effect's controller): "target opponent may cast it".

cast_only.description: "You may cast that card" (not "play"): lands get no permission (Grenzo, Havoc Raiser).

exile_after.description: "If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead."

extra_generic.description: A spell cast through this permission costs this much generic mana more (Lightstall Inquisitor: {1} more).

free_if.description: Only cards matching this filter may be cast without paying their mana cost ("you may cast Equipment spells this way without paying their mana costs": Nahiri, Forged in Fury).

land_tapped.description: A land played through this permission enters tapped (Lightstall Inquisitor).

limit.description: "You may play up to N of those cards" (March of Reckless Joy: 2): once N of the selected cards have been cast or played, the others lose the permission.

one.description: "You may play ONE of those cards": once one of the selected cards is cast or played, the others lose the permission (Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion).

pay_life_mv.description: Instead of its mana cost the card costs life equal to its mana value ("you may cast it, paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost").

per_type.description: "For each nonland card type, you may cast one spell of that type from among those cards" (Aminatou's Augury): a spell cast uses up one of its card types for the whole group; lands get no permission. A multi-type spell uses the type the fewest other granted cards have.

play_cond.description: The permission only applies while this holds (checked each time the card is played, with the grantee as controller): "During any turn you attacked with three or more creatures, you may play that card".

oneOf.description: "Until end of turn, you may cast a spell from among the selected exiled cards without paying its mana cost": ONE nonland card of them may be cast for free this turn (casting one ends the offer for the others). The cards keep any other play permission they have (Court of Locthwain).

"Each opponent can't block with more than one creature this combat": the selected players can't declare more than `n` different blocking creatures for the rest of this combat (Mirri, Weatherlight Duelist).

"This turn, instead of declaring blockers, each defending player chooses any number of creatures they control and divides them into a number of piles equal to the number of creatures attacking them ... Assign each pile to a different one of those attacking creatures at random. Each creature in a pile that can block the creature that pile is assigned to does so" (Camouflage).
Additional upkeep steps for the active turn (Ninth Doctor, Paradox Haze); used during combat they come after the combat phase (Obeka).
An additional beginning phase (untap, upkeep, draw) after the post-combat main phase; the end step follows it (Sphinx of the Second Sun).

An additional beginning phase (untap, upkeep, draw) right after the current combat phase, before the post-combat main phase (Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter). There is an additional end step after the current one (Y'shtola Rhul).
An additional combat phase after this one (after the post-combat main phase if resolved then). `untap`: untap all creatures you control now.

then_main.description: "...followed by an additional main phase": a second post-combat main phase after the extra combat (modelled as Combat, Combat, Main, Main).

oneOf.description: `what` becomes a copy of `of` (the first selected card), for `duration` (Forever or UntilEndOfTurn), plus exceptions.
Cast the (first) selected card without paying its mana cost, as the resolving effect finishes (cascade). `may`: the controller is asked first.

after_cast.description: Run (as a trigger above the spell) right after the spell has actually been cast through this effect ("if you do, convert Soundwave": cast triggers see the cast before the effects change anything).

alt.description: Cast using the card's n-th `AlternativeCost` ability (with `pay: true`: madness / miracle with an {X} cost; the spell reads `Condition::CastWithAlt`).

any_mana.description: "Mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell" (Quistis Trepe, Tinybones the Pickpocket).

bottom_after.description: "If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead" (Kylox's Voltstrider).

by.description: The player who casts the card (default: the effect's controller): "its owner may cast it", "target opponent may cast it without paying".

copies.description: Copy the spell this many times as soon as it is cast (a copy trigger above it on the stack; each copy may get new targets): Finale of Promise.

copy.description: Cast a copy of the card instead of the card itself (the original stays where it is): "copy that card and you may cast the copy".

decline_to_bottom.description: If the controller declines, the card goes to the bottom of its owner's library (cascade).

decline_to_hand.description: If the controller declines, the card goes to hand instead (discover).

exile_after.description: "If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead" (it is exiled when it resolves or is countered).

extra_mana.description: Mana added to the cost of this cast ("by paying {R}{R} in addition to its other costs": Ogre Battlecaster); use with `pay: true`. A leading `-` ("-{2}") instead reduces the generic part of the cost ("that copy costs {2} less to cast": God-Eternal Kefnet).

face_choice.description: A modal double-faced card with a castable (non-land) back face: the caster is asked which face to cast (Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios). With `pay`, an `extra_mana` starting with `=` ("={1}") is the whole cost paid instead of the mana cost.

lands.description: A selected land card is played instead (uses a land drop; nothing happens when none is left): "you may play one of those cards without paying its mana cost" (Vault 112: Sadistic Simulation).

lock_spells_after.description: With `may`: when the controller accepts, they can't cast additional spells this turn beyond this one (Conduit of Worlds). A cast that then fails to start leaves the one-more-spell allowance.

on_cast.description: Run when the controller accepts the (`may`) cast, right before the spell is cast ("if you cast a spell this way, put a +1/+1 counter on it": Helmut Zemo).

otherwise.description: "If you don't": done when the card is not cast because the controller declines, or it is a land that can't be played, or (with `pay`) its cost can't be afforded (Chandra, Torch of Defiance).

pay.description: The card is cast paying its mana cost (and other costs) instead of for free ("you may cast it, paying its mana cost").

suspend.description: Cast the card paying its suspend cost rather than its mana cost (use with `pay: true`; The Face of Boe). The card needs a `Suspend` ability.

oneOf.description: "You may cast any number of spells from among" the selected cards without paying their mana costs: the controller answers yes/no for each nonland card, then every accepted card is cast in turn, all before any of the spells resolves (Etali, Primal Storm).

copy.description: Each accepted card is copied and the copy is cast instead (the card stays where it is): Wizard's Spellbook's "copy each card exiled with this artifact".

pay.description: The accepted cards are cast paying their mana costs ("you may cast any number of the copies": The Tale of Tamiyo).

oneOf.description: Internal (from `ManaRider::ExileSpell`): the source spell is exiled instead of going to the graveyard as it resolves, linked to the permanent whose mana was spent on it.
Populate, and the new token enters tapped and attacking (Ghired, Conclave Exile).
Each selected creature that isn't in a sector is assigned to one by its controller; the source's opponents choose first (the space sculptor rule: Space Beleren).
Until end of turn, creatures can be blocked only by creatures in the same sector (Space Beleren +1).
Save `Remembered` into a numbered slot (0-3) for `Sel::Stored` / `Filter.among_stored`; with `append` add to what the slot holds.
`Remembered` = the selected objects, without moving them ("remember the triggering attacker" before a later StoreRemembered / Filter.blocking_stored).
Reveal (remember) the top `n` cards of a library WITHOUT moving them: `Remembered` = those cards ("reveal the top five cards of your library"). Reordering / moving them is done by later effects.
The selected attacking creatures now attack the first selected player / planeswalker / battle instead (a token "attacking that player": CreateToken attacking:true, then this).

The effect's controller reselects what the first selected attacking creature attacks: any player other than that creature's controller, or a planeswalker / battle they control or protect (the current defender stays an option; Misleading Signpost). Auto-picks when only one option.
Empty `Remembered` (a later Choose that picks nothing would otherwise leave an earlier set in place).
Marker (does nothing): the ability this effect is in can't be copied (Gogo, Master of Mimicry: "This ability can't be copied").
Add the selected cards to the end of `Remembered` (Flickerform: the enchanted creature, then the Auras attached to it).
The creature / permanent spell selected (`TriggerObject` in a cast trigger) enters with `n` additional +1/+1 counters (Wildgrowth Archaic, Runadi).

loyalty.description: The counters are loyalty counters instead (Dark Intimations: "that planeswalker enters with an additional loyalty counter").

sunburst.description: Sunburst: a spell that isn't a creature enters with charge counters instead of +1/+1 counters (Solar Array).

oneOf.description: Attach each selected Aura / Equipment to the first selected permanent or player only where that is legal (an Aura's enchant restriction, an Equipment only to a creature, a player only for "Enchant player" Auras); the others stay put (Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist).
Move the selected Auras onto the first selected player (Archnemesis, Maddening Hex: "attach this Aura to that player").
The players skip their next combat phase (`this_turn`: only a combat phase still to come this turn, by the active player).
The selected player skips every instance of the draw step, of the main phases, or of the combat phases for the rest of this turn (Fatespinner).
The players skip their next draw step (Fatigue; "if you searched your library this way, skip your draw step this turn" during upkeep).
The selected players skip their next untap step (Shisato, Whispering Hunter): nothing untaps and phasing doesn't happen.
"Lands you control don't untap during your next untap step."
Creatures each selected player controls don't untap during that player's next untap step (Imaginary Threats); cleared when their upkeep begins.
"Until your next turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to you."

"You may change the targets of target spell" / "choose new targets for target spell": the effect's controller may pick a new legal target for each target slot of a spell on the stack (a slot with no other legal choice is skipped). `blocker` blocks `attacker` this turn if able (Hunt Down, Feral Contest).
You gain control of a spell on the stack (Aethersnatch, Invert Polarity): it resolves under your control, so a permanent spell enters under it.

Exchange control of a spell on the stack and a permanent (Sudden Substitution): the spell's controller becomes the permanent's controller, and the permanent goes to the spell's old controller for good.

Exchange this card (in its owner's hand) with the first selected permanent (battlefield) or spell (stack) you control (Red Herring): this card takes its place and the other goes to the hand. Spells and abilities that targeted the exchanged permanent now target this card.
Change the target of a spell (`must_change`: the target must be changed to another legal one when there is one -- Swerve, Ricochet Trap).

by.description: The player who chooses the new targets (default: the effect's controller). When the selection is empty nobody changes anything (Psychic Battle: `OwnerOfGreatestMv`, empty on a tie).

each_stack.description: Offer a new target for every other spell and ability on the stack that has targets (Boltbender: "any number of other spells and/or abilities"); `what` is ignored. The effect's own ability is skipped; modal spells are left alone.

exclude_yours.description: The new target can't be the effect's controller or a permanent they control; a slot with no such legal target keeps its current one (Chef's Kiss).

forced.description: With `to`: the target is changed to that object without asking, when it is a legal target ("change the target to enchanted creature if able": Captured by the Consulate).

new_filter.description: The new target must be a permanent matching this filter (Meddle: "another creature"); players are not offered.

players_only.description: The new target must be a player (Reflecting Mirror: "the new target must be a player").

random.description: Reselect each target at random from among all legal targets (the current one included); nobody chooses (Grip of Chaos).

to.description: The only new target on offer is this object (Mizzium Meddler: "change a target to this creature"), when it is a legal target.

oneOf.description: "If it's neither day nor night, it becomes day."
"It becomes night." (even when it was day)
"It becomes day." (even when it was night; The Celestus)

The creature becomes tapped and attacking (the same defender as the first attacker; Sneak, "put onto the battlefield tapped and attacking"). With `defender_among`, the effect's controller picks the defender (a player, planeswalker or battle) among those attacked by creatures the selected players control ("choose a player or planeswalker that opponent is attacking"; Tahngarth, First Mate).
The creatures put onto the battlefield "blocking" the first selected attacker (Flash Foliage, Brimaz): they join its blockers without a Blocked event.
The selected attacking creatures become blocked (no creature blocks them; Curtain of Light, Choking Vines): they deal no combat damage to the defender unless they have trample.
"Damage can't be prevented this turn."
`lose_at_end`: the player loses the game at the beginning of that extra turn's end step (Final Fortune, Last Chance).

Each player exiles the top card of their library; the player whose card has the greatest mana value takes an extra turn after this one. If two or more are tied for greatest, only the tied players repeat the process until the tie is broken (Timesifter). Players without a card take no part.
The game ends in a draw (Divine Intervention, Celestial Convergence); nothing that stops a player from losing prevents it.
Exile the top `n` cards of the selected players' libraries ("exiles the top half of their library, rounded up": Ulamog, the Defiler). The exiled cards are remembered.

Look at the top n cards of a library and put them back in any order (Ponder, Sensei's Top). `decider`: the player who looks at and orders the cards when it isn't the effect's controller (Tahngarth's Glare: the library's owner orders it).

Reveal cards from the top of a library until `count` cards matching the filter are revealed: those go to `to`, the rest to `rest` (a library: the bottom, in random order if `rest_random`). The found cards become `Remembered`.

cascade_land.description: Cascade: if the controller controls a `StaticEffect::CascadeLandToBattlefield`, they may put a land card from among the revealed cards onto the battlefield tapped before deciding on the found card (Averna, the Chaos Bloom).

found_to_bottom.description: The found card is not moved to `to`: it goes to the bottom of the library together with the rest (random order with `rest_random`), but stays `Remembered` ("put the revealed cards on the bottom in a random order. When you reveal a nonland card this way, ...": Calibrated Blast, Amplifire).

rest_ordered.description: The controller chooses the order the rest go to the bottom of the library in (one Pick of all of them, topmost first; single-player reveals only).

under_your_control.description: The found cards enter the battlefield under the effect controller's control instead of the library owner's ("put it onto the battlefield under your control": Dance, Pathetic Marionette).

oneOf.description: Prevent damage until end of turn: all of it (`amount` None) or the next `amount` points; only damage dealt to `to` and/or by `from` (anything when absent); `combat_only`: only combat damage.

counters.description: For each point of damage this shield prevents, put a +1/+1 counter on the object it protects (Temper).

end_step_counters.description: For each point prevented from damage dealt to a creature, put a counter of this kind on it at the beginning of the next end step (Scars of the Veteran: +0/+1).

once.description: Only the next damage event matching `to`/`from` is prevented ("the next time a source of your choice would deal damage...").

or_you.description: The shield also covers damage to its controller ("to you and/or permanents you control", "this creature and/or you": Harm's Way, Glarecaster).

redirect_by_source.description: With `redirect_to`: the redirected damage is dealt by the source of this effect (non-combat) rather than by the original source ("Refraction Trap deals that much damage to any target").

redirect_to.description: The prevented damage is dealt to this object instead (a redirect shield: Shimian Night Stalker, Harsh Judgment-style).

oneOf.description: The player may play `n` more lands this turn.
"Your maximum hand size is reduced by `n` for the rest of the game" (cumulative; Inspired Idea).

A player chooses between `min` and `max` cards in a zone that match the filter, then `then` runs with `Remembered` bound to the choice. The filter's controller is relative to the chooser ("a land you control" = `controller: You`). Nothing eligible: nothing happens.

accumulate.description: The chosen cards are ADDED to `Remembered` instead of replacing it (several Choose effects building one set: "one land of each basic land type").

also_zones.description: More zones the choice is made among ("a card from their hand or graveyard": `zone: Hand, also_zones: [Graveyard]`).

among.description: The candidates are exactly these cards (filtered) instead of a zone: "one of those targets" (Aerith Rescue Mission: `Targets`).

distinct.description: The chosen cards must all differ in this respect ("any number of cards with different names / different powers"); a later duplicate pick is dropped.

from.description: Whose zone the cards are in, when not the chooser's own (Duress: the target opponent's hand).

min_amount.description: A computed minimum / maximum instead of the fixed `min` / `max` ("reveals X cards", "choose up to X nonland cards").

random.description: Nobody is asked: `max` of the candidates are picked at random ("a card at random from their hand", "two of them at random").

top.description: Only the topmost N cards of a graveyard zone are offered ("one of the top two cards of your graveyard": Phyrexian Grimoire).

oneOf.description: Choose any number of cards whose TOTAL mana value / power / toughness is at most `budget` ("any number of creature cards with total mana value 6 or less"). The chooser picks one card at a time among those that still fit; stop with an empty pick. `Remembered` = the chosen cards.
A replacement/prevention effect for the rest of this turn ("this turn each creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter").

until_your_next_turn.description: Lasts until the controller's next turn begins instead of until end of turn (Arlinn, the Pack's Hope).

oneOf.description: The selected player(s) face a villainous choice made by `effects` (a `May` / `Unless` that is their choice): done an additional time when an opponent of the player facing it controls `StaticEffect::VillainousChoiceTwice` (The Valeyard).
The controller may do these effects.

remember_answer.description: Record the answer for `Condition::LastCostPaid` (true when the player accepted): "you may repeat this process" (Kindle the Carnage).

who.description: The player who decides instead of the controller ("its controller may copy this spell").

oneOf.description: "You may pay <cost>. If you do, <effects>": `payer` is asked, and if they pay, the effects happen.
"unless <player> pays <cost>": otherwise do the effects. `any_player`: every selected player in turn may pay ("unless any player pays"); the first to pay stops the effects.

Cumulative upkeep: put an age counter on this permanent, then its controller pays `cost` once per age counter (mana / life / discard / sacrifice amounts are multiplied) or sacrifices it. Put it in an upkeep trigger. `if_paid` runs once the upkeep was paid (Balduvian Fallen reads `Amount::LastPaymentManaSpent`). `if_unpaid` runs after the sacrifice when the upkeep was not paid (Thought Lash: exile your library).
Echo payment: its controller pays `cost` or sacrifices this permanent. If that player controls a permanent with `StaticEffect::EchoPayZero`, the cost is {0} instead.
Start a new coin-flip series: zero the won-flip count and lost flag, and make `LastFlipWon` / `LastCostPaid` true so a `RepeatWhile` loop starts.
Run `effects`, then again while `cond` holds (do-while; at most `max` passes, default 20): "flip a coin until you lose".

Do the effects for each object matching a selector, with `Remembered` bound to it. `turn_order`: the objects are processed in turn order starting with the active player (a permanent counts as its controller; Kaboom!).
Do the effects once for each selected PLAYER (in turn order); inside, `Sel::EachObject` is that player ("for each defending player", "each opponent, in turn").

"Each player chooses ... simultaneously" (phenomena such as Caught in a Parallel Universe, Two Streams Facility). The players are asked ONE BY ONE (in the order `players` selects: the effect's controller first, then turn order), but nothing is applied and nothing is shown to the others until EVERY player has chosen: each answer is only kept per chooser, no token is made, no card moves, no event names a pick. A later chooser can therefore never pick something an earlier chooser's result would create. Afterwards `then` runs once per chooser (ForEachPlayer style: `Sel::EachObject` = that chooser, `Sel::ChosenByEach { index }` = their picks in order; a chooser who picked nothing is skipped). Card choice: `zone` + `filter` (controller etc. relative to the chooser, so `controller: LeftOfYou` = "controlled by the player to their left"), `min..=max` picks (an ordered list: the first pick is the "first" creature); nothing eligible: that player picks nothing. Named choice: with `options` (non-empty) each player picks one of the texts instead; `remember: true` stores it per player and source card name for the rest of the game (read with `PlayerFilter::ChoseFirstOption` / `ChoseSecondOption`, flipped by `Effect::FlipPlayerChoices`); `then` is then run per chooser too.

Every player's remembered named choice for this source card's name (`EachPlayerChooses { remember: true }`) becomes the other option ("each player who last chose green anchor chooses red waterfall, and vice versa").
Create a delayed triggered ability.

Create a temporary triggered ability that watches for events ("until end of turn, whenever ...", "when you next cast ..."): when `trigger` matches, `effects` go on the stack. `once` removes it after it fires.

ability.description: Index (in this card's `abilities` array) of a dormant `Triggered` ability (give it `from: "Command"` so it never triggers by itself) that goes on the stack when the temporary trigger fires, choosing its targets then ("target creature gets +1/+1 counters ..." granted triggers: Heroic Sacrifice, Roads Go Ever, Ever On). `effects` is then unused.

also.description: Further triggers sharing this one's single delayed ability: whichever happens first fires it, and with `once` all are removed ("when you next cast an instant, cast a sorcery, or activate a loyalty ability": Repeated Reverberation).

bind.description: Only for events about these permanents (chosen when the spell/ability resolves): "target creature gains 'whenever this deals combat damage ...' until end of turn".

carry.description: The trigger's `Remembered` is this selection, evaluated now, instead of the current remembered set ("when that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand": Ugin, the Ineffable).

cond.description: Intervening "if": checked when the trigger event happens (nothing goes on the stack if false), evaluated for the effect's controller (Fight for the Throne).

oneOf.description: Turn this permanent face up (morph); `megamorph` also puts a +1/+1 counter on it. Turn matching face-up permanents face down (a 2/2 creature with no name, types or abilities); `TurnFaceUp` (morph) turns a face-down permanent back.

The selected face-down permanents have these extra card types and creature types for as long as they stay face down ("they're 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures": Death in Heaven; put after a `Move` with `remember`).

not_creature.description: The face-down permanent is not a creature: it has only `add_types` (Yedora, Grave Gardener: "It's a Forest land").

counters.description: Extra +1/+1 counters put on it as it is turned face up.

what.description: Turn these face-down permanents face up instead of this one (Ixidor, Break Open, Kaust).

oneOf.description: Manifest: put the top card of the player's library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature.

controller.description: Who controls the manifested permanent when it isn't the library's owner ("you manifest the top card of that player's library").

include_source.description: With `what`: the source itself is manifested along with those cards (Jeskai Infiltrator: "exile it and the top card of your library in a face-down pile ... then manifest those cards").

what.description: Manifest these cards instead of the library top: they are exiled, shuffled into a random order, then manifested under `who`'s control (Ghastly Conscription).

oneOf.description: Cloak: like Manifest (the top card of the player's library face down as a 2/2) but the face-down permanent has ward {2}. The new permanent is Remembered.

controller.description: Who controls the cloaked permanent when it isn't the library's owner ("cloak the top card of that player's library": Etrata, Deadly Fugitive).

what.description: Cloak these (exiled, or in hand: Vannifar, Evolved Enigma) cards instead of the library top: shuffled into a random order, then cloaked under `who`'s control (Become Anonymous).

oneOf.description: Manifest dread: look at the top two cards of your library, manifest one of them (face down 2/2) and put the other into your graveyard.

"Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library": each card's OWNER decides (yes = top, no = bottom). Works on permanents, cards in other zones and spells on the stack (target spell or creature).
Put the selected cards on top of their owners' libraries; an owner who gets several of them chooses their order (one Pick, topmost first; Harmonic Convergence).
The controller reorders the graveyard of the first selected player as they choose (one Pick, topmost first; skipped for fewer than two cards): Fossil Find.
"For one spell this turn, you may spend mana as though it were mana of any type" (North Star): the controller's next spell this turn with a colored or colorless mana symbol uses the allowance up.
"The next spell they cast this turn has cascade": the selected players' next spell cast this turn gains cascade (Bigger on the Inside).
Until end of turn, each spell the player casts from their hand has cascade (Yidris, Maelstrom Wielder).

The selected permanents gain every activated (non-loyalty) ability printed on the `from` cards for `duration` (Grell Philosopher). `pay_with`: each colored symbol of a granted ability's mana cost can also be paid with that color of mana ("you may spend blue mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities").
Each selected creature stops being goaded (one-shot goads of any player are removed; a static goad is not): Serene Sleuth.
Detain: until your next turn the permanents can't attack or block and their activated abilities (mana abilities too) can't be activated.
Haunt: exile this card (from the graveyard) haunting the target creature `what`. The card's own `from: Exile` triggers can use `Filter.haunted_by_this` ("when the creature it haunts dies").

Mutate: (the effect of the mutate `AlternativeCost`) merge this creature spell with the target creature (a non-Human creature you own). The caster chooses whether the spell goes over (yes) or under (no) the target. If the target is no longer legal the spell resolves as a creature.

Until end of turn you may play (cast / play as a land) cards from `zone` (your graveyard / library top / exile ...) matching `filter` ("until end of turn, you may cast creature spells from your graveyard"). With `of`, the cards come from the graveyard of that player instead of yours; `any_mana` lets you spend mana as though it were mana of any type to cast them (Whispersteel Dagger).

exile_after.description: "If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead" (graveyard permission only; Bösium Strip).

snapshot.description: The permission is for the matching cards in `zone` right now, not for ones that arrive later this turn (Kethis, the Hidden Hand).

tapped.description: "If you do, it enters tapped": a permanent played or cast from the graveyard through this permission enters tapped (Kaldring, the Rimestaff).

oneOf.description: Until end of turn the controller may play the top card of the selected players' libraries, spending mana as though it were mana of any color to cast them (Xanathar, Guild Kingpin).
Until end of turn, for as long as the card now on top of your library stays there, you may play it without paying its mana cost (X is 0): Temporal Aperture (after `Shuffle` and `RevealTop`).
The source assembles `n` Contraptions (no Contraption deck exists in this engine, so they are only counted in `Player.contraptions`; `Replace::Assemble` multiplies `n`): Steady-Handed Mook.
Double the value of X of the selected spell on the stack ("double the value of X": Unbound Flourishing; `what` is `TriggerObject` for a cast trigger).

Until end of turn you may cast creature spells matching `filter` from your graveyard by foraging in addition to their other costs (forage: exile three other cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food); such a creature enters with a finality counter (Osteomancer Adept).
Until end of turn the controller may cast each selected creature / nonland card in a graveyard (any graveyard), paying its costs (Havengul Lich).

exile_after.description: "If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead" (Mavinda).

tax_unless_targets_own_creature.description: The spell costs this much generic mana more unless it targets a creature the caster controls (Mavinda, Students' Advocate: 8).

oneOf.description: The `to` permanents gain every activated ability printed on each card `from` selects (a card on the stack or in a graveyard counts) for `duration` (Havengul Lich: "gains all activated abilities of that card until end of turn").

Earthbend N: `what` (a land you control) becomes a 0/0 haste creature (still a land) with N +1/+1 counters; when it dies or is exiled it returns to the battlefield tapped. Expands to Animate + AddCounters + two bound AddTriggers.

"You may [reveal] a <filter> card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand" (the Wishes, Mastermind's Acquisition): `who` may take up to `max` cards matching `filter` from their own sideboard into hand (optionally revealing them). No sideboard or no match: nothing happens.

reveal.description: The card is revealed as it is put into the hand.

oneOf.description: "You may play a card you own from outside the game this turn" (Wish): until end of turn the controller may play lands and cast spells from their own sideboard. With `filter`, instead only ONE matching card (Frontier Explorer: a basic Plains; Your Wish Is My Command: an instant or sorcery) may be played / cast from the sideboard this turn and the permission is used up by it; `extra_mode`: a modal spell cast that way may have one additional mode chosen. Filtered grants allow lands and spells alike.
"Add <cards> as your companions" (The Keeper of Kaldra): creates each named card in the controller's sideboard as one of their companions ({3} puts it into hand, once each).
"Give an opponent a card you own from outside the game" (Collector Protector): each selected sideboard card moves into the first selected player's sideboard (and becomes theirs).
A one-shot effect that does nothing itself (reminder-only abilities).

all_colors.description: Has every one of these colors ("both white and black").

all_types.description: The object must have ALL of these types ("artifact creature"); `types` means any of.

among_remembered.description: Only cards in the current Remembered set ("choose one of the cards milled this way").

among_stored.description: Is one of the cards saved in this stored slot (`StoreRemembered`).

any_object.description: In a mana restriction's `ability` filter: "an ability of a [type] source" also covers abilities of cards in hand or graveyard (cycling), not just permanents.

any_of.description: Also required: matches at least one of these filters (OR): "attacking or blocking", "basic land or Gate".

artifact_mana_spent.description: A spell (or permanent) for which mana from an artifact source was spent to cast it (Shadow the Hedgehog's Chaos Control).

attached_by_source.description: Is the permanent the source (an Aura or Equipment) is attached to ("equipped creature", "enchanted land").

attached_host.description: An Aura / Equipment attached to a permanent matching this filter (Miracle Worker: "Aura attached to a creature you control"; filter relative to the ability's controller).

attached_to.description: The permanent is attached to one of the cards selected here (Fires of Mount Doom: "Equipment attached to that creature", `Target`).

attached_to_matching.description: Is attached to a permanent matching this filter ("an Aura attached to a creature", "Equipment attached to a land you control").

attached_to_sel.description: Is attached to one of the selected permanents ("destroy all Auras attached to that creature": `{"type":"TriggerObject"}`).

attached_to_source.description: Is an Aura / Equipment attached to the source ("Auras attached to this creature", "equipment attached to it"). Count it for "+1/+1 for each Aura attached".

attacked_battle_this_turn.description: Attacked a battle this turn (War Historian).

attacked_last_own_turn.description: Attacked during its controller's most recent turn (the turn one full round ago; checked before it attacks again this turn).

attacked_or_blocked_since_upkeep.description: The creature attacked or blocked since the source controller's last upkeep (this turn's upkeep counts as the last one outside their own turn): Shape of the Wiitigo.

attacked_this_turn.description: Was declared as an attacker this turn (also after combat ended).

attacked_you_this_turn.description: Attacked the source's controller (or a planeswalker/battle they control) this turn, even if it is no longer attacking (Jabari's Influence).

attacking_battle.description: Currently attacking a battle (War-Trained Slasher, Thrashing Frontliner, Rampaging Geoderm).

attacking_chosen_player.description: Attacking the player the source's controller last chose (or a planeswalker/battle they control): Beckoning Will-o'-Wisp.

attacking_enchanted_player.description: Attacking the player the source Aura enchants (Curse of Hospitality: "creatures attacking enchanted player").

attacking_opponent_player.description: Attacking one of the source controller's opponents themself, not a planeswalker or battle (Oviya, Automech Artisan).

attacking_player.description: An attacker whose defending player is one of the selected players (Echoing Assault, Ordruun Mentor: "attacking that player"); a planeswalker/battle counts as its controller.

attacking_player_direct.description: With `attacking_player`: only creatures attacking a player themself, not a planeswalker or battle they control (Landroval, Horizon Witness).

attacking_same_as.description: An attacker attacking the same player or planeswalker/battle as one of the selected attackers (Kitesail Skirmisher, Jin Sakai).

attacking_you.description: Attacking the source's controller or a planeswalker/battle they control (not another player).

attacking_you_player.description: Attacking the source's controller themself (not their planeswalkers/battles): Arachnogenesis.

aura_could_enchant_source.description: An Aura card (any zone) that could enchant the filter's source permanent: it has an enchant restriction the source meets (Bruna, Light of Alabaster).

banded_with_attacking_source.description: The source is attacking and this is the source itself or a creature attacking in the same band as it (Camel: "this creature and creatures banded with this creature").

banded_with_source.description: Is an attacking creature in the same band as the source (not the source itself): Icatian Skirmishers.

base_power.description: The card's PRINTED power / toughness (before counters and effects) compared: "creatures with base power and toughness 1/1".

beamable.description: Can be returned to hand to pay a "beam me up" cost: not under a "can't be beamed up" effect (Marooned, Scotty).

blocked_attacker.description: Attacking creatures that have been blocked.

blocked_by_attached.description: Is blocked by the creature this Equipment / Aura is attached to (Godsend).

blocked_by_matching.description: Is an attacking creature currently blocked by a creature matching this filter (Sting, the Glinting Dagger).

blocked_by_source.description: Is blocked by the source creature (an attacker blocked by this blocker).

blocked_by_stored.description: Is blocked by a creature held in this stored slot.

blocked_pair_stored.description: Blocked or was blocked by a creature held in this stored slot this turn (per-card `block_pairs`).

blocked_pair_this_turn.description: Blocked or was blocked by a creature matching this filter this turn.

blocking_attached.description: Is blocking the creature this Equipment / Aura is attached to ("one of those creatures" for the equipped creature: Godsend).

blocking_matching.description: Is currently blocking an attacking creature that matches this filter (Sting, the Glinting Dagger).

blocking_source.description: Is blocking the source creature ("creatures blocking this creature").

blocking_stored.description: Is blocking a creature held in this stored slot ("creatures blocking that creature"; fill the slot with StoreRemembered).

can_be_enchanted_by_source.description: The permanent has no protection from the source (so the source Aura could legally enchant it): "a creature at random this Aura can enchant".

can_enchant.description: An Aura card whose "enchant ..." restriction (`Ability::Attach`) lets it legally enchant at least one of the selected permanents (Academy Researchers, Danitha, Aura Graft).

cast_by_non_owner.description: The card is a spell on the stack that its caster does not own ("a spell they don't own": Gonti, Night Minister).

cast_for_warp.description: It was cast for its warp cost (Full Bore: "if that creature was cast for its warp cost").

cast_from.description: The card is (or, as a spell being cast, was cast from) this zone / is not in this zone ("spells you cast from your graveyard", "spells cast from anywhere other than your hand").

chosen_color.description: Is the colour the source chose as it entered.

chosen_name.description: The card's name is the name chosen on the source ("spells with the chosen name").

chosen_type.description: Has the creature type the source chose as it entered ("creatures of the chosen type").

chosen_type_any.description: Has any of the creature types chosen with `ChooseCreatureType { accumulate: true }` on this source (this resolution).

color_count.description: Exactly this many colors (Meeting of the Five: exactly three).

color_count_vs.description: Number of colors compared with a computed amount (Evolving Door: exactly the stored count plus one).

combat_alone.description: It is attacking alone (the only attacking creature) or blocking alone (the only blocking creature); still true while it dies in combat (Thijarian Witness).

commander.description: The card is a commander (use `owner` for "your commander"; a commander creature is `types:[Creature]` + this).

controlled_by.description: The permanent's controller is one of these players (`{"type":"DefendingPlayer"}`, `{"type":"TriggerPlayer"}`, a targeted player ...): "target creature defending player controls", "creature controlled by the damaged player".

controlled_by_chosen_player.description: Controlled by the player this source chose (`ChoosePlayer`): "target creature that player controls".

controlled_since_turn_start.description: Controlled continuously since the beginning of this turn (Keldon Twilight, Siren's Call, Nettling Imp).

controller_chose.description: The permanent's controller picked this word ("War" / "Peace") in the source's per-player as-enters choice (`ChooseKind::WarPeace`).

controller_controls.description: The permanent's controller controls a permanent matching this filter ("a creature whose controller controls a snow Swamp": snow swampwalk as a `CantBeBlockedBy`).

controller_hit_by.description: The permanent's controller was dealt combat damage this turn by at least that many different creatures matching the inner filter (Admiral Beckett Brass).

controller_lands_max.description: The permanent's controller controls at most this many lands ("as long as that player controls three or fewer lands": Sheltering Prayers).

could_produce_colorless.description: Could produce {C} through any mana ability (Break the Ice).

could_produce_mana_of.description: Could produce at least one type of mana (W U B R G C) that any of the selected permanents could produce, over all their mana abilities (Mana Web: `{"type":"TriggerObject"}`).

couldnt_attack.description: Some(true): the creature couldn't attack this turn (not its controller's turn, or no legal attack right now: summoning sick, defender, can't-attack effects). Some(false): it could (Season of the Witch).

counter_min.description: With `has_counter`: at least this many counters of that kind ("three or more +1/+1 counters"; default 1).

counter_put_by_you.description: You (the source's controller) put a counter of this kind on it this turn (Kid Loki).

counter_put_by_you_this_turn.description: The source's controller put a counter on this permanent this turn (La Forge, Thoughtful as Ever).

created_by_source.description: The token was created by the source ("tokens created with this enchantment", Dual Nature; made by `CopyPermanent`). Still matches after the source left the battlefield.

created_by_this.description: A token created by an effect of this ability's source (while it is the same object): "tokens created with this creature" (Tetravus).

crewed_source_this_turn.description: Tapped to pay a Crew / Saddle cost of the source this turn ("target creature that crewed it this turn").

damaged_by.description: The creature was dealt damage this turn by one of the selected cards (Touch of Moonglove: `{"type":"Target","idx":0}` of the spell that created the temporary trigger).

damaged_by_attached.description: Was dealt damage this turn by the permanent the source is attached to ("a creature dealt damage by enchanted creature this turn").

damaged_by_source.description: Was dealt damage this turn by the source of the ability ("a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn dies"). Also works for a dying creature.

damaged_by_source_ever.description: The permanent was ever dealt damage by the source this game (The Fallen's planeswalkers).

damaged_by_your_matching.description: Was dealt damage this turn by a source the ability's controller controlled that matches this filter ("dealt damage this turn by a Spider you controlled": Shelob, Child of Ungoliant). Also works for a dying creature.

damaged_by_your_source.description: Was dealt damage this turn by any source the ability's controller controlled ("a creature dealt damage this turn by a source you controlled": Etching of Kumano). Also works for a dying creature.

dealt_combat_damage_this_turn.description: Dealt combat damage this turn (to any player or creature).

dealt_combat_damage_to_player_this_comba.description: Dealt combat damage to a player during the current combat phase ("this combat": Glen Elendra; differs from "this turn" with extra combats).

dealt_combat_damage_to_player_this_turn.description: Dealt combat damage to a player this turn (Glen Elendra).

dealt_combat_damage_to_you_this_turn.description: Dealt combat damage to the source's controller this turn.

dealt_damage_this_turn.description: Dealt any damage this turn (combat or not, to anything): "a creature that dealt damage this turn".

dealt_damage_to_opponent_this_turn.description: Dealt damage this turn to a player who is an opponent of the source's controller now (Whirling Dervish: control changes matter).

dealt_damage_to_source.description: Dealt damage this turn to the source of the ability ("each creature that dealt damage to this creature this turn": Giant Albatross; works when the source has died).

dealt_damage_to_you_this_turn.description: Dealt damage to the source's controller this turn ("a creature that dealt damage to you this turn").

defended_by.description: The permanent's defender side (a battle's protector, else its controller) is one of these players: "planeswalker that player controls or battle that player protects" (Rampaging Raptor).

discarded_this_turn.description: A card discarded this turn (also matches cycled cards).

double_faced.description: `true`: a double-faced card (transforming or modal, it has another face); `false`: a single-faced card.

drawn_this_turn.description: A card in its owner's hand that was drawn this turn and hasn't left the hand since (Sylvan Library).

enchantable_by.description: A permanent that at least one of the selected Auras could legally enchant ("attach it to another permanent it can enchant": Aura Graft, Simic Guildmage).

enchanted.description: Has an Aura (or other enchantment) attached.

enchanting_you.description: An Aura / Curse attached to the source's controller ("a Curse attached to you": Lynde, Cheerful Tormentor).

enchants_creature.description: An Aura card whose restriction is plain "enchant creature" (Attach to exactly Creature, no other conditions): Tallowisp.

enlisted_this_turn.description: Enlisted a creature this turn (Aradesh, the Founder).

entered_from.description: Entered the battlefield from this zone ("entered from a graveyard").

entered_since_your_last_turn_ended.description: Entered the battlefield since the end of its source controller's previous turn (Premature Burial).

equip_ability.description: In a restricted-mana `ability` filter: only when paying to activate an equip ability ("spend this mana only to activate equip abilities").

except.description: Not one of the selected objects ("other than that creature": `TriggerObject`); judged when targets are chosen too.

exiled_this_turn.description: The card was put into exile this turn (Maralen, Fae Ascendant).

exiled_with_this.description: The card is in exile and was exiled by this ability's source ("exiled with this"): for Choose / Count / CantCast filters.

face_down.description: Face-down (`true`) / face-up (`false`) permanents or spells (morph, disguise, manifest, cloak).

fading.description: A permanent with fading (it has the fade-counter entry ability of a fading card): Parallax Inhibitor.

first_by_caster_this_turn.description: This spell is the first spell cast this turn by its caster that matches the rest of this filter ("their first multicolored spell each turn").

foretell_ability.description: In a restricted-mana `ability` filter: only when paying to foretell a card from hand (a special action: Karfell Harbinger).

foretold.description: This card is in exile and foretold (Alrund, God of the Cosmos: "each foretold card you own in exile").

goaded.description: `true`: a goaded creature (one-shot or continuous goad); `false`: not goaded.

granted_offspring.description: The permanent was cast with an offspring cost granted by `StaticEffect::GrantOffspring` paid (Zinnia, Valley's Voice).

graveyard_top.description: A card in a graveyard that is the topmost (most recently put there) among the cards of that graveyard matching the rest of this filter (Necratog: "the top creature card of your graveyard").

graveyard_top_card.description: The card is the very top card of its owner's graveyard, whatever it is (Bösium Strip; unlike `graveyard_top`, which looks at the top matching card).

had_to_attack.description: The creature attacked this turn because it was required to (goaded or otherwise forced; Firkraag, Cunning Instigator).

has_ability.description: Currently has this exact ability, printed or granted (Musician: "if it doesn't have that ability, it gains it", with `Not`).

has_activated_ability.description: Has at least one activated ability (printed or granted; mana and loyalty abilities count): craft with "nonlands with activated abilities" (The Enigma Jewel).

has_adventure.description: `true`: the card has an Adventure half (printed); `false`: it has none.

has_any_counter.description: Has at least one counter of any kind.

has_attached.description: Has a permanent matching this filter attached (relative to the source: "enchanted by an Aura you control" = `{subtypes:[Aura], controller:You}`, "another Aura attached" = `{subtypes:[Aura], other:true}`).

has_counter.description: Has a counter of this kind.

has_disguise.description: `true`: the card has a disguise ability printed (a morph that is not a plain morph); `false`: it has none (Expose the Culprit).

has_keyword_word.description: The card's rules text has a keyword line starting with this word ("flashback", "devoid", "freerunning", "cycling", "equip"; case-insensitive; also in a comma list): for keywords that are not in the Keyword enum.

has_mana_ability.description: Has a mana ability (an activated, non-loyalty, targetless ability that adds mana): Magewright's Stone, Moonsilver Key, Power Sink.

has_morph.description: `true`: the card has a morph (or megamorph / disguise) ability in its printed text; `false`: it has none.

has_nonmana_activated.description: Has an activated ability that is not a mana ability (Ravager Wurm, Tazri).

has_phyrexian_mana.description: The card's mana cost contains a Phyrexian mana symbol ({H}: Rage Extractor).

has_protection.description: The permanent currently has at least one protection quality (printed or granted): Concerted Effort.

has_tap_ability.description: Has an activated ability whose cost includes {T} ("artifact with a {T} ability": Magewright's Stone).

haunted_by_this.description: The card is haunted by the source (haunt: "when the creature it haunts dies" - use with `Dies` in a trigger with `from: Exile`).

in_chosen_sector.description: A creature in the sector the source chose (`ChooseCreatureType` with `only` Alpha / Beta / Gamma stores it on the source; Space Beleren).

in_zone.description: The card is currently in this zone (Ashes of the Abhorrent: `CantActivate` / `CantCastCards` limited to graveyard cards).

is_spell.description: The card is a spell on the stack, or one being cast from hand (not a permanent or an ability): "protection from spells that are one or more colors".

kicked.description: `true`: a spell that was kicked (any kicker paid); `false`: not kicked.

lacks_keyword_word.description: The card's rules text has no keyword line starting with this word (the opposite of `has_keyword_word`: Bohn, Beguiling Balladeer "without foretell").

last_drawn.description: The card is the last card its owner drew this turn and is still in their hand (Jandor's Ring).

last_exiled_with_this.description: The card most recently exiled with the source ("the last card exiled with this artifact": Ice Cauldron).

least_toughness.description: No creature on the battlefield has lower toughness (Purging Scythe: "the creature with the least toughness"; ties all match).

legal_target_of.description: The card is another legal target of the selected spell on the stack (Beamsplitter Mage: "another creature that spell could target"); its current targets are excluded.

linked_with_this.description: The card is the permanent this source linked itself to with `Effect::LinkRemembered` (on the battlefield, or just left it: "the creature put onto the battlefield with this").

loyalty_activated_this_turn.description: A planeswalker that had a loyalty ability activated this turn (Cut Short).

mana_value_chosen_parity.description: Mana value has the parity chosen by the source's `ChooseKind::OddEven` (zero is even).

mana_value_even.description: Mana value parity: true = even (zero is even), false = odd.

mana_value_not_chosen_number.description: Mana value differs from the source's chosen number (`ChooseKind::RandomTwoToFour`: "protection from each mana value other than the chosen number").

mana_value_vs.description: Mana value compared with a computed amount (`X`, a creature's power, life gained ...), evaluated for the ability's source.

milled_this_turn.description: A card that was milled (by an instruction using "mill") this turn and is still in the graveyard it went to (Tato Farmer).

modal_spell.description: A modal spell: a card with a "choose one / two / ..." spell ability (Riku of Many Paths: "whenever you cast a modal spell").

modified.description: "Modified": the creature has a counter on it, is equipped, or is enchanted by an Aura its controller controls.

multi_type.description: The card has two or more card types (Rendmaw, Creaking Nest).

mv_le_controller_graveyard.description: Mana value no greater than the number of cards in the graveyard of this object's own controller (Drown in the Loch: per candidate, not per ability).

mv_odd.description: Mana value is odd / even (Soundwave, Superior Captain: "a spell with an odd mana value"; 0 is even).

name_not_curse_on_enchanted.description: Doesn't share a name with a Curse attached to the source's enchanted player (Curse of Misfortunes: `SearchLibrary`).

no_abilities.description: `true`: the object has no abilities (no printed abilities or keywords, or it lost them); `false`: it has some.

no_counters.description: Has no counters of any kind.

no_land_type_shared_with_yours.description: The card shares no land type with any land its searcher / `src_controller` controls (Hiveheart Shaman).

no_mana_ability.description: Has NO mana ability ("artifacts without mana abilities": Midnight Arsonist).

no_permanent_same_name.description: No permanent matching this filter (evaluated from the source controller's view, e.g. `{"token":true,"controller":"You"}`) has the same name as this one ("doesn't have the same name as a token you control": The Apprentice's Folly).

not_among_remembered.description: Only cards NOT in the current Remembered set ("each nonland permanent that wasn't chosen"; combine with `zone` filters in `All`).

not_among_stored.description: Is NOT one of the cards saved in this stored slot.

not_attached_by_source.description: Is NOT the permanent the source is attached to ("other than enchanted creature": Sporogenic Infection, Due Diligence).

not_attacked_this_turn.description: Was NOT declared as an attacker this turn.

not_attacking_you.description: An attacking creature that is attacking someone other than the source's controller and their planeswalkers/battles ("attacks a player other than you").

not_chosen_color.description: Isn't the colour the source chose.

not_chosen_type.description: Doesn't have the creature type the source chose ("creatures not of the chosen type").

not_chosen_type_any.description: Has none of the creature types chosen with `ChooseCreatureType { accumulate: true }` on this source (Harsh Mercy).

not_color_count.description: Not exactly this many colors (Invasion of Ravnica: "isn't exactly two colors").

not_commander.description: The card is NOT a commander.

not_controlled_by.description: Controlled by a player NOT among the selected players.

not_enchanted.description: Has no Aura (or other enchantment) attached (Winds of Rath, Time Elemental).

not_has_counter.description: Has no counter of this kind.

not_linked_with_this.description: The card is NOT a permanent this source linked itself to with `LinkRemembered` (Fight or Flight: "only creatures in the chosen pile can attack").

not_only_controllers_chosen_color.description: Is NOT (exactly one colour and that colour is the colour its controller chose with `ChooseColor.per_player` on the source): Selective Obliteration's "unless it's only the color its controller chose".

not_played.description: Entered the battlefield without being played (a land that was put onto the battlefield by an effect: Deep Gnome Terramancer).

not_printed_subtypes.description: None of these subtypes is PRINTED on the card (layer-independent: Bludgeon Brawl's "non-Equipment artifact" must keep matching after the Equipment type is added).

not_printed_types.description: None of these card types is PRINTED on the card (layer-independent: "each noncreature artifact is an artifact creature with P/T equal to its mana value" must keep matching after the type change).

not_put_by_this.description: Not being moved right now by an effect of this source ("if it wasn't put onto the battlefield with this ability": Kodama of the East Tree; read while the zone-change event is handled).

not_put_in_graveyard_this_combat.description: A card that was NOT put into a graveyard during this combat phase (Storrev: "that wasn't put there this combat").

not_same_name_as.description: Does NOT have the same name as any of the selected cards ("a creature with a different name": Yenna).

not_shares_type_with.description: Shares NO creature type with any of the selected cards (Radagast the Brown).

not_summoning_sick.description: The creature could use {T} abilities (it is not summoning sick): enlist.

not_targeted_by_same_name_ability.description: A spell that is not the target of an ability from another source with the same name as the filter's source (Goblin Artisans).

not_trigger_object.description: Not the object of the trigger event being targeted for ("return up to one OTHER target creature card" from a dies trigger: Illicit Masquerade).

nth_spell_this_turn.description: This spell was the nth spell cast this turn by any player (1-based): "the second spell cast this turn" (Second Guess).

only.description: Must be one of the selected objects ("attached to that creature": `attached_host: {only: Target 0}`); judged when targets are chosen too.

only_controllers_chosen_color.description: Is exactly one colour and it is the colour its controller chose with `ChooseColor.per_player` on the source (Selective Obliteration).

owned_by.description: The card's owner is one of these players (`{"type":"EachObject"}` inside `ForEachPlayer`: "all permanents they own", The Great Aurora).

owner.description: Owned by a player matching this (relative to the source's controller): "you own", "an opponent owns".

paid_with_mana_from_source.description: A spell cast using mana produced by the source permanent ("a permanent spell using mana produced by this land").

paired.description: Soulbond: `true` = paired with a creature, `false` = unpaired.

paired_with_this.description: Soulbond: this creature if it is paired, and the creature paired with the source ("each of those creatures").

payable_by_activation_mana.description: The card's mana cost could be paid by some amount of (or all of) the mana spent to activate the source's most recent activated ability (Illusionary Mask).

played_via_this.description: A card the source's `GrantPlayFromExile` permission lets the controller play, matched while it is being cast or played from exile: "when you play a card this way" (Fires of Mount Doom).

power_even.description: Power parity: true = even (zero is even), false = odd (Zimone's Hypothesis).

power_gt_base.description: The creature's current power is greater than its base (printed) power (Baird, Kutzil).

power_ne_base.description: The creature's current (or last-known) power differs from its base (printed) power (Jason Bright).

power_up_ability.description: In a restricted-mana `ability` filter: only when paying to activate a power-up ability (`Activated.power_up`; Quinjet Technician).
