power_vs.description: Power / toughness compared with a computed amount (X, another creature's power, cards in hand ...).

prepared_spell.description: A prepare spell copy cast from exile (Codie, Ravenous Codex: "a prepared spell"); `Card.cast_prepared`.

printed_subtypes.description: At least one of these subtypes is PRINTED on the card ("if it's a Samurai card": Oathkeeper still returns a Samurai that Lignify made a Treefolk).

printed_types.description: At least one of these card types is PRINTED on the card (looks through face-down: Hauntwoods Shrieker's "if it's a creature card").

protection_any_color.description: The permanent currently has protection from every colour (from each of the five colours, from monocolored and multicolored sources, or from everything): Escaped Shapeshifter.

pt_unequal.description: Power and toughness are not equal (Gilt-Leaf Winnower).

put_in_graveyard_from_battlefield_this_t.description: ... and it came from the battlefield.

put_in_graveyard_from_library_this_turn.description: A card that was put into a graveyard from a library this turn (milled; "cards milled this turn").

put_in_graveyard_not_from_battlefield_th.description: ... and it came from somewhere OTHER than the battlefield (hand, library, stack).

put_in_graveyard_this_turn.description: A card that was put into a graveyard this turn (and may since have left it).

renowned.description: A renowned creature (Enshrouding Mist: "if it's renowned").

ring_bearer.description: The permanent is its controller's Ring-bearer.

sacrificable.description: Can be sacrificed: not under a "can't be sacrificed" effect (set on sacrifice-cost filters by `sac_cost_filter`).

same_name_as.description: Has the same name as the selected card(s) ("search for cards with the same name as that creature": `{"type":"Target","idx":0}`).

same_name_as_cast_spell.description: This card has the same name as a spell that was cast this turn (Twinning Glass).

same_name_as_nontoken_permanent.description: This card has the same name as a nontoken permanent on the battlefield (Cornered Market: "spells with the same name as a nontoken permanent"; the card itself does not count).

shares_card_type_with.description: Shares at least one CARD type (artifact, creature, instant ...) with any of the selected cards ("a card that shares a card type with that spell": `{"type":"TriggerObject"}`).

shares_color_last_spell.description: Shares at least one color with the spell most recently cast this turn (Mana Maze); colorless or no spell cast yet: no match.

shares_color_with.description: Shares at least one color with any of the selected cards ("a creature that shares a color with it": Ringsight, Rassilon conspire).

shares_color_with_activation_mana.description: The permanent shares a color with the mana spent to activate the source's most recent activated ability (Protective Sphere).

shares_type_with.description: Shares at least one creature type with any of the selected cards ("a creature card that shares a creature type with this creature": `{"type":"This"}`, kinship).

shares_type_with_each.description: With `shares_type_with`: the card must share a creature type with EACH of the selected cards, not just any one (Cryptic Gateway).

single_permanent_or_player_target.description: A spell or ability (`TargetKind::StackObject`) whose only target is a single permanent or player (Radiant Performer).

single_target.description: A spell with exactly one target (Deflection, Swerve, Ricochet Trap: "target spell with a single target").

skip_first_same_name_as.description: With `exiled_with_this`: leaves out the first (oldest) card exiled with the source that has the same name as the selected card, but not later ones with that name (Spellweaver Helix: "copy the other one").

spell_has_targets.description: A spell on the stack that has at least one target ("a spell with one or more targets": Wyll's Reversal).

spell_targets.description: A spell on the stack with a target (a permanent/card) matching this filter ("a spell that targets a permanent you control", "targets a commander you control").

spell_targets_enchanted_player.description: A spell on the stack that targets the player the source Aura enchants (Infectious Curse: "spells you cast that target enchanted player").

spell_targets_only_players.description: A spell on the stack that has targets and targets only players (Rebound).

spell_targets_opponent.description: A spell on the stack that targets an opponent of the source's controller (player target; Danitha, Spear of Agony).

spell_targets_permanent_or_player.description: A spell on the stack with at least one target that is a player or a permanent on the battlefield ("if that spell targets a permanent or player": Shiko and Narset, Unified).

spell_targets_single_opp_object.description: A spell on the stack whose only target is a single opponent of the source's controller or a single permanent an opponent of the source's controller controls (Zevlor, Elturel Exile).

spell_targets_stack.description: A spell that targets a spell or ability on the stack that itself targets a permanent matching this filter (Not of This World: "targets a spell or ability that targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater").

spell_targets_you.description: A spell on the stack that targets the source's controller ("target spell that targets you": Mirror Sheen).

spell_would_destroy_your_land.description: A spell on the stack that would destroy a land the source's controller controls if it resolved now: a `Destroy` among its effects aimed at such a land (by target or by an "all" filter) (Equinox).

surveilled_this_turn.description: A card that was put into a graveyard by surveilling this turn and has stayed there (Eye of Duskmantle).

tapped_for_source_cost_this_turn.description: Tapped this turn to pay a "tap an untapped X you control" cost of the source's abilities.

targeted_by.description: The card is one of the current targets of the selected spell on the stack (Orvar: "one of those permanents"; use `TriggerObject`).

top_of_graveyard.description: A card in a graveyard that is one of the topmost N cards (most recently put there) of its owner's graveyard that match the rest of this filter ("exile the top card of your graveyard": 1; Spinning Darkness: black cards, 3).

total_pt_max.description: Power plus toughness is at most this (Cut Down: "total power and toughness 5 or less").

total_pt_vs.description: Power plus toughness compared with a computed amount (Wild Pair: the same total as the entered creature).

toughness_gt_power.description: The creature's own toughness is greater than its own power (Bedrock Tortoise, Immobilizer Eldrazi).

transformed.description: A permanent whose back face is up because it transformed (not a modal / adventure face): Mutagen Connoisseur.

turned_face_up_this_turn.description: Was turned face up this turn.

types.description: Any of these types (empty = any type).

unblocked.description: An attacking creature that no creature has blocked (Ninjutsu).

was_blocked_this_turn.description: Was blocked this turn (an attacker that a creature blocked).

was_cast.description: true = the permanent / spell was cast; false = it was not cast (put onto the battlefield or onto the stack by an effect, a copy).

was_dealt_damage_this_turn.description: Was dealt damage this turn by any source (even if it has healed or regenerated since).

was_dealt_excess_damage_this_turn.description: Was dealt excess damage (more than lethal) this turn.

was_dealt_noncombat_damage_this_turn.description: Was dealt noncombat damage this turn (Grisly Sigil).

HitByCount.description: "A player who was dealt combat damage this turn by `at_least` or more different creatures matching `filter`" (Admiral Beckett Brass: three Pirates).

Keyword.description: Keywords with no parameters (a bit each in `KeywordSet`).

oneOf.description: Assist: another player may pay up to the generic part of this spell's cost.
"Bands with other legendary creatures": legendary creatures may attack in a band as long as one of them has this (Seafarer's Quay).
"Bands with other creatures named <its own name>": creatures with the same name may attack in a band as long as one has this (Master of the Hunt's Wolves of the Hunt).
A creature fights (emitted for each fighter; `Trigger::KeywordActionDone` with this action).
Adventure: the back face is the adventure spell; when it resolves the card is exiled and may later be cast as its front face.
Omen: the back face is a sorcery/instant "omen spell"; when it resolves (not countered, not fizzled) its card is shuffled into its owner's library instead of going to the graveyard.

Prepare: the back face is a sorcery/instant "prepare spell". It can't be cast from hand; while the creature is prepared (`Effect::BecomePrepared`) a copy of the spell waits in exile and may be cast, which unprepares the creature.

Room: a two-door enchantment. The front's abilities belong to door 1, the back's (in `back.abilities`) to door 2; cast either half (that door unlocks), and unlock the other for its mana cost as a sorcery. Abilities only work while their door is unlocked.

`n` mana that can only be spent to cast spells matching the filter ("Spend this mana only to cast creature spells"). It is only counted when paying for such a spell. `spell` limits it to spells matching the filter; `ability` (a filter on the SOURCE of the ability) also lets it pay to activate abilities of matching sources ("spend this mana only to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creature sources"). Give only `ability` for "only to activate abilities" (empty filter = any source).

amount.description: A computed amount instead of the fixed `n` ("add X mana, spend it only on ...").

chosen.description: The mana is of the colour this permanent chose as it entered instead of `m` (Throne of Eldraine).

cost_c.description: "... or pay a cost that contains {C}": the mana also pays any cost with a {C} symbol.

no_generic.description: "This mana can't be spent to pay generic mana costs" (Jegantha, the Wellspring).

rider.description: What happens to the spell this mana is spent on.

unlock.description: "... or unlock doors": the mana also pays the mana cost of unlocking a door of a Room (Smoky Lounge).

upkeep.description: "Spend this mana only to pay cumulative upkeep costs" (Snowfall); give no `spell`/`ability`.

oneOf.description: `n` unrestricted mana of type `m`; when it is spent on a spell matching `spell` (any spell if absent) that spell gets the rider ("Add {R}. If that mana is spent on a Dragon creature spell, it gains haste"). Only mana tapped while paying carries the rider.

`n` mana of any colour that can only be spent as `Restricted` mana can (`spell` / `ability` filters). Each mana is a separate colour choice ("add two mana in any combination of colors, spend only on creature spells"); with `one_color` all `n` share one chosen colour.

amount.description: When set, the number of mana is this amount instead of `n` (Klauth, Metamorphosis, Crucible of the Spirit Dragon; effects only).

other_color.description: The colour chosen must differ from the one chosen for the previous `RestrictedAny` group of the same `AddMana` (Open the Omenpaths: "two mana of any one color and two mana of any other color").

oneOf.description: One mana of any of this permanent's own colours (none if it is colourless), spent only to activate abilities of sources matching `ability` (Tazri, Stalwart Survivor).
One mana of any color.
`n` mana of any one color, with a rider when it is spent on a spell matching `spell` (Primal Wellspring: "when that mana is spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell").
One mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce (Exotic Orchard).
One mana of a type the permanent sacrificed to pay this ability's cost could produce (Squandered Resources).
One mana of a type the permanent untapped to pay this ability's cost could produce (Benthic Explorers).
`n` mana of one chosen color (Gilded Lotus: three of any one color).
A computed amount of one fixed type (Empowered Autogenerator: X mana where X = charge counters; Temple: two when ...).
X mana of any one color, X computed.
`amount` mana, each of which may be a different color ("add X mana in any combination of colors", "... of {G} and/or {W}": `colors` limits the choice, empty = any color).

colors_of.description: Instead of `colors`: the choice is limited to the colors of the first selected card ("in any combination of its colors": Omnath, Locus of All).

oneOf.description: One mana of a color a permanent you control could produce (Fellwar Stone...).
One mana of a color that a permanent you control matching `filter` could produce (Gond Gate: Gates).

colorless.description: "any type" (Reflecting Pool, Naga Vitalist): colorless counts too.

n.description: How many mana of the chosen type (Incubation Druid: 3).

oneOf.description: One mana of a color among the permanents you control matching `filter` (Mox Amber: legendary creatures and planeswalkers); no mana if there are none.

zone.description: Look at cards in this zone of yours instead of the battlefield (The Grey Havens: legendary creature cards in your graveyard).

oneOf.description: One mana of a color of a card exiled with this permanent (Chrome Mox's imprint); no mana if there is none.

One additional mana of a type the land that was just tapped for mana produced (Mana Flare, Heartbeat of Spring, Dictate of Karametra): used by a `TapsForMana` trigger. With several produced types the first is used.
One mana of a color from this card's color identity (Commander's Sphere).
One mana of a color from your commander's color identity, with a rider when spent on a spell matching `spell` (Study Hall, Path of Ancestry).

Mana equal to the mana cost of the first selected permanent: one mana of each coloured symbol's colour, colourless for generic and {C} symbols, nothing for {X}; a hybrid symbol lets the controller choose one of its colours (Elemental Resonance).
One mana of each coloured symbol in the mana cost of the card this ability's `Cost::Mill` just milled (hybrid symbols: one of either colour; generic, {C}, {X} and snow give nothing; Charmed Pendant).
One mana of the type last noted by `Effect::NoteManaSpent` on this permanent; no mana if none was noted.
The type and amount of mana last noted by `Effect::NoteManaSpentAll` on this permanent, spendable only on spells matching `spell` (Ice Cauldron: `last_exiled_with_this`).
`n` mana of the colour this permanent chose as it entered.
`n` mana of the second colour this permanent chose as it entered (`ChooseKind::SecondColor`; Cryptic Spires: one ability per circled colour).
Choose a color as the ability is activated; add mana of it equal to the controller's devotion to that color (Nyx Lotus).
A computed amount of mana of the colour this permanent chose as it entered (Nyx Lotus: devotion to the chosen colour).

ManaRider.description: What happens to a spell that mana with a rider is spent on ("that spell can't be countered", "it gains haste", "it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter").

oneOf.description: The permanent spell gains haste until end of turn.
The permanent spell gains haste for as long as it stays on the battlefield (Hall of the Bandit Lord: no duration is stated).
The permanent spell enters with an additional +1/+1 counter (once per mana spent).
The permanent spell enters with an additional +1/+1 counter (once per mana spent) and gains hexproof until its caster's next turn (Jade Orb of Dragonkind).
The commander spell enters with additional +1/+1 counters equal to the number of times it has been cast from the command zone this game, this cast included (Opal Palace).
"When that mana is spent to cast ..., scry N": the caster scries (a trigger above the spell on the stack).
"... draw a card" (N cards).
"... copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy."
"... scry X, where X is the number of times you've cast your commander from the command zone" (Study Hall).
"... you gain N life" (Scaled Nurturer).
"... you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves" (Forger's Foundry): the card is exiled with the permanent that made the mana.
"... it gains riot" (Domri, Chaos Bringer): a creature spell enters with its controller's choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.

ManaSourceKind.description: A kind of mana source for `Amount::ManaSpentFromSource`.

oneOf.description: A creature tapped for mana (Inga and Esika: "three or more mana from creatures").

Mark.description: A value a permanent's own abilities keep about it (`Effect::SetMark`): what a Licid's ability is doing, what a card has used or counted. Unlike counters, other effects can't see or change it.

oneOf.description: A Licid is an Aura through its own ability.
A card's first private value.
A card's second private value.

cost.description: Spree: an additional cost paid when this mode is chosen.

paw.description: Pawprints of this mode when the `ChooseModes` has a `budget` ("Choose up to five {P} worth of modes").

oneOf.description: Not a basic land name.
A noncreature, nonland card name (Council of the Absolute).
A land card name (Petrified Hamlet).

PlayWindow.description: How long a play-from-exile permission lasts.

oneOf.description: Until the end of this turn.
Until the end of the controller's next turn.
Until the beginning of the controller's next upkeep (through the turn before their next turn).
Until the beginning of the controller's next end step (this turn's if it has not begun yet): Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest.
Until the beginning of the next end step of the player who gets the permission (`by`), not the effect's controller (Casey & Raph, Hotheads).
Until the end of combat on the controller's next turn (Brazen Cannonade).
For as long as it stays in exile.
For as long as the effect's controller still controls the source permanent ("you may play it for as long as you control this creature": Gwen Stacy, Intet, Taster of Wares).
Until the source exiles another card (with this same ability): granting it to new cards revokes the permission this source gave earlier (Unstable Amulet).
You or a teammate (Archenemy: the archenemy's opponents are one team; otherwise only you; Valor's Reach).
The player this card enchants (Curses).
The owner of the source card ("at the beginning of that player's next declare attackers step" after exiling the source: Noctis, Heir Apparent).
An opponent of the controller who controls a creature attacking the enchanted player or a planeswalker/battle they control (Curse of Verbosity).
A player with the most life, or tied for the most (among all players).
A player with the least life, or tied for the least.
An opponent of the controller with at least two fewer creature cards in their graveyard than the controller (Keeper of the Dead).
The active player ("target opponent whose turn it is").
A player controlling the most lands, or tied for the most (Tectonic Hellion).
A player controlling the fewest creatures, or tied (Gor Muldrak).
A player controlling the most creatures, or tied (Wild Mammoth, No Witnesses).
A player controlling the most Wizards, or tied (Thoughtbound Primoc).
A player with the most cards in hand, or tied (Sokenzan Renegade).
A player who attacked this turn (declared at least one attacker).
An opponent who attacked this turn.
An opponent who attacked the controller or a planeswalker the controller controls this turn (Sandswirl Wanderglyph).
An opponent who searched their own library this turn.
An opponent who cast a spell this turn.
A player who cast a spell this turn.

A player who cast a nonartifact spell this turn (Ethersworn Canonist).
A player who cast a non-Phyrexian spell this turn (Phyrexian Censor).
An opponent with the most life, or tied, among the opponents (Keeper of the Flame).
A player with more life than the controller.
An opponent of the ACTIVE player with more life than them (Oath of Mages: "target player who has more life than they do and is their opponent").
An opponent of the ACTIVE player with more cards in hand than them (Oath of Scholars).
An opponent of the ACTIVE player who controls more lands than them (Oath of Lieges).
An opponent of the ACTIVE player who controls more creatures than them (Oath of Druids).
An opponent of the ACTIVE player whose graveyard has fewer creature cards than theirs (Oath of Ghouls).
A player whose life total is less than half their starting life total (Anya, Merciless Angel).
A player whose graveyard holds seven or more cards (Master's Councillors: "for each graveyard with seven or more cards in it").
Lost life this turn (Rix Maadi Guildmage).
A player who controls more creatures than the controller.
A player who controls more artifacts than the controller (Ward of Bones).
A player who controls more enchantments than the controller (Ward of Bones).
A player who controls more lands than the controller (Ward of Bones).
A player who controls more permanents than each other player, unless they have ignored the source's effect this turn with `Effect::IgnoreSourceEffect` (Damping Engine).
A player with more cards in hand than the controller.
A player with at least two more cards in hand than the controller.
A player who was dealt damage this turn (any source).
A player who was dealt combat damage this turn.
A player who was dealt noncombat damage this turn.
A player who was dealt damage this turn by this source (Wicked Akuba).
A player who was dealt combat damage this turn by this source (Steel Hellkite, Hope of Ghirapur).
A player who was ever dealt damage by this source this game (Diseased Vermin).
An opponent (of the effect's controller) who was ever dealt damage by this source this game (The Fallen: "each opponent ... it has dealt damage to this game").
An opponent who was ever dealt combat damage by a creature with this source's name (Gollum, Obsessed Stalker: "each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named ...").
A player who was ever dealt combat damage by this source this game.
A player who was ever dealt combat damage this game by a creature with the same name as this source (Gollum, Obsessed Stalker).
Any player except the one this Curse / Aura enchants ("any number of target players other than that player").
Any player except the player who caused the trigger ("choose another target player": The Lord of Pain). Judged while targets of a triggered ability are chosen.
Exactly the player who caused the trigger ("target card they own in exile" after combat damage to that player: Time Reaper). Judged while a triggered ability's targets are chosen / it resolves.
Any player except this source's owner ("target player other than this artifact's owner", Crown of Doom).
Any player except the active player (Dosan the Falling Leaf: "players can cast spells only during their own turns").
The player this source is attacking (or the controller of the planeswalker / battle it attacks): "defending player" for an attacking source.

The player the creature this Aura enchants is attacking (or the controller of the planeswalker / battle it attacks): "defending player" for "whenever enchanted creature attacks" (Chorale of the Void).
The controller of the permanent this Aura / Equipment is attached to ("the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller", Soul Tithe, Venarian Gold).
The player this source chose as it entered ("the chosen player's upkeep", Black Vise, Energy Vortex).

The player to the LEFT of the controller ("you"): the next player in turn order who is still in the game. In a creature filter's `controller` it is relative to whoever the filter is judged for, e.g. the chooser of `EachPlayerChooses` ("a creature controlled by the player to their left").
A player whose last named choice for this source's card (`EachPlayerChooses { options, remember: true }`) was the FIRST option (Two Streams Facility: green anchor).
Like `ChoseFirstOption` for the SECOND option (red waterfall).
The player can cast only one more spell this turn (Irencrag Feat): spells already cast don't count.
The player can't cast creature spells.

The player can't cast instant or sorcery spells (Abeyance).
The player can't activate abilities that aren't mana abilities (Abeyance).
The player can't play lands (the land-play special action only).
The player can't become the monarch (Jared Carthalion, True Heir: this turn).

The player may play lands and cast spells from other players' graveyards as though in their own (Shaman's Trance).

Sources that are NOT this color (colorless included): hexproof from nongreen sources (Gaea's Revenge).

Protection from the colour chosen "as this enters" (Pentarch Ward, Iron Maiden-style chosen colours): sources of that colour.
Protection from the creature type / card type chosen "as this enters" (Riders of Gavony, Serra's Emissary): sources of that subtype or card type.
Protection from sources matching a filter (mana value 3 or less, a supertype, an odd/even mana value, ...); the filter is read with the protected permanent as its source.

Sources whose mana value equals the mana value of an artifact the protected permanent's controller controls ("protection from each mana value among artifacts you control": Rebbec, Architect of Ascension).
Protection from everything controlled by one player: `who` selects that player when `GrantProtection` resolves (Eon Frolicker: the targeted opponent); it is then stored as `p`.

Replace.description: Events a replacement effect can modify. `multiply` is applied first, then `add`.

oneOf.description: "If you would gain life, you gain twice that much instead" (multiply 2) / "gain that much +1" (add 1).

instead.description: Do these effects INSTEAD of gaining life (put on the stack after the current effect): `Amount::EventAmount` = the life that would have been gained, `Sel::TriggerPlayer` = the player who would gain it ("draw that many cards instead": Nefarious Lich).

oneOf.description: "If you would learn, you may instead ..." (Retriever Phoenix, from the graveyard): `Effect::Learn` offers these `instead` effects to the controller (source = the replacing card); declining learns normally.

"If a Rigger you control would assemble a Contraption, it assembles two Contraptions instead" (Steamflogger Boss): `Effect::Assemble` by a source matching `filter` (relative to the replacing permanent's controller) assembles `multiply` times as many.
"If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead" (multiply 2).

after_first.description: Only applies when the player has already drawn a card this turn ("can't draw more than one card each turn": `multiply: 0`).

bind_then_target.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: the ability's target slot this index picks is carried to the `instead` effects as their `Sel::Target{idx:0}` (Words of War).

cycling_other_nonland.description: Only applies to a draw caused by the cycling ability of ANOTHER nonland card (Unpredictable Cyclone); with `instead`, `Sel::TriggerObject` is the cycled card.

draw_step_only.description: Only applies to the player's regular draw-step draw ("if you would draw a card during your draw step": Island Sanctuary); with `instead`.

except_first_in_draw_step.description: Leave the first card drawn in each of the player's draw steps alone.

instead.description: Do these effects INSTEAD of drawing (`Sel::TriggerPlayer` = the player who would draw). They run (on the stack) right after the current effect finishes.

min_cards.description: With `instead`: only applies when ONE draw effect asks for at least this many cards (Alms Collector: 2); the whole draw is replaced.

once.description: Used up the first time it applies (only meaningful in `AddReplacement`).

optional.description: With `instead`: the controller may decline (then the player draws normally).

oneOf.description: Tokens created by `who` (Doubling Season, Anointed Procession: multiply 2). With `types` / `subtypes` it only applies to tokens that have one of those card types and all of those subtypes ("artifact tokens", "Food tokens", "creature tokens"). `instead_token` creates that token card instead; `extra_token` creates additional tokens of that card (`extra_per_token`: as many as the tokens being created, else one per event). Cards `who` would mill: n * multiply + add instead (The Water Crystal: add 4; Bruvac: multiply 2). Applied once, never re-triggers itself.
Cards `who` would scry (not surveil): n + add instead when n > 0 (Kenessos, Priest of Thassa: add 1).

draw_instead.description: "If you would scry a number of cards, draw that many cards instead" (Eligeth, Crossroads Augur).

control_instead.description: The tokens are created under the replacement's controller instead (Crafty Cutpurse, with `who: Opponent` and `AddReplacement`).

copy_chosen.description: Esix, Fractal Bloom: the first time each of the controller's turns `who` would create tokens, they may instead choose a creature other than the source and create that many copies of it (`Card.token_repl_turn`).

copy_equipped.description: Mirrormind Crown: the first time each turn `who` would create tokens, they may instead create that many copies of the creature this source is attached to (`Card.token_repl_turn`; asked in `Effect::CreateToken`).

extra_tokens.description: Several additional token cards (Academy Manufactor: "instead create one of each"); each is created like `extra_token`.

instead_choice.description: Jinnie Fay: whenever `who` would create tokens they may instead create that many of ONE of these token cards (the player picks, or declines; asked in `Effect::CreateToken`).

oneOf.description: Counters put on permanents matching `on` that `who` controls (Hardened Scales: add 1, kind +1/+1).

by.description: Only counters put by a player matching this filter (relative to the replacement's controller): Vorinclex "if an opponent would put counters".

halve.description: Half as many, rounded down (applied after `multiply` / `add`).

modular.description: Only counters put by a modular trigger (`Effect::ModularCounters`): Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp.

players.description: Also applies to counters put on players (Winding Constrictor: "...or on you"; Solemnity with `prevent`-style multiply 0): `who` is then the player receiving them.

oneOf.description: Damage dealt by sources matching `source` to `to` (multiply 2 doubles it; prevent stops it entirely).

add_amount.description: Adds this computed amount to the damage ("plus X"); evaluated for the replacement's source and controller.

at_most.description: Only applies to damage of at most / at least this amount ("damage of 3 or less", "7 or more").

between_chosen_players.description: Only damage dealt by a source controlled by one of the source's two chosen players (`chosen_player`, `chosen_player2`) to the other one or a permanent the other controls (Bitter Feud).

bind_chosen_color.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only damage from sources of the colour the source's controller chose (`ChooseColor` earlier in the same effect list), snapshotted when the effect resolves ("sources of the color of your choice").

bind_player.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement` and `to_chosen_player_or_permanents`: the player to bind.

bind_source.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only damage dealt BY the creature this selector picks when the effect resolves (a target).

bind_then_target.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: the spell's target slot this index picks is carried to the `then` effects as their `Sel::Target{idx:0}` ("deals that much damage to any target": Divine Deflection).

bind_to.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only damage dealt TO the permanent this selector picks when the effect resolves ("target creature").

bind_to_player.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only damage dealt TO the player this selector picks (use with `bind_to` for "any target": the permanent or the player).

cause_targets_recipient.description: Only damage caused by a spell or ability that targets the recipient (Silhouette).

combat.description: Some(true): only combat damage; Some(false): only noncombat damage.

condition.description: The replacement only applies while this holds (evaluated for the replacement's source and controller).

divide_by.description: The damage becomes this fraction of itself, rounded down ("halve that damage, rounded down" = 2).

instead.description: The effect replaces the damage without being prevention ("put that many counters on it instead": Phytohydra): it applies even when the damage can't be prevented.

leave_at_least.description: For damage to a player: it can't take the player below this life total (Worship: 1).

once.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: the replacement is used up the first time it applies ("the next time ... this turn").

once_per_batch.description: `then` runs once for all damage dealt to this at the same time (Phantom Centaur: simultaneous blockers remove one counter).

prevent_amount.description: Prevents this computed amount of the damage ("prevent X of that damage"); the rest is dealt.

prevent_fraction.description: Prevents this fraction of the damage, rounded down ("prevent half of that damage, rounded down" = 2); the rest is dealt.

prevent_up_to.description: A shield: prevents (at most) this much damage in total, then is used up ("prevent the next 3 damage").

prevent_up_to_amount.description: `prevent_up_to` computed when `Effect::AddReplacement` resolves ("prevent the next X damage, X = your devotion").

raise_to_amount.description: Damage smaller than this computed amount becomes exactly that amount instead; larger damage is left alone (Ojer Axonil: "less than Ojer's power ... deals damage equal to Ojer's power instead").

redirect_optional.description: With `redirect_to`: the controller MAY have the damage dealt to the new recipient instead (Blood of the Martyr). The damage is held back and a follow-up asks; when declined it is dealt as originally planned (a non-redirecting second pass; damage is no longer simultaneous with the event).

redirect_to.description: The damage is dealt to this object instead (selector evaluated for the replacement's source and controller; Martyrs of Korlis, Ancient Adamantoise): the new recipient is still hit by replacements and keeps the damage's source and combat-ness.

set_to.description: The damage becomes exactly this much ("it deals 3 damage instead").

then.description: Effects that happen after the damage was changed (put on the stack): `Amount::EventAmount` = the amount that was prevented/removed, `Sel::TriggerSource` = the damage source ("prevent that damage; put that many counters ...", "mill that many").

then_always.description: `then` also runs when the damage is not changed (`EventAmount` = the damage dealt): "that source deals that much damage to you and this deals that much to its controller" (Eye for an Eye).

to_chosen_player_or_permanents.description: Only damage dealt to a player or to a permanent that player controls: the player is the one this selector picks when an `AddReplacement` resolves, else the source's chosen player (Lightning, Army of One; Sawhorn Nemesis).

to_filter.description: Only damage dealt to a PERMANENT matching this filter (relative to the replacement's controller / source): "creatures you control", "a permanent an opponent controls", "enchanted creature" (`attached_by_source`).

to_filter_or_you.description: With `to_filter`: the replacement also covers damage to its controller ("you and/or creatures you control").

to_this.description: Only damage dealt to the permanent that has this replacement effect.

oneOf.description: A card that would go from `from` (any zone if omitted) to `to` goes to `instead` (Rest in Peace).

bind_damager.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only cards dealt damage this turn by the one card this selector picks when the effect resolves ("a creature dealt damage by the targeted creature": Runesword).

bind_to.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: only the one card this selector picks when the effect resolves ("that spell", "target creature").

bottom.description: A library destination is the bottom of the library ("put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead").

cause_effect.description: Only when a spell or ability (an effect, not a cost or the cleanup step) causes the move ("if an effect causes you to discard a card": Library of Leng).

cause_opponent.description: Only when a spell or ability controlled by a player other than the card's owner causes the move ("if a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card").

not_cycled.description: Not when the card is being cycled (the discard of a cycling cost): Abandoned Sarcophagus "and it wasn't cycled".

not_from_battlefield.description: Not when the card comes from the battlefield ("permanent, spell, or card not on the battlefield": Sanctifier en-Vec).

on_resolve.description: Only when a spell is put into its destination as it resolves (not when countered or fizzled): "if that spell would be put into a graveyard as it resolves".

once.description: With `Effect::AddReplacement`: used up the first time it applies.

optional.description: "You may ... instead": the owner is asked after the move (at the next priority) and the card is moved on from `to` to `instead` when they accept.

then.description: Effects that go on the stack after the card moved ("exile it instead. When you do ..."). `Sel::TriggerObject` / `TriggerSource` = the card that moved; `TriggerPlayer` = its owner.

whose.description: Whose cards (their owner relative to the source's controller).

oneOf.description: "If this would be destroyed, regenerate it" (Mossbridge Troll, Knight of the Holy Nimbus, enchanted land of Crackling Emergence): matching permanents regenerate instead of being destroyed. Respects "can't be regenerated". Not triggered by sacrifice or lethal-damage state-based destruction that can't be regenerated.

"If enchanted land would be destroyed, instead sacrifice this Aura and that land gains indestructible until end of turn" (Harmonious Emergence): a matching permanent that would be destroyed (not one that is indestructible, and not sacrificed) is not destroyed; the replacement's source is sacrificed and the permanent gains indestructible until end of turn.
"If a matching permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all +1/+1 counters from it and all damage dealt to it is healed" (Dr. McCoy, Surly Surgeon).
Matching permanents enter tapped.

"If a creature you control would explore, instead it explores, then it explores again" (Topography Tracker): matching creatures explore `extra` more times. `scry`: the controller first scries that many (Twists and Turns: "instead you scry 1, then that creature explores").
"If a creature you control would connive, instead you draw `draw` card(s), then that creature connives" (Leader, Super-Genius).
"As a matching permanent enters, it becomes a P/T <subtype> creature in addition to its other types" (Displaced Dinosaurs: historic permanents become 7/7 Dinosaur creatures).
Matching permanents enter untapped (Horizon Explorer, Archelos): overrides every other enters-tapped effect.
Matching permanents that would enter under an opponent's control (of this ability's controller) enter under this ability's controller's control instead (Gather Specimens; use with `AddReplacement`).
Matching permanents enter with extra counters. `once`: used up the first time it applies (only meaningful in `AddReplacement`: "the next creature spell you cast this turn enters with ...").

"If you would lose the game, instead ...": the controller of the replacement doesn't lose; the listed changes happen at once (Exquisite Archangel, The Golden Throne, Lich's Mirror, Stunning Reversal via `AddReplacement`, which is used up when it applies).

exile_source.description: Exile the source of this replacement.

life.description: Your life total becomes this (`starting_life`: the format's starting life total instead).

shuffle_all.description: Shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library.

oneOf.description: Matching permanents enter the battlefield as a copy of the permanent `of` selects (Essence of the Wild: "creatures you control enter as a copy of this creature"; Infinite Reflection: the enchanted creature). With `Effect::AddReplacement`: `bind` evaluates `of` when the effect resolves (the chosen target) and keeps that card; `once` uses the replacement up the first time it applies ("the next time one or more creatures or planeswalkers enter this turn, they enter as copies of the chosen creature": Mystic Reflection).
Triggered abilities of permanents you control that trigger because of a matching event trigger `additional` extra times (Panharmonicon).

cause.description: The permanent entering / dying that caused the trigger.

own_or_emblem.description: Only triggered abilities of the permanent with this replacement or of an emblem its controller owns count (The Masamune's granted ability).

numbers.description: Chapter numbers sharing this ability ("II, III" = [2, 3]).

SearchInstead.description: `Effect::SearchLibrary.instead`: found cards matching the filter go to another zone when the condition holds.

Sel.description: Who or what an effect acts on.

oneOf.description: The i-th chosen target (of this ability / mode).
All chosen targets.
All the targets chosen for target slot `idx` (Spinning Wheel Kick: "each of X target creatures" after the first slot).
The ability's source object.
Your commander card(s), in any zone (Path of Ancestry: "shares a creature type with your commander").
Your commanders that are on the battlefield or in the command zone (Visions of Dominance).
The controller of the ability.
The owner of the source.
Each opponent of the controller.
The players this source's controller marked friend (`foe: false`) or foe (`foe: true`) with `Effect::ChooseFriendOrFoe`, in turn order from the controller.
Every player matching a player filter ("each player dealt combat damage by this creature this turn").
Each opponent of the trigger's player ("each of that player's opponents").
Every player other than the trigger's player ("each other player" when a player did the thing).
The active player ("the active player controls", Siren's Call, Nettling Imp).
The monarch, if any ("creatures the monarch controls": Azure Fleet Admiral).
Each opponent of the controller other than the trigger's player ("each other opponent": Kediss, Super State, Hydra Omnivore).
Players who voted for the option with this index in the last vote.
You and each player who voted for a choice you voted for (last vote).
The controller's opponents who voted for a choice the controller also voted for (Erestor of the Council).
The players whose recorded `ChooseNumber { record }` number is the highest.
Each player who voted for a choice you did not vote for (last vote).
Every player except the controller(s) of the selected objects ("each player other than its controller": Fractured Identity).
Every player except the players `a` and `b` select ("every player but you and the chosen player": Choose Your Champion: `You`, `ChosenPlayer`).
Inside the `then` of `Effect::EachPlayerChooses`: the cards the current chooser (`Sel::EachObject`) picked, in the order picked (`index: Some(n)` = only the n-th pick, 0-based).
Each opponent of the controller except the player(s) the inner selection names ("each of your other opponents" after "target opponent": Feed the Machine).
One card of the inner selection, chosen at random (seeded RNG): "destroy one of them at random" (Wild Swing, `of: Targets`).

From the selected cards: the one(s) the effect's controller owns plus every other card with a lesser mana value than the greatest of those ("the card you own exiled this way and each other card exiled this way with lesser mana value than it": Triple Triad). Empty when the controller owns none.
A random opponent.
A random opponent other than the player this Aura enchants (Maddening Hex).
A random player (you and the opponents alike): "choose a player at random".
One object chosen at random with equal chances among all creatures, planeswalkers and players ("2 damage to any target chosen at random").
Every player with the highest life total (ties included: "the player with the most life or tied for most life").
Every player with the lowest life total (ties included).
The player being attacked / defending.
You and the defending player ("you and defending player each draw a card": Cait, Cage Brawler).
What the selected attacking creature is attacking: the player, or the planeswalker / battle ("damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking").
Every player the selected creature(s) attacked this turn ("each player this creature attacked this turn"): Angel of Destiny.
Every player the selected creature(s) dealt combat damage to this turn ("that player": Glen Elendra).

The permanents attached to the selected permanent(s) that match `filter` (Auras / Equipment on a target creature: "return target creature and all Auras attached to it", "unattach Equipment attached to target creature").
All objects matching the filter (on the battlefield unless `zone` says otherwise).
All phased-out permanents matching the filter (Time and Tide).
The phased-out permanents held out by this source (`PhaseOut.until_source_leaves`): The Pandorica phases them in when it untaps.
All cards matching the filter in one zone of a particular player ("target player's graveyard").

owned.description: On the battlefield: select permanents the player OWNS rather than controls.

oneOf.description: The object (or player) that caused the trigger to fire.
The cards of a batched trigger event (the matching cards milled together).
The player who caused the trigger to fire.
The player who paid part of the triggering spell's cost through assist (Yume, Chronicler of Valor).
The player chosen on the source ("choose a player").
The permanent bound to this emblem by `CreateEmblem.bind` (kept even after it left the battlefield, so a replacement bound to it never matches anything else).
The exiled card this permanent last chose with `Effect::SetChosenCard`, while it is still in exile (Koh, the Face Stealer).
The card a token copy was made from (`Card.linked_card`), if it is still in exile: "return the exiled card to its owner's graveyard" (Hofri Ghostforge).
With two chosen players (`ChooseKind::Player` + `SecondPlayer`): the one that is NOT the event's player (Sower of Discord: "the other chosen player").
The source of the event that caused the trigger (the creature that dealt damage, the spell that was cast).
The stack item (spell or ability) whose targeting fired a `BecomesTarget` / `PlayerBecomesTarget` trigger; `CounterSpell` counters it even when it is an ability.

The owner of the card with the greatest mana value among the selected cards; nobody when two or more of them tie for greatest (Psychic Battle: `of` = the revealed cards, `Remembered` after `RevealTop`).
The source permanent / card of the selected stack objects (the artifact whose ability was targeted: Ouphe Vandals); still found after the object was countered.
Every activated and triggered ability on the stack controlled by the effect's controller (mana abilities never are; the resolving ability is not on the stack any more: Ulalek, Fused Atrocity).
The permanents that dealt damage to the selected cards this turn (Brine Hag: "each creature that dealt damage to it this turn").
The permanent that was dealt damage (IsDealtDamage triggers).
Inside an ability granted by a static / effect: the permanent that granted it (the Equipment or Aura; `This` is the creature).
What the source is attached to.
What each selected Aura / Equipment is attached to ("the creature that Aura is attached to": Crown of the Ages, Enchantment Alteration).
The creature each selected creature is paired with (soulbond): Joint Assault.
The permanent this Aura/Equipment is attached to, or the creature it enchants.
The player the source enchants (a Curse).
The controller of the i-th target.
The controller (when it dealt the damage) of the most recent source matching `filter` that dealt damage this turn to a player selected by `to` (Suffocation).
The owner of the target.

Every distinct owner of the selected cards ("each player who discarded a card this way": the owners of the remembered discarded cards). `filter`: only the cards matching it count (Scythe Specter: `mana_value_vs` = `HighestManaValueOf` of `Remembered`).
Whatever was chosen/created by an earlier effect of this ability (token just created, card exiled...).
The remembered cards from position `from` on (0-based, in the order they were remembered), at most `count` of them: `{from:0,count:1}` = the first one, `{from:1}` = all but the first (Flickerform).
The remembered cards that match `filter` ("an instant or sorcery card from among those exiled cards": Chandra, Hope's Beacon).
A set saved earlier in this resolution with `StoreRemembered` (slot 0-3): a second/third remembered set (piles, "the rest").
The cards in exile that this permanent exiled ("exiled with this", hideaway, linked exile). Cleared when the card leaves exile or this permanent changes zones.
The creatures (still on the battlefield) that were tapped to convoke the selected spell / permanent (Venerated Loxodon: "each creature that convoked it").
The top `n` cards of each selected player's library (not moved; `n` defaults to 1).

filter.description: Only cards matching this count (the topmost CREATURE card of a graveyard / library).

oneOf.description: The top `n` cards of each selected player's graveyard (the most recently put there first).

filter.description: Only cards matching this count (the topmost CREATURE card of a graveyard / library).

oneOf.description: The oldest `n` cards of each selected player's graveyard (the bottom card first).
The bottom `n` cards of each selected player's library.

amount.description: A computed number of cards instead of `n` ("exile that many cards from the bottom of your library").

filter.description: Only cards matching this count (the topmost CREATURE card of a graveyard / library).

oneOf.description: The permanents (matching `filter`, relative to the effect's controller) and, with `players`, players that the first target of the given spell on the stack could legally target (Radiate, Mirrorwing Dragon): with `except_current` the spell's present targets are left out. Use as the `objects` of a `ForEach` around `CopySpell {target: EachObject}`.
The current targets of a spell on the stack (Exterminator Magmarch: "another opponent than the one controlling the targeted permanent").
Inside `ForEach`: the current element (unlike `Remembered`, effects such as Discard/Mill/Choose inside the loop do not replace it).
The controller's Ring-bearer.
The player to the left of the controller.
The player to the controller's right (the previous player in turn order): Hithlain Rope.

The player next to the first selected player in the direction the source chose (`ChooseCreatureType` with `only: ["Left", "Right"]`; Left = next in turn order, Right = previous). `reverse`: the other way round (Order of Succession).

"Spend only mana produced by creatures to cast this spell": while this card is being cast, only mana from sources matching `filter` (tapped for it, or restricted mana they produced) pays for it; mana already floating in the pool can't be spent (its source isn't tracked): Myr Superion.

Matching spells (cast by players matching `whose`, relative to the source's controller) can't cost less than `min` mana in total, after every other cost change, alternative cost and chosen X: the shortfall is added as generic mana (Trinisphere: `min` 3, condition `Not SourceTapped`).
The affected creatures can attack as though they had haste.
The affected creatures' {T} / {Q} abilities can be activated as though they had haste (Tyvar, Thousand-Year Elixir); attacking is not covered.

Winter Orb: while it applies, matching players can't untap more than `max` permanents matching `filter` during their untap steps. Torpor Orb / Hushbringer / Elesh Norn: triggered abilities of permanents controlled by `whose` (relative to this permanent's controller) that would trigger because a permanent matching `cause` entered / died (`event`) don't trigger. A trigger's own source counts as the cause when it is the permanent.

During each player's untap step (while the condition holds), that player chooses one of `options` and can untap only permanents of that type this step (Storage Matrix: artifact, creature or land; use the condition "this is untapped").

Matching permanents can't be the target of spells (matching `spell`, default any spell; any controller). Abilities may still target them (Dense Foliage, Anti-Magic Aura; Bartel Runeaxe / Tetsuo Umezawa: `spell` = Aura spells). Spells cast by `whose` that target a matching permanent cost this much additional life to cast (Terror of the Peaks).

Matching permanents can't be the target of spells or abilities (of any controller, the permanent's own included) whose source matches `source` ("blue spells or abilities from blue sources": Spellbane Centaur, `source` = `{colors:[Blue]}`). `abilities_only`: spells are not stopped, only abilities from matching sources ("abilities from artifact sources": Artifact Ward).

Flagbearer: while an opponent of this permanent's controller chooses targets as part of casting a spell or activating an ability, they must choose at least one Flagbearer on the battlefield if able (Coalition Honor Guard). Enforced per target slot: a slot where a Flagbearer is a legal target only offers Flagbearers (a spell with several such slots must aim all of them at Flagbearers).

Matching permanents can't be the target of spells or abilities that can target only permanents of this subtype (a `Permanent` target slot whose filter requires `subtype`: Wall of Shadows, "only Walls").
"Cards in graveyards can't be the targets of spells or abilities" (Dennick, Underworld Cerberus).

Matching permanents on the battlefield and matching cards in graveyards can't be the targets of spells or abilities controlled by this permanent's controller's opponents (Tomik, Distinguished Advokist).
"Your opponents can't play land cards from graveyards" (players matching `who` can't play lands from a graveyard; Tomik).

Matching permanents (and, with `players`, this ability's controller's opponents) can be targeted "as though they didn't have hexproof" (Kaya, Bane of the Dead: `own_only` = only spells and abilities this ability's controller controls; Nowhere to Run: `ignore_ward` too).

Granted to a player (GrantStatic on a target player): that player's spells and abilities may target matching permanents (filter relative to the granting source) as though they didn't have shroud (Autumn Willow).
Granted to a player with `GrantStatic`: that player ignores "can't search libraries" effects (Leonin Arbiter's pay-{2} ability).
"You may pay {0} rather than pay the echo cost for permanents you control" (Thick-Skinned Goblin); read by `Effect::Echo`.
You may foretell cards from your hand on any player's turn (Cosmos Charger); read by the generated foretell action.
Matching creatures can't crew Vehicles (Intercessor's Arrest, Bound in Gold).
Matching permanents can't transform (Immerwolf, Bound by Moonsilver).
While voting, the controller votes an additional time (Ballot Broker, Brago's Representative, Tivit, Seller of Secrets).
"You may vote an additional time": the extra ballot can be declined (Ballot Broker, Tivit, Seller of Secrets).
"If an opponent would face a villainous choice, they face that choice an additional time" (The Valeyard).
"All instances of color words in the text of spells and permanents are changed to the chosen color word" (Swirl the Mists; the colour is the source's chosen colour).
Affected permanents get +power/+toughness.

each.description: Evaluate `power` / `toughness` once per affected permanent, with `Sel::EachObject` = that permanent ("+1/+1 for each other creature you control with the same name as it": Mirror Box, Coat of Arms, Toxrill, Bruenor).

oneOf.description: Affected creatures lose `keyword` (and, applied after grants, can't keep it: Archetype of Courage / Mystic Decree).
The affected permanents lose hexproof, indestructible, protection, shroud and ward (Shay Cormac).
Cards in graveyards lose all abilities (Yixlid Jailer): no flashback / graveyard alternative costs, no graveyard activated abilities.

except_mana.description: "lose all abilities except mana abilities" (Blood Sun).

no_land_mana.description: Also loses the mana abilities its basic land types give, but keeps the types (Imprisoned in the Moon).

oneOf.description: Base power and toughness from amounts evaluated continuously (Aettir and Priwen: X/X where X is your life total). `each`: the amounts are evaluated per affected permanent (`Sel::EachObject` = that permanent; March of the Machines, Starfield of Nyx).
Only the base power ("has base power 4"); toughness stays as it is (counters/pumps still apply).
Only the base toughness.
Characteristic-defining ability: base power and toughness from an amount.
Matching permanents gain a supertype (Legendary: Leyline of Singularity; Snow: Glittering Frost).
Matching permanents lose a supertype (Melting: lands are no longer snow).
Matching permanents lose these card types and creature/other subtypes (Princess Yue, Veiled Crocodile, Luxior).
Matching permanents get this name (Psychic Paper, Witness Protection, Princess Yue).
Matching permanents get the card name and creature type this source chose (`ChooseCardName` + `ChooseCreatureType` effects): Psychic Paper. Their other creature types are replaced.
The affected objects have the names of all nonlegendary creature cards in addition to their own (Spy Kit); honoured by name filters (`name`, `chosen_name`, `same_name_as`, `not_same_name_as`).
The attached permanent gets the modification (Auras, Equipment).

"As long as enchanted permanent isn't a creature, it's a creature (in addition to its types) with power and toughness `power`/`toughness`" (Animate Artifact). Judged in the type layer against the types it has then, so the P/T layer still applies after it has become a creature.
Enchanted permanent can't attack and/or block (Pacifism).
Activated abilities of matching permanents (that aren't mana abilities) can't be activated (Detainment Spell, Pithing Needle style).

mana.description: Mana abilities too ("its activated abilities can't be activated" includes them; Pithing Needle's don't).

power_up_only.description: Only power-up abilities (Kang, the Conqueror: "during that turn, power-up abilities can't be activated"; use a dynamic `GrantStatic` with `affects: {}`).

tap_only.description: Only abilities with {T} in their costs (Katabatic Winds, Serra Bestiary).

oneOf.description: Matching face-down permanents can't be turned face up (morph, manifest, cloak or an effect): Karlov Watchdog (with a `YourTurn` condition).
If the controller would copy a spell one or more times, they copy it that many times plus one more (Twinning Staff).
Matching permanents have this ability (activated, mana or triggered) in addition to their own (Chromatic Lantern).
Matching permanents have every protection quality printed on a card exiled with the source (Eater of Virtue: "the same is true for protection").
Matching permanents have every protection quality printed on a creature card in any graveyard (Cairn Wanderer: "the same is true for protection").

Matching permanents have flying, first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance and protection whenever a creature card in exile with a `kind` counter has it (Rayami, First of the Fallen).
Matching permanents have protection from each colour that is not in the colour identity of the static's controller's commander(s) (Commander's Plate).

"Has all activated abilities of <the cards selected by from>" (Dark Impostor, Myr Welder, Necrotic Ooze, Mirran Safehouse); the abilities are those printed on the selected cards. `non_mana`: only the activated abilities that are not mana abilities (Sharkey, Tyrant of the Shire).

intrinsic_land_mana.description: A selected land with basic land types also grants the mana ability those types give it (Manascape Refractor: "all activated abilities of all lands").

loyalty_only.description: Grant the LOYALTY abilities of the selected cards instead of their other activated abilities (Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God: "has all loyalty abilities of all other planeswalkers").

once_each_turn.description: "You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn" (Locus of Enlightenment): the granted copies get `limit_per_turn: 1`.

triggered.description: Grant the triggered abilities of the selected cards too (Koh, the Face Stealer: "all activated and triggered abilities").

oneOf.description: "If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest roll" (Barbarian Class): the controller's die rolls get one extra die and only the highest counts.
Buyback costs cost this much more / less (generic part only; Memory Crystal: `generic: -2`). Applies to every player's buyback kickers (`Kicker.buyback`).
Spells matching the filter cost this much more / less to cast.

color.description: The change applies to the coloured mana of this colour in the cost instead of the generic part: a negative `generic` removes that many coloured shards ("costs {R} less to cast"), a POSITIVE one adds them ("white spells cost {W} more to cast").

dash.description: Applies only to spells cast for their dash alternative cost (Warbringer: "Dash costs you pay cost {2} less").

fixed.description: In `GrantStatic`: `per` is evaluated once when the effect resolves and fixed for its duration (Commander Liara Portyr: "where X is the number of players being attacked").

flashback.description: Applies only to spells cast for their flashback cost (a printed Flashback alternative cost cast from the graveyard: Catalyst Stone).

free.description: In `GrantStatic` with `once`: the matching spell is cast without paying its mana cost (Apex Observatory: "the next spell you cast this turn of the chosen type"). Extra costs still apply.

generic_fallback.description: With `color` and a reduction: when the cost has no coloured mana of that colour left, the reduction takes off generic mana instead ("This can reduce generic costs": Aang, Master of Elements).

not_from.description: Does not apply to spells cast from this zone ("spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand": `not_from: Hand`).

once.description: Used up by the first matching spell the player casts (only meaningful in `GrantStatic`: "the next spell you cast this turn costs {1} less").

per.description: Multiply `generic` by this amount ("costs {1} less for each artifact you control"; Affinity, Blasphemous Act). A spell's own CostChange (`filter.this`) applies while it is in hand, on the stack or in the command zone.

per_caster.description: `per` is counted from the CASTER's point of view ("for each artifact its controller controls": Hum of the Radix) instead of the static's controller.

oneOf.description: "As an additional cost to cast <spells matching filter>, you may pay <cost>. Those spells cost {C} less to cast if you paid this way" (Defiler of Dreams). The caster is asked once per cast; paying adds `cost` to the spell's additional costs and removes one `reduce` coloured shard from its mana cost (only the coloured mana is reduced).

"As an additional cost to cast spells matching `filter`, you may pay any amount of mana. If you do, that permanent enters with that many additional +1/+1 counters" (Chorus of the Conclave). The caster is asked for the amount (0 to the most they can afford on top of the spell's cost) before the spell's other choices.

"As long as this isn't on the battlefield, it's a P/T `subtype` creature in addition to its other types" (Grist, the Hunger Tide): applies to the card in every zone but the battlefield (hand, library, graveyard, exile, stack, command zone).

"You may spend mana from snow sources as though it were mana of any color to cast <spells matching filter>" (Draugr Necromancer: exiled opponents' cards with ice counters). The `filter` is judged against the spell being cast; `whose` is the caster, relative to this permanent's controller.
Damage marked on this creature isn't removed during cleanup steps (Ancient Adamantoise).
Counters remain on this card as it moves to any zone other than a player's hand or library (Me, the Immortal).

"You may spend `from` mana as though it were `to` mana" (Sunglasses of Urza): each {to} / {to/P} symbol of a cost the controller pays can also be paid with `from` mana (planned as a `{to/from}` hybrid; other hybrid symbols are left alone).

"As long as the top card of your graveyard is a creature card, this creature has the full text of that card": while the top card of its controller's graveyard is a creature card, this permanent has that card's name, types, colors, power, toughness, keywords and triggered / activated / static abilities in addition to its own printed abilities (Volrath's Shapeshifter). Its mana cost / mana value stay its own.

Colored mana that spells and abilities the controller controls would add is white mana instead (False Dawn: grant with `GrantStatic` `dynamic` until end of turn). Applies to mana abilities and to `AddMana`; the mana-source planner shows white only.
"For each {C} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana" (K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth): every `color` symbol of a cost the controller pays is treated as a Phyrexian symbol.

"You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color (or type) to cast spells matching `filter`" (Oath of Nissa, Vizier of the Menagerie, Mycosynth Lattice): the spell's colored / colorless costs are paid with any mana.

abilities.description: Instead of spells: mana spent to activate abilities of the battlefield permanents matching `filter` (Nathan Drake: permanents you control but don't own).

oneOf.description: Activated abilities (not mana abilities) of the permanents matching `filter` cost `generic` more / less to activate when activated by a player matching `whose` (relative to the static's controller). `per` multiplies `generic`. `min_one`: not below one mana in total ("can't reduce its total cost below one mana"). Only the generic part of a mana cost is reduced. Equip, crew and other special abilities count as activated abilities.

boast_only.description: Only boast abilities (limit once per turn, conditioned on the creature having attacked: Dragonkin Berserker).

equip_only.description: Only equip abilities ("Equip abilities you activate cost {1} less"): an activated ability whose first effect attaches this Equipment.

first_creature_target_per_turn.description: With `target`: only the first ability each affected player activates during their own turn that targets a creature they control (Professor Hojo; `Game.creature_tgt_act_log`).

first_cycle_per_turn.description: Only while the affected player hasn't cycled a card this turn ("the first card you cycle each turn": Gavi, Nest Warden, with `free`).

first_per_turn.description: Only the first activated ability of an artifact that each affected player activates each turn (Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh; `Game.artifact_act_log`).

first_power_up_per_turn.description: Only the first power-up ability each affected player activates each turn (Advancing the Spirit, with `free`; `Game.power_up_act_log`).

foretell_only.description: Only foretell special actions (an ability that exiles its card from hand and marks it foretold: Ranar the Ever-Watchful).

free.description: The matching abilities' mana cost becomes {0} ("you may pay {0} rather than pay cycling costs": New Perspectives); `generic` is ignored.

in_zone.description: Only abilities of cards in this zone, whichever zone that is ("activated abilities of cards in your graveyard": Convergence of Dominion); the filter's controller test is relative to the static's controller as usual.

once_only.description: Only exhaust abilities (an activated ability marked `once: true`; Boom Scholar).

plot_only.description: Only plot special actions (an ability that exiles its card from hand and marks it plotted: Doc Aurlock, Grizzled Genius).

power_up_only.description: Only power-up abilities (`Activated.power_up`; Hulk, Gamma Goliath).

remove.description: Instead of `generic`: remove these mana symbols from the ability's cost (each coloured / hybrid symbol that is present, generic reducing the generic part). "Reduce the cost by its mana cost if it entered this turn" (power-up): give the card's own mana cost with an `entered_this_turn` condition. Applies to every activated ability of the matching permanents, so use it on cards whose only activated ability is the one reduced.

sac_self_only.description: Only abilities with a "Sacrifice this" cost ("{7}, {T}, Sacrifice this creature: ... costs {1} less ...": Qiqirn Merchant).

target.description: Only abilities whose first target is a permanent matching this filter (relative to this static's source: "Equip abilities that target this creature"). Settled once the targets are chosen.

oneOf.description: Unlocking a Room's doors (the special action) costs `generic` more (positive) or less (negative) for the matching players, relative to the static's controller (Inquisitive Glimmer).

Activated abilities (not mana abilities) of the permanents matching `filter` cost the additional `cost` parts to activate (Brutal Suppression: "Sacrifice a land"). With `per_symbol`, the cost is paid once for each mana symbol of that colour in the ability's mana cost (Drought: a Sacrifice-a-Swamp cost for each {B}); no such symbol, no extra cost.

Spells matching `filter` cast by players matching `whose` cost the additional `cost` parts (Sacrifice parts are repeated once for each `per_symbol` mana symbol in the spell's mana cost when given: Drought; no such symbol, no extra cost).
"You may spend white mana as though it were mana of any color. You may spend other mana only as though it were colorless mana" (Celestial Dawn): applies to the controller's payments.
Nonland cards (and spells) the controller owns that aren't on the battlefield are white (Celestial Dawn; pair with a `SetColors` static for the permanents; `Game.white_nonland`).
Every card outside the battlefield and every spell is colorless (Mycosynth Lattice); use a `SetColors` static for the permanents.
Triggered abilities (and delayed triggered abilities) the controller controls can't cause that player to sacrifice or exile creature tokens they control (The Master, Multiplied).

Spells matching `filter` (cast by players matching `whose`, from `from` if given, hand by default) can be cast by paying `cost` (a mana string, "{0}" = free) rather than their mana cost (Jodah, Leyline of Mutation, Rooftop Storm, Darksteel Monolith). `once_per_turn`: only the first time each turn this source is used.

exile_after.description: The spell cast this way is exiled instead of going to the graveyard when it leaves the stack (flashback-style grants: Katilda and Lier, Backdraft Hellkite). `cost: "own"` = the card's own mana cost.

extra.description: Further (non-mana) costs paid along with `cost`: "rather than pay the mana cost, discard a card" (Dream Halls: cost "{0}", extra [Discard]); "by paying 3 life in addition" (Noctis, from Graveyard).

pay_life_mv.description: Also pay life equal to the spell's mana value (use `cost: "{0}"`): "pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost".

prowl.description: Prowl: only while a creature you controlled that shares a creature type with the spell dealt combat damage to a player this turn (Hunting Velociraptor).

oneOf.description: "If you would proliferate, proliferate twice instead" (Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus); each such permanent you control doubles the number of proliferate rounds.
This planeswalker / battle can't be attacked (put a condition on the static: The Aetherspark while attached to a creature).
Players can't do something.
The matching players can't activate abilities that aren't mana abilities or loyalty abilities, from any zone (Overwhelming Splendor).
The matching players can cast spells only at times they could cast a sorcery (Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir; Teferi, Time Raveler).

The matching players can't play lands (cast spells and put lands onto the battlefield other ways are unaffected); use a condition for "while ten or more lands". With `filter`, only lands matching it (relative to the source; `chosen_name` for "lands with the chosen name", Conjurer's Ban) can't be played.
The matching players can't search libraries (Mindlock Orb: everyone; Ashiok: your opponents): their SearchLibrary effects find nothing.
The matching players skip their untap steps (Stasis): no untapping and no phasing.
Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause you (the controller) to discard cards or sacrifice permanents (Tamiyo, Collector of Tales).
Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause you to sacrifice permanents (Tajuru Preserver); discards and your own costs are unaffected.

Loyalty abilities of the planeswalkers matching `filter`, activated by a player matching `whose`, cost `delta` extra loyalty (an additional [+1]: Carth the Lion). The cost is paid as printed, then `delta` counters are added; the ability's own loyalty cost is still needed to activate.

At most `n` creatures can attack the players matching `defending` (relative to the source's controller) each combat, counted together (Crawlspace: You, 2; Caverns of Despair: Any, 2). Extra attackers are dropped from the end of the declaration.
The matching players must attack with at least one creature each combat if able (Seeker of Slaanesh); if they declare none, the first able attacker is added.

If a creature controlled by a matching player attacks, all their creatures must attack if able (War's Toll): after the declaration, every other able creature is added, attacking the same player as the first attacker when it can.

"If a creature with a `kind` counter on it attacks, all creatures with `kind` counters on them attack if able" (Magnetic Web): after the declaration every other able creature of the attacking player with such a counter is added, attacking the same player as the first such attacker when it can.
Stun counters can't be removed from the matching permanents (Fear of Sleep Paralysis): they stay tapped through untap steps and untap effects, and `{Q}` can't be paid.

Matching permanents and spells are colourless sources of damage (Ghostly Flame): damage-source colour checks (protection from a colour, colourless, monocoloured, multicoloured) see no colour; targeting, blocking and enchanting still see the real colours.
"If a creature you control attacks, this creature also attacks if able" (Ekundu Cyclops): applied to the attack declaration once at least one creature attacks.
"No more than N creatures can block each combat" (Dueling Grounds, Caverns of Despair, Silent Arbiter): a combat-wide cap on blocking creatures; later blockers are dropped.
"The attacking player chooses how each creature blocks each combat" (Invasion Plans): the active player answers the block declaration for every defending player.

Matching spells can't be cast by the players (`who`): "spells with the chosen name can't be cast". `caster_relative`: the filter is evaluated as if the casting player controlled the source, so "You" in an `Amount` inside it (`mana_value_vs`) means the caster (Lavinia, Azorius Renegade: noncreature spells with mana value above the lands the caster controls).
While the source is untapped, attacking doesn't cause creatures its controller controls to tap (Johan; granted with `GrantStatic` `dynamic` until end of combat).

Affected creatures count as having `bonus` more power when tapped for Crew / Saddle costs. `crew_only`: counts for Crew but not Saddle ("crews Vehicles as though its power were N greater": Reckoner Bankbuster's Pilot).
Affected creatures tap for Crew / Saddle using their toughness rather than their power (Giant Ox, Interface Ace).
Affected creatures count as having three times their power when tapped for Crew or Station (Sulu, Heroic Helmsman).
This permanent can't be equipped: Equipment can't be attached to it and falls off (Goblin Brawler).
On an Aura: the permanent it enchants can't be enchanted by other Auras (Consecrate Land): other Auras can't target it and ones already attached go to the graveyard.
"If <who> would begin an extra turn, that player skips that turn instead" (Stranglehold, Gerrard's Hourglass Pendant).
Matching blockers can block attackers matching `attacker` as though they had reach (Dragon Hunter: Dragons).
All damage is dealt as though its source had wither (Everlasting Torment).

Replace only the affected permanents' subtypes of one group (creature types or land types) with `subtypes`, keeping card types and the other subtypes (Ichthyomorphosis: creature types := Fish; Harbinger of the Seas: land types := Island; empty = lose them).
Mana abilities of this permanent cost an additional `n` life to activate (Thran Portal).

The affected permanents' creature types become those of the last creature card exiled with the source, plus `keep` ("it's still a Shapeshifter": Duplicant). Nothing changes while no creature card is exiled with it.
Tapped creatures matching `affects` can block as though they were untapped (Masako the Humorless).
Matching Vehicles have crew `n` instead of their printed crew number (Kotori, Pilot Prodigy: "Vehicles you control have crew 2").
Matching creatures can't attack unless another attacking creature matching `other` also attacks (Scarred Puma).
The matching players may activate Equip abilities any time they could cast an instant (Leonin Shikari).
All affected permanents are the color this source chose ("All nonland permanents are the chosen color"; Shifting Sky).
Matching permanents are the color their owner chose before the game (`Ability::PregameChooseColor`); colorless if none was chosen (Clara Oswald).
Matching permanents are also the color this source chose (Painter's Servant; pair with `ColorAddedEverywhere` for cards outside the battlefield and spells).
Every card that isn't on the battlefield, and every spell, is also the color this source chose (Painter's Servant; `Game.color_all`).

Creature spells this source's controller controls and creature cards they own outside the battlefield are also artifacts (Biotransference; pair with an `AddType` static for the battlefield; `Game.artifact_creatures`).
Affected creatures assign combat damage equal to their toughness rather than their power.
"While you're searching your library, you may cast this card from your library" (Panglacial Wurm); read by `Effect::SearchLibrary`.
Affected creatures with toughness greater than power assign combat damage equal to their toughness (Tapestry Warden).
Affected creatures with toughness greater than power station using their toughness (Tapestry Warden; spacecraft read `Amount::StationValue`).
Affected creatures with negative power assign combat damage as though their power were positive (Loot, the Anomaly).
Lethal damage dealt to the affected creatures is determined by their power rather than their toughness (Zilortha, Strength Incarnate; a creature with power 0 or less is destroyed by any damage).
Affected creatures have landwalk of the land type this source chose (`EntersChoose` `LandType`; Traveler's Cloak).
Affected creatures assign no combat damage (grant it with a timed `GrantStatic`: Stromgald Spy).
