Affected creatures with defender can attack as though they didn't have defender.
Affected creatures with defender can attack players who attacked their controller during their last turn as though they didn't have defender (Weathered Sentinels).

Affected creatures may assign their combat damage as though they weren't blocked (all of it to the player / planeswalker they attack). The damage-assignment question lists each blocker with 0 lethal damage and the defender as a trample target.
"You may assign this creature's combat damage divided as you choose among defending player and/or any number of creatures they control" (Butcher Orgg): on the card itself, unblocked case.

"Rather than the attacking player, you assign the combat damage of each creature attacking you. You can divide that creature's combat damage as you choose among any of the creatures blocking it" (Defensive Formation): the controller of this permanent, as a defending player, makes the damage assignment of blocked attackers (no lethal-damage requirement, no trample).
"Creatures you control can boast twice during each of your turns rather than once" (Birgi, God of Storytelling): boast abilities of the controller's creatures can be activated twice a turn.

"Trample over planeswalkers" on the card itself: combat damage it deals to a planeswalker it attacks beyond the planeswalker's loyalty goes to that planeswalker's controller (Thrasta, Tempest's Roar).
"Can't be blocked by more than N creature(s)" (the affected attackers).
"No more than N creatures can attack this planeswalker each combat" for the matching permanents (Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage): later attackers declared against it are dropped.
"can't be blocked except by N or more creatures": a block with fewer than `n` blockers on the creature is not allowed.
"Can't be blocked unless all creatures defending player controls block it."
"Can't be destroyed by lethal damage unless lethal damage dealt by a single source is marked on it" (Ogre Enforcer). Deathtouch still destroys.

"Can't attack unless defending player controls an Island" (`if_controls: false`) / "can't attack if defending player controls an untapped land" (`if_controls: true`): `defender_controls` is matched against the permanents the attacked player (or planeswalker's controller) controls. The affected creatures can't attack their owner or planeswalkers/battles their owner controls (Alexios, Xantcha).
The affected creatures can't attack this permanent's controller (nor, unless `players_only`, planeswalkers/battles that player controls).

players_only.description: The restriction applies only to attacking the player, not that player's planeswalkers / battles ("can't attack you").

oneOf.description: The affected creatures can't block attackers matching `attacker` ("can't block non-Spirit creatures"; use `not_subtypes` etc. on the attacker filter).
"Can block an additional creature each combat" (`extra: 1`); `extra: 0` means any number of creatures. Its damage is dealt lethal-first in declaration order.
"Can block an additional creature each combat for each ..." (Kemba's Legion): the number of extra blocks is an amount evaluated continuously.
The affected creatures attack this source (a planeswalker) each combat if able (Gideon Jura; use via `GrantStatic dynamic`).
The affected creatures attack the source's controller each combat if able (Trove of Temptation); `enchanted_controller`: the controller of the permanent the source is attached to (Public Enemy).
The affected creatures can't attack unless another creature also attacks ("can't attack alone"); combine with a static condition for "unless ...".
The matching creatures can attack only alone: if one of them is declared with other attackers, only it attacks (Master of Cruelties).
The affected creatures can't attack unless at least `n` other creatures also attack (Orcish Conscripts).
The affected creatures can't block unless at least `n` other creatures also block (Orcish Conscripts).
The affected creatures can't attack a player they have already attacked this turn (Bloodthirster, Port Razer); attacking that player's planeswalkers is still allowed.
Each player may attack only the nearest opponent in the direction this source chose (`ChooseKind::LeftRight`) and planeswalkers / battles that opponent controls (Pramikon, Sky Rampart).
The affected creatures can't attack unless a creature with greater power also attacks (Okk).
The affected creatures can't block unless a creature with greater power also blocks (Okk).
The affected creatures can't block unless another creature also blocks ("can't block alone").
The affected creatures can block creatures with shadow (as though they had / the attackers lacked shadow). They can still block creatures without shadow.
The affected creatures can block creatures with landwalk as though those creatures didn't have landwalk (Street Savvy).
The affected creatures can be blocked as though they didn't have landwalk ("Islandwalk creatures can be blocked as though they didn't have islandwalk").

only.description: Only this landwalk keyword is ignored (Crevasse: Mountainwalk); without it all of the creature's landwalk is.

oneOf.description: The matching permanents can't be sacrificed (neither as a cost nor by an effect).
The matching permanents can't be returned to hand to pay a "beam me up" cost (Marooned: "can't be beamed up"); filters with `beamable` skip them.
The matching permanents can't phase out (Spatial Binding, via GrantStatic until your next upkeep).
The matching planeswalkers aren't put into the graveyard for having 0 loyalty (Sanctum Lurker).
The matching permanents can't become suspected (Airtight Alibi).
Permanents can't phase in (Disciple of Caelus Nin).
Matching cards in `from` can't be put onto the battlefield (Kunoros, Hound of Athreos: creature cards in graveyards).
Matching cards can't enter the battlefield from any zone (Worms of the Earth: lands). Tokens are not covered.
When damage is dealt to this creature, the damage already marked on it is healed first (Wolverine, Fierce Fighter).
Information only (no rules effect in the engine; clients may show it): the matching players play with their hand revealed (Telepathy, Seer's Vision).
Information only: the controller may look at the top card of their library any time (Radar Sense, Glarb) / plays with it revealed (`all`: every player's).

each_library.description: Every player's library, not only the controller's ("Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed": Wizened Snitches).

oneOf.description: Continuously goaded (while the static applies): attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than the static's controller if able.
The creatures block each combat if able.

attacker.description: Only attackers matching this (relative to the static's source): "all creatures able to block this creature do so" = `{"this":true}`.

oneOf.description: The creatures must be blocked if able (at least one creature that can block them does).
The creatures can't be blocked while `cond` holds, judged with the defending player (the blocker's controller) as "you" ("can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an enchantment").

The creatures can't attack a player (or planeswalker of a player) for whom `cond` holds, judged with that defending player as "you" ("can't attack unless defending player is poisoned" = `Not` poisoned).

The creatures can't block an attacker whose controller satisfies `cond`, judged with the attacking player as "you" ("can't block unless you control more creatures than attacking player" = `Not` of that).
The creatures must be blocked by at least `n` creatures matching `by` if able ("must be blocked by a Dalek if able", "by two or more creatures if able").

The matching cards (on the battlefield, spells on the stack, and cards in other zones) are also of the creature type this permanent chose as it entered (Arcane Adaptation, Leyline of Transformation, Adaptive Automaton). `zone`: only cards currently in that zone (Ashes of the Fallen: Graveyard); default every zone. `fixed`: add that fixed subtype to matching cards that are NOT on the battlefield (hand, graveyard, exile, library; `zone` still narrows) instead of the chosen type (Dune Chanter: "land cards you own that aren't on the battlefield are Deserts"); pair with an `AddType` for the battlefield.

replace.description: The matching cards' creature types BECOME the chosen type (their other creature types are lost) instead of adding to them (Conspiracy).

oneOf.description: The matching permanents are also of the SECOND basic land type this permanent chose (`ChooseKind::SecondBasicLandType`). `affects` picks them, usually with `chosen_type` for the first type (Illusionary Terrain: basic lands of the first chosen type are the second).
Creatures matching the filter can't be blocked except by ...
The affected creatures can't be blocked by creatures with greater power than their own (Tadeas, Juniper Ascendant; grant with `GrantStatic`).
The maximum hand size of the matching players is `n` (Cursed Rack: `ChosenPlayer`). Judged with `player_filter_src`.
Matching players don't lose unspent mana as steps and phases end (Upwelling: all mana; Omnath/Fangorn: `colors` [G]; Leyline Tyrant: [R]). Empty `colors` = every type.
This permanent can't have more than `max` counters of `kind` on it; counters put on it beyond that are not added (Rasputin Dreamweaver).
Mana matching players would lose (as steps and phases end, or from a "lose all unspent mana" effect) becomes colorless instead (Horizon Stone).
"If you would get one or more poison counters, instead you get one poison counter and you can't get additional poison counters this turn" (Melira, the Living Cure).
Mana matching players would lose (as steps and phases end, or from a "lose all unspent mana" effect) becomes black instead (Omnath, Locus of All).
Mana matching players would lose (as steps and phases end, or from a "lose all unspent mana" effect) becomes red instead (Ozai, the Phoenix King).
A matching player losing unspent mana (as a step or phase ends, or from a "lose all unspent mana" effect) loses that much life (Yurlok of Scorch Thrash).

"You may play lands / cast spells from your graveyard" (Crucible of Worlds, Muldrotha) or "from the top of your library" (Mystic Forge, Oracle of Mul Daya). The `filter` limits which cards; the controller of this permanent may play them as if from hand.

active_player.description: The permission belongs to the active player (whoever's turn it is) instead of this permanent's controller; the filter is judged from that player's side ("a spell from among the cards they don't own exiled with Ian Malcolm").

any_graveyard.description: With `zone: Graveyard`: the cards in every player's graveyard are offered, not just your own (Coram, the Undertaker).

any_library.description: With `zone: Library`: the top card of every player's library is offered, not just your own (Windriddle Palaces).

exile_after.description: A spell cast through this permission is exiled instead of going to the graveyard when it would (Kess, Dissident Mage; flashback and other alternative-cost casts are not affected).

exile_top.description: "When they do, exile the top card of their library": whoever plays a land / casts a spell through this permission exiles the top card of their own library, tagged as exiled with this permanent (Share the Spoils).

exiler.description: Every player has the permission for the cards THEY exiled (`Card.exiled_by`, set with `Effect::SetExiledBy`), not just this permanent's controller (Shared Fate).

extra_cost.description: Extra costs paid in addition to the other costs when casting through this permission (Falco Spara: remove a counter from a creature you control). Not applied to alternative-cost casts.

extra_life.description: Casting through this permission costs this much life in addition to the other costs (Festival of Embers: 1). Not applied to flashback or other alternative-cost casts.

finality.description: A permanent spell cast from the graveyard through this permission enters with a finality counter (Leonardo, Sewer Samurai).

free.description: A spell cast from exile through this permission is cast without paying its mana cost (Maralen, Fae Ascendant).

leave_exile.description: A permanent played or cast through this permission gains "If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else" (The Eighth Doctor; pair with `once_per_turn`).

leave_exile_gain.description: A permanent played or cast through this permission gains "When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain N life" (Serra Paragon: 2). Pair with `once_per_turn`, which is also used up by playing a land through the permission.

mark_played.description: A card played or cast through this permission is marked as played via this source, so the source's own triggers can tell (`Filter.played_via_this` on `SpellCast` / `LandPlayed`: The Matrix of Time, "whenever you play a land or cast a spell from among cards exiled with ~").

once_per_turn.description: This permission can be used only once each turn (by this permanent): "once during each of your turns, you may cast a ... from your graveyard".

per_kind.description: Once each turn per kind: one land AND one spell (Coram, the Undertaker: "you may play a land and cast a spell from among ...").

per_type.description: Once each turn per permanent type (Muldrotha, the Gravetide): each play/cast through this permission uses up one permanent type of the card (a multi-type card uses the first unused one in the order land, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, battle, creature).

sac_exile.description: Casting through this permission requires sacrificing a creature in addition to the other costs, and a spell cast this way is exiled instead of going to the graveyard (Maestros Ascendancy).

oneOf.description: While a matching player searches their library, this permanent's controller makes the search's choices, and the found cards are exiled instead; the controller may play them for as long as they remain exiled, spending mana as though it were any color (Opposition Agent).
Matching players can't venture into the dungeon more than once each turn (Keen-Eared Sentry: `who` Opponent).
"You have hexproof" (`who` relative to the controller): opponents' spells and abilities can't target those players.

"You have hexproof from <quality>" (Veil of Summer, granted with `GrantStatic` to players): opponents' spells and abilities from sources with that quality can't target those players. Only honoured as a granted effect.
"You have shroud" (Ivory Mask): no spell or ability, even your own, can target those players.
"You have protection from ..." (Absolute Virtue: `Opponents`): the players can't be targeted or dealt damage by matching sources.
"Players have no maximum hand size" / "your opponents have no maximum hand size".
Matching players can't lose the game (Platinum Angel: `You` for its controller).
If damage dealt to a matching planeswalker would remove all its loyalty counters, all but one are removed instead (Deification: use `condition` "you control a creature").
Matching players can't win the game (Courageous Resolve: opponents; Platinum Angel: "your opponents can't win"). The game goes on while the last player left can't win.
"Damage that would reduce your life total to less than 1 reduces it to 1 instead" (Angel's Grace; granted to players until end of turn).
Damage that would reduce the player's life total to less than `floor` reduces it to `floor` instead (Elderscale Wurm); the damage is still dealt in full.

"If your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, instead transform this creature and your life total becomes 3. Then if this creature didn't transform this way, you lose the game" (Enduring Angel). Applied when state-based actions find the life total at 0 or less.
"Damage doesn't cause you to lose life" (Archon of Coronation while monarch); other life loss still happens.
"You don't lose the game for having 0 or less life" (other ways of losing still work).
"You may cast <matching spells> as though they had flash." `once` (in `GrantStatic` to a player): used up by the first matching spell cast.

if_targets.description: Only if the spell targets a permanent matching this filter (Flash Photography: "if it targets a permanent you control"). Cast at a time it could not otherwise be cast, the spell's first target slot is limited to such permanents. Only for a card's own ability (`filter.this`).

oneOf.description: Matching players can't pay life (Platinum Emperion).
Matching players who would pay life (while their library has at least that many cards) exile that many cards from the top of their library instead (Ashiok, Wicked Manipulator).
Players can't sacrifice creatures to pay costs (Angel of Jubilation).
Nonland permanents can't be sacrificed to pay costs of spells or abilities (Yasharn, Implacable Earth); effects that sacrifice are unaffected.
The legend rule doesn't apply to matching permanents (Mirror Box, Mirror Gallery, Spider-Verse).
Matching permanents don't untap during their controller's untap step (Intruder Alarm, Dehydration, Grimgrin).

Granted via `GrantStatic` for a duration: the permanent can't become tapped (every tap path checks `Game::can_become_tapped`); with `except_attacking` it still taps when declared as an attacker (Ood Sphere). `affects` is ignored.

Mana produced by matching permanents' mana abilities is of type `to` instead (Contamination: B; Ritual of Subdual: C; Pale Moon). With `from` set only that type is replaced. Granted via GrantStatic the filter is ignored.

any_color.description: "one mana of a color of your choice instead of any other type and amount" (Harvest Mage): a tap produces exactly one mana of the color the tapping player picks (`to` is ignored; the payment planner treats the land as a source of any color).

single.description: "instead of any other type and amount" (Contamination): a tap produces exactly one mana of `to`.

to_chosen.description: `to` is ignored: the color chosen on the source by its latest `ChooseColor` is used (Hall of Gemstone). Only honoured as a granted dynamic static.

oneOf.description: "If a land is tapped for two or more mana, it produces {C} instead of any other type and amount" (Damping Sphere): affects every player's lands.
Your devotion to each color and each combination of colors is increased by `n` (Altar of the Pantheon).
Matching permanents (you control) also untap during each other player's untap step (Murkfiend Liege, Ivorytusk Fortress, Ohabi Caleria).
A matching permanent that would untap during its controller's untap step has all `kind` counters removed instead (Freyalise's Winds).
A matching permanent that would untap during its controller's untap step instead gets `n` `kind` counters and stays tapped (Edge of Malacol).

A matching permanent that would untap during its controller's untap step instead has one `kind` counter removed, and untaps only if a counter was removed (Bewitching Leechcraft; use `attached_by_source` on an Aura).
"Damage can't be prevented" (Leyline of Punishment): prevention effects and protection do nothing while this is on the battlefield.

"Combat damage dealt by creatures you control can't be prevented" / "damage dealt by sources you control ...": prevention does nothing for damage from sources matching `filter` (read with this permanent as the source).
"As you cascade, you may put a land card from among the exiled cards onto the battlefield tapped" (Averna, the Chaos Bloom): read by `RevealUntil.cascade_land`.
"Skip your draw step" (Necropotence, Dragon Appeasement): the matching players skip their draw steps.
"You may look at an additional `n` cards each time you surveil" (Enhanced Surveillance).
"You gain life rather than lose life from radiation" (Strong, the Brutish Thespian).
"If you would begin your draw step, you may skip that step instead. If you do, you gain `gain` life" (Fasting).
"Players skip their upkeep steps" (Eon Hub): the matching players skip their upkeep.
"You can't play lands from your hand" (Experimental Frenzy): only land plays from the hand are stopped.
"You may activate loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control twice each turn rather than only once" (Oath of Teferi).
You may activate loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant (Teferi's Talent emblem; emblem statics run from the command zone).
Instant and sorcery spells you control have rebound (Cast Through Time; a spell with its own rebound is unchanged).
Instant and sorcery spells (of every player) have rebound; works from a face-up plane (Trail of the Mage-Rings).
The affected permanents can't be enchanted: new Auras can't target them; Auras already attached stay (Guardian Beast).
Players other than the static's controller can't gain control of the affected permanents (Guardian Beast).
This permanent can't be enchanted: Auras can't target it and ones attached to it fall off (the Tetravite token).
"During your turn, as long as you haven't activated an exhaust ability this turn, you may activate exhaust abilities as though they haven't been activated" (Elvish Refueler).
"Each power-up ability of permanents you control can be activated an additional time" (Wonder Man, Hollywood Hero): a once-only `power_up` ability may be activated twice.
"If an opponent would search a library, that player searches the top `n` cards of that library instead" (Aven Mindcensor): searches by players matching `who` only see the top `n` cards.
"You may choose not to untap this during your untap step": its controller is asked each untap step (the default answer untaps it).
"If you would flip a coin, instead flip two coins and ignore one" (Krark's Thumb): the controller's flips are won if either coin is (the better result is kept).
"The first time you flip one or more coins each turn, those coins come up heads and you win those flips" (Edgar, King of Figaro): the controller's first coin flip each turn is won.

Matching spells its controller casts have replicate with a replicate cost equal to their mana cost (Ian Chesterton). Offered as a multikicker-like payment (`KickCount` = times paid) in the cast; the copies are made by a `SpellCast` trigger on the granting permanent (`Repeat` of `KickCount` with `CopySpell`).

cost.description: The replicate cost as a mana string (Threefold Signal: `{3}`); without it the cost equals the spell's mana cost.

oneOf.description: Matching spells its controller casts have offspring `cost` (Zinnia, Valley's Voice): an optional extra cost, offered like a kicker (`KickCount` = 1 when paid). The 1/1 token copy is made by an `EntersBattlefield` trigger on the granting permanent whose filter has `granted_offspring: true`.

Matching spells its controller casts have conspire (Wort, the Raidmother): an optional extra cost of tapping two untapped creatures you control that share a color with the spell, offered like a kicker (`KickCount` = 1 when paid). The copy is made by a `SpellCast` trigger on the granting permanent (`Repeat` of `KickCount` with `CopySpell`).

Matching spells its controller casts have casualty `n` (Anhelo, the Painter): an optional extra cost of sacrificing a creature with power `n` or greater, offered like a kicker (`KickCount` = 1 when paid). `first_each_turn`: only the first matching spell that player casts each turn. The copy is made by a `SpellCast` trigger on the granting permanent (`Repeat` of `KickCount` with `CopySpell`).

Matching spells the player casts have convoke / improvise / delve ("the next spell you cast this turn has improvise"). Only meaningful in `GrantStatic` to a player; `once`: used up by the first matching spell cast.
Matching spells can't be countered. `once` (in `GrantStatic` to a player): applies to the first matching spell cast only.

by.description: Only against counterspells / abilities from a source matching this ("can't be countered by blue or black spells": Autumn's Veil; `GrantStatic` to a player only).

oneOf.description: Creatures can't attack you (or planeswalkers you control) unless their controller pays this much for each (Propaganda: 2).

amount.description: A computed tax instead of `generic` ("unless pays {X} for each, X = the cards in your hand / your life ..."), evaluated for the static's controller.

only_planeswalkers.description: Onakke Oathkeeper: only attacks against the controller's planeswalkers / battles, not the player.

only_player.description: Ghostly Prison: only attacks against the controller, not their planeswalkers.

oneOf.description: Matching creatures can't attack unless their controller pays this cost (checked per attacker as attackers are declared): "enchanted creature can't attack unless its controller pays {3}", Brainwash, Norn's Annex (use ManaAmount for computed amounts).

against.description: Only when attacking a player matching this (relative to the static's controller): "creatures can't attack YOU unless ..." is `You`.

oneOf.description: Matching creatures can't block unless their controller pays this cost (per blocker).

attacker.description: Only when blocking an attacker matching this filter (relative to the static's controller): Heat Wave "can't block creatures you control unless ...".

oneOf.description: Creatures you control can attack as though they had haste etc. are expressed as GrantKeyword. You control the permanent (Control Magic-style).
The current monarch controls the enchanted permanent (Fealty to the Realm); nobody's control changes while there is no monarch.
Your opponents can't gain life / cast spells during your turn, etc.

During combat (beginning of combat through end of combat) players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities (turning face up is a special action and still allowed; Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty).
During combat (beginning of combat through end of combat) players can't cast spells; abilities are unaffected (Basandra, Battle Seraph).
If a spell or ability you control would counter a spell, instead exile that spell and you may play that card without paying its mana cost (Guile; the offer is made by `Effect::CounterSpell`).
You may pay {0} rather than the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate during each of your turns (Forge Anew; only the mana part of an equip cost is replaced).
Like `EquipFirstFree` but on any turn, not only the controller's own ("the first equip ability you activate each turn": Bruenor Battlehammer).
You may play additional lands.

who.description: Who gets the extra land drops (default: the permanent's controller; Rites of Flourishing / Ghirapur Orrery: Any).

oneOf.description: Matching players' maximum hand size changes by `delta` (Gnat Miser: opponents -1; Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur: opponents -7).
Colored mana of this kind is produced by lands you control (Mana Reflection ...), kept coarse.

all_players.description: Applies to mana every player makes, not just its controller's (Lavaleaper).

basic_land.description: Only mana from basic lands is multiplied (Virtue of Strength).

SubtypeKind.description: Which group of subtypes a "loses all creature types" / "nonbasic lands are Islands" effect replaces; the rest of the subtypes stay.

oneOf.description: A permanent on the battlefield matching the filter.
Any target: creature, planeswalker, battle or player.
A player or a planeswalker ("target player or planeswalker").
An opponent or a planeswalker ("target opponent or planeswalker").
Any one of these kinds of target ("target artifact, creature, planeswalker or opponent": a Permanent kind plus `Player {Opponent}`).
A card in a zone (graveyard targets and the like).
A spell on the stack matching the filter.

A spell or ability on the stack. The filter's target predicates (`single_target`, `spell_has_targets`, `spell_targets`, `spell_targets_you`) apply to either kind; the rest of the filter applies to spells (via the spell card).
An activated and/or triggered ability on the stack (Stifle, "copy target activated or triggered ability you control"). `controller` filters who controls it; `filter` filters its source permanent.

chooser.description: The player who chooses this slot's targets instead of the controller ("target creature of an opponent's choice": `{"type":"TriggerPlayer"}`, `ChosenPlayer`, `EachOpponent`'s first ...).

corrupted.description: With `per_opponent`: a slot exists only for opponents with three or more poison counters as the spell is cast (corrupted: Geth's Summons).

distinct.description: "another target": must differ from the targets chosen for the earlier slots of the same spell or ability.

distinct_by.description: The chosen targets must all differ in this respect ("with different names", "each with a different mana value"); picks that repeat an earlier pick's value are dropped.

distinct_modes.description: In a `Reflexive` inside a `ChooseModes`: the targets can't repeat anything an earlier mode of the same resolution targeted ("each mode must target a different player": Shadrix Silverquill).

exact_x.description: With `max_x`: exactly X targets (minimum X too) instead of "up to X".

label.description: Free-form label shown in the UI ("target creature").

max_amount.description: With `exact_x` (and no `max_x`): exactly N targets (Strength of the Tajuru: KickCount + 1). "up to N target creatures" where N is a computed amount (Archipelagore: `TimesMutated`; evaluated when the targets are chosen); `max` is ignored.

max_total_mv.description: The chosen targets' total mana value can't exceed this ("any number of target artifacts with total mana value 10 or less"); targets beyond the budget (in the order picked) are dropped.

max_total_power.description: Same for total power ("any number of target creature cards with total power 6 or less").

max_x.description: The most targets is X ("up to X target creatures"); `max` is ignored.

per_opponent.description: One separate target slot per opponent ("for each opponent, up to one target creature that player controls"): `min`/`max` apply to each opponent's slot; the chosen targets are all in `Targets`.

per_player.description: Like `per_opponent` but also one slot for the controller ("for each player, up to one target creature that player controls"; the controller's slot comes first).

random.description: The target is chosen at random among the legal ones as the spell or ability is put on the stack ("target creature an opponent controls chosen at random": Scab-Clan Giant).

same_graveyard.description: "cards from a single graveyard": every chosen card must belong to the same player's graveyard (picks from other graveyards than the first are dropped).

when_kicked.description: The slot exists only if the spell was kicked / the gift was promised (`true`) or only if it was not (`false`): "if the gift was promised, target ...".

TempUntil.description: How long a temporary triggered ability (Effect::AddTrigger) lasts.

oneOf.description: Until the start of its controller's next turn.
Until the end of its controller's next turn (Season of the Bold).
Until the end of the next turn of the player in the trigger's first `Remembered` object (give `carry: DefendingPlayer`); it fires only for events caused by that player (Nuka-Nuke Launcher).
Until the end of the current combat (Love on the Battlefield).

TextKind.description: Which kind of word a `ChangeText` effect may replace.

oneOf.description: Any time the player has priority.
Main phase, empty stack, your turn.
Whenever a permanent matching the filter enters the battlefield.
Whenever a creature (or other permanent) matching the filter dies.
Zone change of a matching card from `from` to `to`.

after_resolving.description: Only when a spell card was put there as the final step of resolving without being countered or fizzled ("when this spell card is put into a graveyard after resolving": Haunt on sorceries).

also_from.description: More zones the card may come from besides `from` ("from graveyards and/or the battlefield": `from: Graveyard`, `also_from: [Battlefield]`); pair with `batched` for "one or more".

cause_opponent.description: Only when a spell or ability controlled by someone other than this trigger's controller moved it (Sacred Ground, Karmic Justice); the trigger player is that cause.

cause_you.description: Only when a spell or ability controlled by this trigger's controller moved it ("a spell or ability you control exiles ...": Hero of Bretagard).

craft_cost.description: Only when it was exiled from the battlefield as a cost of a craft ability (an activated ability whose costs exile this card and the crafted permanent: Market Gnome).

destroyed.description: Only when it was destroyed (not sacrificed, not state-based damage-free moves).

not_sacrificed.description: Only when it wasn't sacrificed (Urza's Miter: "if it wasn't sacrificed").

not_to.description: Any destination except this zone ("leaves the battlefield without dying": `from: Battlefield`, `not_to: Graveyard`; Dour Port-Mage with `batched`).

at_enchanted.description: Only when it attacks the player this Curse enchants (not a planeswalker or battle that player controls).

at_opponent.description: Only when it attacks an opponent of the trigger's controller (or a planeswalker/battle one controls): "attacks one of your opponents".

at_you.description: Only when it attacks you (not your planeswalkers or battles).

at_you_or_pw.description: Only when it attacks you or a planeswalker/battle you control ("attacks you or a planeswalker you control").

batched.description: "Whenever one or more creatures attack": once per defending player per combat, not once per attacker.

one_per_declaration.description: With `batched`: one trigger for the whole declaration even when the attackers go at different planeswalkers (Mila: "one or more planeswalkers you control"); without it each attacked planeswalker gets its own (Oath of Kaya).

player_only.description: Only attacks on a player (not on a planeswalker or battle): "whenever you attack a player".

pw_only.description: Only attacks on a planeswalker/battle the trigger's controller controls, never on the player (Oath of Kaya, Mila).

oneOf.description: "Whenever a player attacks one of your opponents": once per attacking player (matching `who`, relative to the trigger's controller) and attacked opponent of the trigger's controller (planeswalkers and battles don't count) per combat. `TriggerPlayer` = the attacking player, `TriggerObject` = the attacked player.
A spell matching `filter` is countered by a spell or ability controlled by a player matching `by` (relative to the trigger's controller): Baral, Lullmage Mentor.
`player_only`: it must be attacking a player, not a planeswalker or battle ("attacks a player alone": Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty).

"Whenever this creature and another creature attack different players": the matching creature attacks a player and another attacking creature attacks a different player (not a planeswalker or battle; Canal Courier).

"Whenever you attack" / "whenever a player attacks with N or more creatures": once per attack declaration by a player matching `who`, if at least `min` creatures attacked. The trigger object is the first attacking creature.

filter.description: Count only attackers matching this ("attack with one or more Zombies"); the trigger needs at least `min` of them.

max.description: At most this many attackers ("attack with exactly two creatures": min 2, max 2).

min_total_power.description: The counted attackers' total power must be at least this ("attack with creatures with total power 6 or greater": Ugin's Mastery).

players_only.description: Only attackers that attack a player (not a planeswalker or battle) count ("one or more Devils you control attack one or more players": Zurzoth).

oneOf.description: A creature matching `filter` blocks. Fires once per blocked attacker unless `once` ("whenever this blocks" with no "a creature": one trigger however many attackers it blocks).

blocked.description: Also requires the blocked attacker to match ("whenever this blocks a nonblack creature").

oneOf.description: An attacking creature matching `filter` isn't blocked (after blockers are declared; "attacks and isn't blocked").
"When you unlock this door": a door of this Room becomes unlocked (`door` 1 or 2; absent = either). A Room (matching `filter`) you control becomes fully unlocked (eerie).
A matching permanent phases out / phases in.
A matching player commits a crime (targets an opponent, an opponent's permanent or a card in an opponent's graveyard).
"Whenever day becomes night or night becomes day" (`to_day: true` = only night becoming day, `false` = only day becoming night).

batched.description: "Whenever one or more creatures you control become blocked": one trigger per declare-blockers step, however many attackers were blocked.

blocker.description: Also requires the blocking creature to match ("becomes blocked by a nonblack creature").

by_each.description: Triggers for every blocking creature ("becomes blocked by a creature"), not once per attacker.

oneOf.description: Combat damage dealt by a matching source.

to_filter.description: The damaged permanent must match this filter ("deals combat damage to a non-Wall creature": Acidic Dagger).

to_owner.description: The damaged player must be the owner of the damage source ("deals combat damage to its owner": The Beast, Deathless Prince).

combat.description: Some(true): only combat damage; Some(false): only noncombat damage.

first_to_player_each_turn.description: Only the first time this turn the damage source dealt damage to a player (Stensia: "for the first time each turn").

opponents_count.description: "one or more ... deal damage to your opponents, for each opponent dealt damage": combat damage of one damage step folds into ONE trigger whose `EventAmount` is the number of different opponents dealt damage (like `CombatDamageToPlayer.opponents_count`); noncombat damage triggers separately with `EventAmount` 1 (Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator).

per_source.description: With `batched`: damage is folded only per damage source ("a red creature or spell deals damage": Justice), not across all matching sources ("one or more Pirates").

oneOf.description: Damage dealt to a matching permanent or player. `combat`: Some(true) = only combat damage, Some(false) = only noncombat damage (absent = any).

batched.description: Combat damage dealt at the same time by several sources is one trigger whose `EventAmount` is the total (Innocent Bystander: "dealt 3 or more damage").

excess.description: Only damage beyond lethal ("is dealt excess damage": Aegar, the Freezing Flame); `EventAmount` is then the excess (Toralf, God of Fury).

oneOf.description: "At the beginning of the first upkeep of the game" (Two Streams Facility). Use with `from: "Command"` on a plane that starts face up.

or_copy.description: Also whenever a matching spell is copied ("cast or copy": magecraft, Prismari Apprentice ...).

oneOf.description: Whenever a matching player casts a matching spell using teamwork (a Kicker whose cost taps creatures: `Cost::TapTotalPower`) (Virtual Assistant).
Whenever a matching player copies a matching spell (only copies, not casts: The Twelfth Doctor).
Whenever a matching player casts a spell (matching `filter`) that targets a permanent matching `target` (heroic: `target: {this: true}`).

only.description: The spell's ONLY target is such a permanent ("a spell that targets only this creature"): it has exactly one target and it matches.

oneOf.description: This permanent becomes renowned.
This creature (matching the filter) mutates (a mutating creature spell merges with it).
This card (or a matching one) was plotted: exiled from hand with the Plot special action (Longhorn Sharpshooter; use `from: Exile`).
A card (matching the filter, e.g. `owner: You`) is foretold: exiled from hand by the foretell special action or a foretelling effect (Dream Devourer).
A creature matching `filter` is exerted ("whenever you exert a creature": `controller: You`); the trigger object is the exerted creature.
A Case matching `filter` becomes solved ("whenever you solve a Case": `subtypes: [Case], controller: You`); the trigger object is the Case.
"Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga (matching `filter`) resolves" (Narci, Tom Bombadil). The trigger object is the Saga.
"Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga (matching `filter`) triggers" (Historian's Boon): fires as the lore counter reaching the last chapter is added. The trigger object is the Saga.
A player faces a dilemma: chooses one or more modes for a spell or ability (Star Trek). `EventAmount` is how many they have faced this turn.
A player scries or surveils (`surveil`: Some(false) scry only, Some(true) surveil only, None either).

first_this_turn.description: Only the first surveil of the turn (Whispering Snitch: "whenever you surveil for the first time each turn"; use with `surveil: true`).

to_bottom.description: Only when the scry put one or more cards on the bottom; `EventAmount` is how many (The Temporal Anchor).

by_effect_of.description: Only when an effect (spell/ability resolution) controlled by a player matching this (relative to the trigger's controller) tapped it - not costs, attacks or the untap step ("whenever you tap an untapped creature an opponent controls").

not_declared_attacker.description: Not when it is tapped as it is declared as an attacker (Verity Circle).

teamwork.description: Only when it was tapped to pay a teamwork cost (Agent Maria Hill).

oneOf.description: A regeneration shield (or "regenerate instead" replacement) was used on a matching permanent ("when it regenerates this way", Matopi Golem).

`by`: who controls the spell / ability doing the targeting ("an opponent's spell or ability targets ~": `by: Opponent`). A player matching `who` (relative to this permanent's controller; `Enchanted` = the enchanted player) becomes the target of a spell or ability controlled by a player matching `by`. Whenever a spell or ability (spell, activated or triggered ability; not delayed triggers or copies) is put onto the stack; `TriggerStackItem` is that item. `single_target`: only if it has exactly one target (Grip of Chaos).

has_targets.description: Only if it has at least one target ("whenever a player chooses one or more targets": Psychic Battle).

oneOf.description: "Whenever you and/or at least one permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls": one trigger per spell or ability (the first matching permanent target counts only when the player is not targeted too). `TriggerPlayer` is the controller of the targeting spell or ability.
Damage (any, or only combat / noncombat) is dealt to one of the two players chosen on the source (Sower of Discord); `TriggerPlayer` is the damaged player, `EventAmount` the damage.

activated_only.description: Only an activated ability (not a spell or a triggered ability) counts (Professor Hojo).

only.description: Only when the spell or ability targets only the matching object ("an ability that targets only it": Agrus Kos, Eternal Soldier): every target of the stack object is that permanent.

source.description: The spell / ability's source card must match this filter ("an instant or sorcery spell": `types`).

spell_only.description: Some(true): only targeted by a spell; Some(false): only by an ability.

oneOf.description: A matching player draws a card. `this_card`: only when this very card is drawn (miracle: use `from: Hand`); `first_this_turn`: only the first card drawn that turn.

chosen_name.description: Only when the drawn card has the name chosen for the source (`Effect::ChooseCardName`: Booby Trap).

not_first_in_draw_step.description: Not the first card drawn during that player's own draw step ("except the first one they draw in their draw step").

nth_this_turn.description: Only the Nth card drawn this turn (2 = "the second card each player draws each turn").

cause_opponent.description: Only when a spell or ability controlled by a player other than the discarding player causes the discard ("whenever an opponent's spell or ability causes you to discard").

filter.description: What kind of card was discarded ("whenever you discard an artifact card").

this_only.description: Only when this very card is the one discarded (Madness).

cause.description: Only when the life is gained because of a spell or ability matching the filter, read from the object resolving right now ("whenever a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life": Firesong and Sunspeaker).

exactly.description: Only when the player lost exactly this much life in the event ("one or more opponents each lose exactly 1 life": Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin; use `batched` on the ability).

first_this_turn.description: Only the first time that player loses life this turn (Vengeful Warchief).

oneOf.description: `kind` omitted: counters of any kind.

first_this_turn.description: Only when this is the first time counters of this kind were put on that permanent this turn, counting placements before the source entered (Botanical Brawler).

per_counter.description: Triggers once for each counter put on at the same time ("whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on ..."; Bloodcrazed Hoplite ruling).

placed_by.description: Only counters put there by a spell or ability controlled by this player ("a counter you put"); relative to the trigger's controller.

oneOf.description: Counters were put on (or given to) a matching player (poison, energy, experience, rad); `EventAmount` = how many (All Will Be One).

placed_by.description: Only counters put there by a spell or ability controlled by this player; relative to the trigger's controller.

oneOf.description: One or more counters of `kind` were removed from a matching permanent or card (e.g. a suspended card in exile with `from: Exile`); `last`: only when that removed the last counter of the kind.

by_you.description: Only when the trigger's controller removed the counter ("when you remove the last counter": Divine Intervention).

emerge.description: Only when the permanent is sacrificed to pay the emerge cost of a spell being cast (Foul Emissary).

oneOf.description: When this becomes attached.
Whenever a permanent matching `filter` (an Aura) becomes attached to this permanent (Bramble Elemental, Brood Keeper). TriggerObject = the attached permanent.

Whenever a permanent matching `attachment` becomes attached to a permanent matching `host` (anything, not just this one). TriggerObject = the host, TriggerSource = the attached permanent. `mv_le`: the host's mana value must be at most the attachment's (Eriette, the Beguiler).
When you lose control of a permanent matching the filter (Gustha's Scepter, Khârn the Betrayer). A source that is itself the permanent triggers for its former controller.
You gain control of a matching permanent (Risky Move: "when you gain control of this enchantment"); the ability is controlled by the new controller.

When a permanent matching the filter transforms (Cult of the Waxing Moon, Corruption of Towashi). `or_enters`: also when a matching permanent enters the battlefield transformed (Corruption of Towashi).
When a permanent matching the filter is turned face up.
A land is played (a land drop). `filter` tests the land; `not_from_hand`: only when it was played from somewhere other than a hand (Courser of Kruphix, Shadow of the Goblin).

from.description: Only when the land was played from this zone (Exile, Library, Graveyard).

oneOf.description: A player's library is shuffled (Cosi's Trickster, Widespread Panic).
A matching player becomes the monarch (Garland, Royal Kidnapper: "whenever an opponent becomes the monarch"). `Sel::TriggerPlayer` = that player.
Whenever a matching player activates an ability (of a permanent matching `filter`) that isn't a mana ability.

boast.description: Only boast abilities (once each turn, only if the creature attacked this turn).

exhaust.description: Only exhaust abilities (an `Activated` ability with `once: true`).

has_x_cost.description: Only abilities with {X} in their activation cost (Magus Lucea Kane).

incl_mana.description: Mana abilities count too ("whenever you activate an ability of a creature" without the "that isn't a mana ability" rider: Elrond, Moon-Reader).

loyalty.description: Only loyalty abilities ("activate a loyalty ability": Repeated Reverberation).

loyalty_removed_min.description: Only loyalty abilities whose cost removes at least this many loyalty counters (Way of the Mind Sculptor: 2).

mana_spent_min.description: Only abilities activated by spending at least this much mana (Dynaheir, Invoker Adept: 4).

ninjutsu.description: Only ninjutsu abilities (activated from hand, returning an unblocked attacker to hand as a cost: Satoru Umezawa).

no_tap_cost.description: Only abilities whose activation cost has no {T} ("activates an artifact's ability without {T} in its activation cost": Haunting Wind, Powerleech).

sacrificed.description: Only abilities with a sacrifice among their costs ("if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it": Ashnod the Uncaring).

targets_creature_or_player.description: Only abilities with at least one target that is a creature or a player (Ertha Jo, Frontier Mentor).

targets_only_this.description: Only abilities that target only this permanent (exactly one target, the trigger's source: Bill Potts).

oneOf.description: Either trigger event ("whenever you cast ... or activate ..."): one trigger, so "this ability triggers only once each turn" covers both (Bill Potts). `TriggerObject` is whatever `a` / `b` give.
Whenever a triggered ability (controlled per `by`, source matching `filter`) is put on the stack because a permanent entering caused it to trigger (Strict Proctor). TriggerObject is the ability.

Whenever a triggered ability (controlled per `by`, source matching `filter`) is put on the stack because its own source attacked, i.e. it triggered from that creature's attack (Firebender Ascension). TriggerObject is the ability.
A player (matching `who`, relative to the source's controller) searches a library (a SearchLibrary effect starts).
Whenever this Mount becomes saddled (or, with `any`, whenever a matching Mount does).
A player loses the game (`who`: which players; `Enchanted` for Curse of Vengeance).

batched.description: "One or more creatures ... deal combat damage to a player": once per damaged player per damage step.

opponents_count.description: "One or more creatures deal combat damage to one or more of your opponents": ONE trigger per damage step (not per player), only damage to opponents of the controller counts, and `Amount::EventAmount` is the number of different opponents dealt damage (Hordewing Skaab). Implies `batched`.

or_battle.description: Also fires for combat damage dealt to a battle ("to a player or battle": Zurgo and Ojutai). The battle's controller stands in as the damaged player for batching.

per_controller.description: With `batched`: fold the damage per CONTROLLER of the damaging creatures (as well as per damaged player), so each controller's creatures give their own trigger ("whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls deal combat damage to you, that opponent ...": Norn's Decree; read the controller with `Sel::ControllerOf{TriggerObject}`).

oneOf.description: "Whenever a creature (matching filter) exploits a creature" - fires for any exploiting creature.

victim.description: Restricts the sacrificed creature ("exploits a nontoken creature").

oneOf.description: Whenever a player (matching `who`) wins a clash.
A matching player clashes (either result); `Amount::EventAmount` is 1 if they won, else 0.
Whenever players finish voting (the Vote effect completed).
A matching creature explores (the Explore effect resolved for it). `revealed`: the revealed card must match ("explores a land card" / "a nonland card").
A player matching `who` investigates (`first_this_turn`: only their first investigate each turn: Erdwal Illuminator).
A player matching `who` collects evidence.
A player matching `who` pays life (EventAmount = the life paid): Font of Agonies.
A creature matching `filter` performs a keyword action (trains / evolves / mentors); the trigger object is the mentored creature for `Mentors`, else the creature itself.
A matching creature connives (the Connive effect resolved for it).
A player gets one or more {E} (energy counters).
A player matching `who` discovers (`Effect::Discover`); `EventAmount` is the discover value N (Curator of Sun's Creation).
One or more cards matching `filter` are milled from a player's library (batched per Mill effect; `EventAmount` = how many matched).
A player matching `who` bends: waterbends (pays a waterbend cost), earthbends, firebends (firebending mana is added) or airbends, one of `kinds` (empty = any kind) (Avatar Aang).
A player matching `who` manifests dread (the Manifest dread effect finished); `Sel::EventCards` = the card(s) put into the graveyard this way (Paranormal Analyst).

A player (matching `who`) rolls a die; `EventAmount` is the result. `highest`: only when the natural result is the die's highest ("whenever you roll a die's highest natural result": Netherese Puzzle-Ward). `batched`: "whenever you roll one or more dice": once per roll (all the dice of one roll together, however many the roll replacement added) instead of once per die (Barbarian Class).
A player (matching `who`) gives a gift: a spell they cast with the gift promised (a `Kicker` with an empty cost) resolves without being countered or fizzling (Jolly Gerbils).
A player (matching `who`) flips a coin; `won` limits to won / lost flips (None = any).
A player proliferates (the Proliferate effect completed).
This Vehicle becomes crewed (its Crew cost was paid).
Planechase: "Whenever you roll {CHAOS}" on a plane (also when chaos ensues). Use with `from: "Command"`.
Planechase: "Whenever you roll a blank on the planar die" (Pompeii). Use with `from: "Command"`.
Planechase: "Whenever you roll the planar die" (any face; Stairs to Infinity). Use with `from: "Command"`.
Planechase: "When you planeswalk to this plane" / a phenomenon's "When you encounter". Use with `from: "Command"`.
Planechase: "When you planeswalk away from this plane". Use with `from: "Command"`.
Archenemy: "When you set this scheme in motion". Use with `from: "Command"`.
Archenemy: "Whenever you set a scheme in motion" (another scheme than this one); `non_ongoing`: only a non-ongoing scheme (My Laughter Echoes). TriggerObject = that scheme.

A creature (matching `filter`) is tapped to pay a Crew / Saddle cost of a Vehicle / Mount (matching `vehicle`); `saddle`: only Saddle (true) / only Crew (false). TriggerObject = the creature, TriggerSource = the Vehicle / Mount.
This attachment becomes unattached from a permanent.
Whenever the Ring tempts a player (matching `who`).
Whenever a player (matching `who`) takes the initiative.
This dungeon card's room `name` was entered (put it on a dungeon card as `from: Command`).
Whenever a player (matching `who`) completes a dungeon.
Whenever a player (matching `who`) chooses a creature as their Ring-bearer (the creature is the trigger object).
Expend N: whenever a player (matching `who`) spends their Nth total mana of the turn to cast spells.
This creature becomes monstrous (a matching creature, with `filter`).
Fires when its condition is true (state trigger).
"Whenever <a matching permanent> is tapped for mana": a triggered mana ability, resolved immediately (Wild Growth, Utopia Sprawl ...).

on_stack.description: Not a mana ability: the trigger goes on the stack (Burning Earth).

produced.description: Only when the mana produced includes this type (Forsaken Monument: colorless).

produced_chosen_color.description: Only when the mana produced includes the color this permanent chose (Gauntlet of Power).

oneOf.description: A saga's chapter `chapter` (lore counters reaching that number).
The attacking creature caused the trigger (Wulfgar, Isshin).
The permanent turned face up caused the trigger (Panoptic Projektor).
A player drawing a card caused the trigger; `cause` filters the permanent whose ability triggers (Krang).
The trigger controller gaining life caused the trigger; `cause` filters the permanent whose ability triggers (Dr. Beverly Crusher).
A creature dealing combat damage to a player caused the trigger; `cause` filters that creature (Felix Five-Boots).
A room being entered caused the trigger; `cause` filters the dungeon card (Dungeon Delver: a dungeon you own).
The trigger controller casting or copying an instant or sorcery spell caused the trigger; `cause` filters the permanent whose ability triggers (Veyran, Voice of Duality).
ANY triggered ability of a permanent matching `cause` (the permanent whose ability triggers is the cause).
A creature being dealt damage caused the trigger; `cause` filters the damaged creature (Wayta, Trainer Prodigy).
Outside the game: cards the owner may fetch with Wish-style effects. Never part of any game rule otherwise.
